Bekhorot 44b:2-11: Gemara amar rabbi abba bereh derabbi chiyyay bar abba: mashtinin mayim bifne rabbim, veen shotin mayim bifne rabbim. vetanya name hachi: mashtinin mayim bifne rabbim, veen shotin mayim bifne rabbim. umaase beechad shebbikkesh lehashetin mayim velo hishtin, venimtza kereso tzava.
Shemuel itzterich leh beshabbeta derigla, negadu leh gelima, ata lekammeh daavu, amar leh: etten lach arba mea zuze vezil ahdar ovada. at — deefshar lach, dela efshar leh — listakkan.
Mar bar rav ashe itzterich aggudda gamla, ashten. amaru leh: chamatach kaatya! amar lehu: beudena.
Tanu rabbanan: shene nekavim yesh bo baadam, echad motzi sheten veechad motzi shichvat zera, veen ben ze laze ella kiklippat hashshum. beshaa sheadam nitzrach, im nikkevu ze letoch ze — nimtza akar.
Amar resh lakish: may dichtiv "lo yihye vecha akar vaakara uvivhemtecha"? ematay lo yihye vecha akar? bizman shebbivhemtecha".
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: "lo yihye vecha akar" — min hattalmidim, "vaakara" — shello tehe tefillatecha akura lifne hammakom. ematay? bizman sheatta mesim atzmecha kivhema.

Amar rav pappa: lo yashtin adam mayim lo al kele cheres, velo al mekom kashe, deamar rav: hane medore devavel mehadderi mayya leen etam. amar abbaye: ha itteta la tekum lehedya beanpe yanoka, aggisa let lan ba.

Tanya, rabban shimon ben gamliel omer: ammud hachozer mevi adam lide hidrokan, silon hachozer mevi adam lide yerakon. amar rabba bar rav huna, amar rav kattina, amar resh lakish: dam rave — shechin rave, shichvat zera rava — tzaraat rava, tzoa rava — hidrokan rave, me raglayim ravin — yerakon rave.
Ruach katzrit baa alav. may ninhu? tana: ruach ben nefalim baa alav.
Berakhot 54b:12-20: Amar rav yehuda amar rav: arbaa tzerichin lehodot: yorde hayyam, holche midbarot, umi shehaya chole venitrappe, umi shehaya chavush bevet haasurim veyatza.

Yorde hayyam menalan? — dichtiv: "yorde hayyam booniyyot vegomer hemma rau maase Adonai". veomer: "vayyaamed ruach seara yaalu shamayim yerdu tehomot", veomer: "yachoggu veyanuu kashshikkor", veomer: "vayyitzaku el Adonai batztzar lahem umimmetzukotehem yotziem", veomer: "yakem seara lidmama", veomer: "vayyismechu chi yishtoku", veomer: "yodu laAdonai chasdo venifleotav livne adam".
Holche midbarot menalan? dichtiv: "tau vammidbar bishimon darech ir moshav lo matzau … vayyitzaku el Adonai … vayyadrichem bederech yeshara … yodu laAdonai chasdo".

Mi shechala venitrappe, dichtiv: "evilim midderech pisham umeavonotehem yitannu. kol ochel tetaev nafsham vegomer vayyizaku el Adonai batztzar lahem vegomer yishlach devaro veyirpaem vegomer yodu laAdonai chasdo".

Mi shehaya chavush bevet haasurin menalan? — dichtiv: "yoshve choshech vetzalmavet vegomer ki himru imre el vegomer". veomer: "vayyachna beamal libbam vegomer", veomer: "vayyizaku el Adonai batztzar lahem", veomer: "yotziem mechoshech vetzalmavet vegomer", veomer: "yodu laAdonai chasdo".

May mevarech? amar rav yehuda: "baruch gomel chasadim tovim". abbaye amar: vetzarich leodoye kamme asra, dichtiv: "virommuhu bikhal am vegomer". mar zutera amar: uteren minnayyhu rabbanan, shenneemar: "uvemoshav zekenim yehalluhu".
Matkef la rav ashe: veema kullehu rabbanan?! — mi ketiv "bikhal zekenim"? "bikhal am" ketiv. veema be asra shear amma, utere rabbanan! kashya.
Rav yehuda chalash veittefach. al legabbeh rav chana bagdataa verabbanan. amri leh: "berich rachamana deyahavach nihalan vela yahavach leafra". amar lehu: petartun yati milleodoye.
Veha amar abbaye bae odoye beappe asra! — dahavo be asra. veha ihu la ka mode! — la tzerich, deane batrayyhu "amen".
Chagigah 16a:11-17: Kol shello chas al kevod kono, ratuy lo shello ba leolam. may hi? rabbi abba amar: ze hammistakkel bakkeshet. rav yosef amar: ze haover avera basseter. mistakkel bakkeshet, dichtiv: "kemare hakkeshet asher yihye veanan beyom haggeshem ken mare hannoga saviv hu mare demut kevod Adonai".

Rav yosef amar: ze haover avera basseter, kidrabbi yitzchak. deamar rabbi yitzchak: kol haover avera basseter, keillu dochek ragle shechina, shenneemar: "ko amar Adonai hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay".

Ini?! vehaamar rabbi ila hazzaken: im roe adam sheyyitzro mitgabber alav — yelech lemakom sheen makkirin oto, veyilbash shechorin veyitattef shechorin, veyaase ma shellibbo chafetz, veal yechallel shem shamayim befarhesya! la kashya: ha — dematze kayef leh leyitzreh, ha — dela matze kayef leyitzreh.

Daresh rabbi yehuda berabbi nachmani meturegmaneh deresh lakish: kol hammistakkel bishlosha devarim enav kehot: bakkeshet, uvannasi, uvakkohanim. bakkeshet — dichtiv: "kemare hakkeshet asher yihye veanan beyom haggeshem hu mare demut kevod Adonai". bannasi — dichtiv: "venatatta mehodcha alav". hammistakkel bakkohanim bizman shebbet hammikdash kayyaym, shehayu omdin al duchanan umevarchin et yisrael bashshem hameforash.

Daresh rabbi yehuda berabbi nachmani meturegmaneh deresh lakish, may dichtiv: "al taaminu verea al tivtechu bealluf" — im yomar lecha yetzer hara, chato vehakkadosh baruch hu mochel al taamen, shenneemar: "al taaminu verea", veen "ra" ella yetzer hara shenneemar "ki yetzer lev haadam ra",

Veen "alluf" ella hakkadosh baruch hu, shenneemar: "alluf neuray atta". shemma tomar mi meid bi? avne veto vekorot beto shel adam hem meidin bo, shenneemar: "ki even mikkir tizak vechafis meetz yaanenna",

Vachachamim omrim: nishmato shel adam meida bo shenneemar "mishshochevet chekecha shemor pitche ficha", (i zo hi davar sheshshochevet) [e ze hu davar sheshsharuy] becheko shel adam — heve omer: zo neshama. rabbi zerika omer: shene malache hashsharet hamelavvin oto, hen meidin bo, shenneemar: "ki malachav yetzavve lach lishmarcha bechol derachecha". vachachamim omrim: evarav shel adam meidin bo, shenneemar: "veattem eday neum Adonai vaani el".

Mishnah Beitzah 2:10-3:3:
Agala shel katan temea midras venittelet beshabbat, veenah nigreret ella al gabbe chelim. rabbi yehuda omer, kol hakkelim en nigrarin chutz min haagala, mippene shehi choveshet: 
En tzadin dagim min habbevarin beyom tov, veen notnin lifnehem mezonot. aval tzadin chayya vaof min habbevarin, venotnin lifnehem mezonot. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, lo chol habbevarin shavin. ze hakkelal, kol hamechussar tzida asur, vesheeno mechussar tzida muttar: 
Metzudot chayya vaof vedagim sheasaan meerev yom tov, lo yittol mehen beyom tov, ella im ken yodea shennitztzodu meerev yom tov. umaase venachri echad, shehevi dagim lerabban gamliel, veamar, muttarin hen, ella sheen retzoni lekabbel hemennu: 
Behema mesukkenet lo yishchot, ella im ken yesh shahut bayyom leechol mimmenna kazzayit tzali. rabbi akiva omer, afillu chazzayit chay mibbet tevichatah. shechatah bassade, lo yevienna vemot uvemota. aval mevi veyado evarim evarim:
Mishnah Beitzah 3:4-8:
Bechor shennafal levor, rabbi yehuda omer, yered mumche veyire, im yesh bo mum, yaale veyishchot. veim lav, lo yishchot. rabbi shimon omer, kol sheen mumo nikkar mibbeod yom, en ze min hammuchan: 
Behema shemmeta, lo yezizenna mimmekomah. umaase veshaalu et rabbi tarfon aleha veal hachalla shennitmea, venichnas levet hammidrash veshaal, veamru lo, lo yezizem mimmekomam: 
En nimnin al habbehema lechattechilla beyom tov, aval nimnin aleha meerev yom tov veshochatin umechallekin benehen. rabbi yehuda omer, shokel adam basar keneged hakkeli o cheneged hakkofitz. vachachamim omrim, en mashgichin bechaf moznayim kol ikkar: 
En mashchizin et hassakkin beyom tov, aval massiah al gabbe chavertah. lo yomar adam lattabbach, shekol li vedinar basar. aval shochet umechallekim benehen: 
Omer adam lachavero, malle li cheli ze, aval lo vammidda. rabbi yehuda omer, im haya cheli shel midda, lo yemalennu. maase veabba shaul ben batnit, shehaya memalle middotav meerev yom tov venotnan lallakochot beyom tov. abba shaul omer, af bammoed ose chen, mippene verure hammiddot. vachachamim omrim, af bechol ose chen, mippene mitztzuy hammiddot. holech adam etzel chenvani haragil etzlo, veomer lo, ten li betzim veegozim beminyan, shekken derech baal habbayit lihyot mone betoch beto:
Mishnah Beitzah 4:1-4:
Hammevi chadde yayin mimmakom lemakom, lo yeviem besal uvekuppa, aval mevi hu al ketefo o lefanav. vechen hammolich et hatteven, lo yafshil et hakkuppa laachorav, aval meviah hu veyado. umatchilin baaremat hatteven, aval lo vaetzim shebbammuktze: 
En notlin etzim min hassukka, ella min hassamuch lah. meviin etzim min hassade min hamechunnas, umin hakkarpef afillu min hamefuzzar. ezehu karpef, kol shessamuch lair, divre rabbi yehuda. rabbi yose omer, kol shennichnasin lo vefotachat, vaafillu vetoch techum shabbat: 
En mevakkein etzim, lo min hakkorot, velo min hakkora shennishbera veyom tov. veen mevakkein lo vekardom velo vimgera velo vemaggal, ella vekofitz. bayit shehu male ferot, satum venifchat, notel mimmekom happechat. rabbi meir omer, af pochet lechattechilla venotel: 
En potchin et hanner, mippene shehu ose cheli. veen osin pechamin beyom tov, veen chotchin et happetila lishnayim. rabbi yehuda omer, chotchah baur lishte nerot:
Mishnah Beitzah 4:5-5:1:
En shovrin et hacheres, veen chotchin et hanneyar litzlot bo maliach, veen gorfin tannur vechirayim, aval mechabbeshin, veen makkifin shete chaviyyot lishpot alehen et hakkedera, veen somchin et hakkedera vevakkaat, vechen bedelet, veen manhigin et habbehema vemakkel beyom tov, verabbi elazar berabbi shimon mattir: 
Rabbi eliezer omer, notel adam kesam mishshellefanav lachatzotz bo shinnav. umegabbev min hechatzer umadlik, shekkol ma shebbechatzer muchan hu. vachachamim omrim, megabbev mishshellefanav umadlik: 
En motziin et haur lo min haetzim, velo min haavanim, velo min heafar, velo min hammayim, veen melabbenin et harafim litzlot bahen. veod amar rabbi eliezer, omed adam al hammuktze erev shabbat bashsheviit, veomer, mikkan ani ochel lemachar. vachachamim omrim, ad sheyyirshom veyomar, mikkan vead kan: 
Mashshilin perot derech arubba beyom tov, aval lo veshabbat, umechassim perot bechelim mippene haddelef, vechen kadde yayin vechadde shemen. venotnin keli tachat haddelef beshabbat:
Mishnah Beitzah 5:2-6:
Kol shechayyavin alav mishshum shevut, mishshum reshut, mishshum mitzva, beshabbat, chayyavin alav beyom tov. veellu hen mishshum shevut, lo olin bailan, velo rochvin al gabbe vehema, velo shatin al pene hammayim, velo metappechin, velo mesappekin, velo merakkedin. veellu hen mishshum reshut, lo danin, velo mekaddeshin, velo choltzin, velo meyabbemin. veellu hen mishshum mitzva, lo makdishin, velo maarichin, velo macharimin, velo magbihin teruma umaaser. kol ellu beyom tov amru, kal vachomer beshabbat. en ben yom tov leshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad: 
Habbehema vehakkelim keragle habbealim. hammoser behemto livno o leroe, hare ellu cheragle habbealim. kelim hameyuchadin leachad min haachin shebbabbayit, hare ellu cheraglav. vesheen meyuchadin, hare ellu chimkom sheholchin: 
Hashshoel keli mechavero meerev yom tov, keragle hashshoel. beyom tov, keragle hammashil. haishsha sheshshaala mechavertah tevalin umayim umelach leissatah, hare ellu cheragle shetehen. rabbi yehuda foter bemayim, mippene sheen bahen mammash: 
Haggachelet keragle habbealim, veshalhevet bechol makom. gachelet shel hekdesh moalin bah, veshalhevet lo nehenin velo moalin. hammotzi gachelet lirshut harabbim, chayyav. veshalhevet, patur. bor shel yachid, keragle hayyachid. veshel anshe otah hair, keragle anshe otah hair. veshel ole vavel, keragle hamemalle: 
Mi shehayu ferotav beir acheret, veervu vene otah hair lehavi etzlo mipperotav, lo yaviu lo. veim erav hu, perotav kamohu:
Mishnah Beitzah 5:7: Mi shezzimmen etzlo orchim, lo yolichu veyadam manot, ella im ken zikka lahem manotehem meerev yom tov. en mashkin veshochatin et hammidbariyyot, aval mashkin veshochatin et habbayatot. ellu hen bayatot, hallanot bair. midbariyyot, hallanot baafar:
Mishnah Horayot 1:1-4:
Horu vet din laavor al achat mikkol mitzvot haamurot battora, vehalach hayyachid veasa shogeg al pihem, ben sheasu veasa immahen, ben sheasu veasa acharehen, ben shello asu veasa, patur, mippene shettala vevet din. horu vet din veyada echad mehen shettau, o talmid vehu rauy lehoraa, vehalach veasa al pihen, ben sheasu veasa immahen, ben sheasu veasa acharehen, ben shello asu veasa, hare ze chayyav, mippene shello tala bevet din. ze hakkelal, hattole veatzmo, chayyav. vehattole bevet din, patur: 
Horu vet din, veyadu shettau, vechazru vahen, ben sheheviu chapparatan uven shello heviu chapparatan, vehalach veasa al pihen, rabbi shimon poter, verabbi eliezer omer, safek. ezehu safek. yashav lo vetoch beto, chayyav. halach lo limdinat hayyam, patur. amar rabbi akiva, mode ani vaze shehu karov liftur min hachova. amar lo ven azzay, ma shana ze min hayyoshev beveto, shehayyoshev beveto efshar haya lo sheyyishma, veze lo haya efshar lo sheyyishma: 
Horu vet din laakor et kol hagguf, amru, en nidda vattora, en shabbat battora, en avoda zara vattora, hare ellu feturin. horu levattel miktzat ulekayyem miktzat, hare ellu chayyavin. ketzad. amru, yesh nidda vattora, aval habba al shomeret yom keneged yom patur. yesh shabbat battora, aval hammotzi mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim, patur. yesh avoda zara vattora, aval hammishtachave fatur, hare ellu chayyavin, shenneemar (Vayikra 4) venelam davar, davar velo chol hagguf: 
Horu vet din, veyada echad mehen shettau, veamar lahen toin attem, o shello haya mufla shel bet din sham, o shehaya achad mehen ger o mamzer o natin o zaken shello raa lo vanim, hare ellu feturin, shenneemar kan eda (Vayikra 4) veneemar lehallan (Bamidbar la) eda, ma eda haamur lehallan ad sheyyihyu chullam reuyin lehoraa, af eda haamura chan ad sheyyihyu chullam reuyim lehoraa. horu vet din shoggim veasu chol hakkahal shoggin, meviin par. mezidin veasu shoggin, meviin kisba useira. shoggin veasu mezidin, hare ellu feturin:
Mishnah Horayot 1:5-2:3:
Horu vet din, veasu chol hakkahal o rubban al pihem, meviin par. uvaavoda zara, meviin par vesair, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, shenem asar shevatim meviin shenem asar parim, uvaavoda zara, meviin shenem asar parim ushenem asar seirim. rabbi shimon omer, shelosha asar parim, uvaavoda zara, shelosha asar parim ushelosha asar seirim, par vesair lechol shevet vashevet, par vesair levet din. horu vet din, veasu shiva shevatim o rubban al pihem, meviim par, uvaavoda zara meviin par vesair, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer, shiva shevatim shechatu, meviim shiva farim, ushear shevatim shello chatu, meviin al yedehen par, sheaf ellu shello chatu, meviin al yede hachotim. rabbi shimon omer, shemona farim. uvaavoda zara, shemona farim ushemona seirim, par vesair lechol shevet vashevet, ufar vesair levet din. horu vet din shel echad min hashshevatim veasa oto hashshevet al pihem, oto hashshevet hu chayyav, ushear kol hashshevatim peturim, divre rabbi yehuda. vachachamim omrim, en chayyavim ella al horayat bet din haggadol bilvad, shenneemar (Vayikra 4) veim kol adat yisrael yishgu, velo adat oto hashshevet: 
Hora chohen mashiach leatzmo, shogeg veasa shogeg, mevi far. shogeg veasa mezid, mezid veasa shogeg, patur, shehoraat kohen mashiach leatzmo, chehoraat bet din latztzibbur: 
Hora vifne atzmo veasa vifne atzmo, mitkapper lo vifne atzmo. hora im hatztzibbur veasa im hatztzibbur, mitkapper lo im hatztzibbur, sheen bet din chayyavim ad sheyyoru levattel miktzat ulekayyem miktzat, vechen hammashiach. velo vaavoda zara, ad sheyyoru levattel miktzat ulekayyem miktzat: 
En chayyavin ella al helem davar im shiggat hammaase, vechen hammashiach. velo vaavoda zara, en chayyavin ella al helem davar im shiggat hammaase. en bet din chayyavin ad sheyyoru vedavar shezzedono charet veshiggato chattat. vechen hammashiach. velo vaavoda zara, ad sheyyoru al davar shezzedono charet veshiggato chattat:
Mishnah Niddah 2:2-5:
Nimtza al shello, temein vechayyavin karban. nimtza al shellah otyom, temein vechayyavin karban. nimtza al shellah leachar zeman, temeim missafek ufeturim min hakkarban: 
Ezehu achar zeman. kede shettered min hammitta vetadiach paneha. veachar kach, metammea meet leet veenah metammea et boalah. rabbi akiva omer, af metammea et boalah. umodim chachamim lerabbi akiva beroa chetem, shemmetammea et boalah: 
Kol hannashim bechezkat tohora levaalehen. habbain min hadderech, neshehen lahen bechezkat tohora. bet shammay omrim, tzericha shene iddim al kol tashmish vetashmish, o teshammesh leor hanner. bet hillel omrim, dayyah bishne iddim kol hallayla: 
Mashal mashlu chachamim baishsha, hacheder vehapperozdor vehaaliyya. dam hacheder, tame. nimtza vapperozdor, sefeko tame, lefi shechezkato min hammakor:
Mishnah Niddah 2:6-3:2:
Chamishsha damim temeim baishsha. haadom, vehashshachor, uchekeren karkom, uchememe adama, uchemazug. bet shammay omrim, af kememe tiltan uchememe vasar tzali. uvet hillel metaharin. hayyarok, akavya ven mahalalel metamme, vachachamim metaharim. amar rabbi meir, im eno metamme mishshum ketem, metamme mishshum mashke. rabbi yose omer, lo chach velo chach: 
Ezehu adom, kedam hammakka. shachor, kacheret. amok mikkan, tame. dehe mikkan, tahor. uchekeren karkom, kabbarur shebbo. uchememe adama, mibbikat bet kerem, umetzif mayim. uchemazug, shene chalakim mayim veechad yayin, min hayyayin hashsharoni: 
Hammappelet chaticha, im yesh immah dam, temea. veim lav, tehora. rabbi yehuda omer, ben kach uven kach, temea: 
Hammappelet kemin kelippa, kemin saara, kemin afar, kemin yavchushim adummim, tattil lammayim. im nimmochu, temea. veim lav, tehora. hammappelet kemin dagim, chagavim, shekatzim uremasim, im yesh immahem dam, temea. veim lav, tehora. hammappelet min behema, chayya vaof, ben temein ben tehorim, im zachar, teshev lezachar. veim nekeva, teshev linkeva. veim en yadua, teshev lezachar velinkeva, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, kol sheen bo mitztzurat adam, eno valad:
Mishnah Niddah 3:3-7:
Hammappelet shefir male mayim, male dam, male genunim, enah chosheshet levalad. veim haya merukkam, teshev lezachar velinkeva: 
Hammappelet sandal o shilya, teshev lezachar velinkeva. shilya babbayit, habbayit tame. lo shehashshilya valad, ella sheen shilya velo valad. rabbi shimon omer, nimmok havvalad ad shello yatza: 
Hammappelet tumtum, veanderoginos, teshev lezachar velinkeva. tumtum vezachar, anderoginos vezachar, teshev lezachar velinkeva. tumtum unekeva, anderoginos unekeva, teshev linkeva vilvad. yatza mechuttach o mesoras, mishsheyyatza rubbo, hare hu cheyalud. yatza chedarko, ad sheyyetze rov rosho. veezehu rov rosho, mishshettetze faddachto: 
Hammappelet veen yadua ma hu, teshev lezachar velinkeva. en yadua im valad haya im lav, teshev lezachar velinkeva ulenidda: 
Hammappelet leyom arbaim, enah chosheshet levalad. leyom arbaim veechad, teshev lezachar velinkeva ulenidda. rabbi yishmael omer, yom arbaim veechad, teshev lezachar ulenidda. yom shemonim veechad, teshev lezachar velinkeva ulenidda, shehazzachar nigmar learbaim veechad, vehannekeva lishmonim veechad. vachachamim omrim, echad beriyyat hazzachar veechad beriyyat hannekeva, ze vaze learbaim veechad:
Mishnah Niddah 4:1-4:
Benot kutim, niddot mearisatan. vehakkutim metammeim mishkav tachton kaelyon, mippene shehen boale niddot, vehen yoshvot al kol dam vadam. veen chayyavin aleha al biat mikdash, veen sorfin alehem et hatteruma, mippene shettumatan safek: 
Benot tzedokin, bizman shennahagu lalechet bedarche avotehen, hare hen kechutiyyot. pershu lalechet bedarche yisrael, hare hen keyisreelit. rabbi yose omer, leolam hen keyisrael, ad sheyyifreshu lalechet bedarche avotehen: 
Dam nachrit vedam tohora shel metzoraat, bet shammay metaharim. uvet hillel omrim, kerukkah uchememe ragleha. dam yoledet shello tavla, bet shammay omrim, kerukkah uchememe ragleha. uvet hillel omrim, metamme lach veyavesh. umodim beyoledet bezov, shehi metammea lach veyavesh: 
Hammaksha, nidda. kishsheta shelosha yamim betoch achad asar yom veshafta meet leet veyalda, hare zo yoledet bezov, divre rabbi eliezer. rabbi yehoshua omer, layla vayom, kelele shabbat veyomo. sheshshafta min hatztzaar, velo min haddam:
Mishnah Niddah 4:5-5:1:
Kamma hu kishshuyah. rabbi meir omer, afillu arbaim vachamishshim yom. rabbi yehuda omer, dayyah chadshah. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim, en kishshuy yoter mishshete shabbatot: 
Hammaksha vetoch shemonim shel nekeva, kol damim shehi roa, tehorim, ad sheyyetze havvalad. verabbi eliezer metamme. amru lo lerabbi eliezer, uma bimkom shehechmir bedam hashshofi, hekel bedam hakkoshi, mekom shehekel bedam hashshofi, eno din shennakel bedam hakkoshi. amar lahen, dayyo labba min haddin lihyot kanniddon, mimma hekel aleha, mittumat ziva, aval temea tumat nidda: 
Kol achad asar yom bechezkat tohora. yashva lah velo vadka, shagga, neensa, hezida velo vadka, tehora. higgia sheat vistah velo vadka, hare zo temea. rabbi meir omer, im hayta vemachave vehiggia sheat vistah, velo vadka, hare zo tehora, mippene shecharada mesalleket et haddamim. aval yeme hazzav vehazzava veshomeret yom keneged yom, hare ellu bechezkat tuma: 
Yotze dofen, en yoshvin alav yeme tuma vime tohora, veen chayyavin alav karban. rabbi shimon omer, hare ze cheyalud. kol hannashim mittammeot babbayit hachitzon, shenneemar (Vayikra 15:19), dam yihye zovah bivsarah. aval hazzav uvaal keri, enan mittammeim, ad shettetze tumatan lachutz:
Mishnah Niddah 5:2-5: Haya ochel batteruma vehirgish shennizdazeu evarav, ochez baamma uvolea et hatteruma. umetammeim bechol shehu, afillu cheen hachardal uvefachot mikkan:

Tinoket bat yom echad, mittammea venidda. bat asara yamim, mittammea veziva. tinok ben yom echad, mittamme veziva, umittamme vingaim, umittamme vitme met, vezokek leyibbum, ufoter min hayyibbum, umaachil batteruma, ufosel min hatteruma, venochel umanchil. vehahorgo, chayyav. vahare hu leaviv uleimmo ulechol kerovav kechatan shalem:

Bat shalosh shanim veyom echad, mitkaddeshet bevia. veim ba aleha yavam, kenaah. vechayyavin aleha mishshum eshet ish, umetammea et boalah letamme mishkav tachton kaelyon. nisset lechohen, tochal batteruma. ba aleha achad min happesulim, pesalah min hakkehunna. ba aleha achad mikkol haarayot haamurot battora, mumatin al yadah, vehi fetura. pachot mikkan, kenoten etzba baayin:

Ben tesha shanim veyom echad shebba al yevimto, kenaah. veeno noten get ad sheyyagdil. umittamme venidda, letamme mishkav tachton kaelyon. ufosel veeno maachil batteruma. ufosel et habbehema meal gabbe hammizbeach, veniskelet al yado. veim ba al achat mikkol haarayot haamurot battora, mumatim al yado, vehu fatur:
Mishnah Rosh Hashanah 1:1-3:
Arbaa rashe shanim hem. beechad benisan rosh hashshana lammelachim velargalim. beechad beelul rosh hashshana lemasar behema. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim, beechad betishre. beechad betishre rosh hashshana lashshanim velashshemittin velayyovlot, lannetia velayrakot. beechad bishvat, rosh hashshana lailan, kedivre vet shammay. bet hillel omrim, bachamishsha asar bo: 
Bearbaa ferakim haolam niddon, befesach al hattevua, baatzeret al perot hailan, berosh hashshana kol bae haolam ovrin lefanav kivne maron, shenneemar (tehillim log) hayyotzer yachad libbam, hammevin el kol maasehem. uvechag niddonin al hammayim: 
Al shishsha chodashim hashsheluchin yotzin, al nisan mippene happesach, al av mippene hattaanit, al elul mippene rosh hashshana, al tishre mippene takkanat hammoadot, al kislev mippene chanukka, veal adar mippene happurim. ucheshehaya vet hammikdash kayyam, yotzin af al iyyar mippene fesach katan:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 1:1-3: Mitzvat ase min hattora levarech achar achilat mazon shenneemar <small>(Devarim 8 10)</small> "veachalta vesavata uverachta et Adonai elohecha". veeno chayyav min hattora ella im ken sava shenneemar veachalta vesavata uverachta. umiddivre sofrim achal afillu kezayit mevarech acharav:

Umiddivre sofrim levarech al kol maachol techilla veachar kach yehane mimmennu. vaafillu nitkavven leechol o lishtot kol shehu mevarech veachar kach yehane. vechen im heriach reach tov mevarech veachar kach yehane mimmennu. vechol hannehene belo beracha maal. vechen middivre sofrim levarech achar kol ma sheyyochal vechol ma sheyyishte. vehu sheyyishte reviit vehu sheyyochal kezayit. umatemet enah tzericha beracha lo lefaneha velo leachareha ad reviit:

Ucheshem shemmevarchin al hahanaya kach mevarchin al kol mitzva umitzva veachar kach yaase otah. uverachot rabbot tikkenu chachamim derech shevach vehodaya vederech bakkasha kede lizkor et habbore tamid af al pi shello nehena velo asa mitzva:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 1:10-11: Kol habberachot kullan af al pi shebberech veyatza yede chovato muttar lo levarech laacherim shello yatzu yede chovatan kede lehotzian. chutz mibbirkat hahanaya sheen bah mitzva sheeno mevarech laacherim ella im ken nehena immahen. aval birkat hahanaya sheyyesh bah mitzva kegon achilat matztza belele happesachim vekiddush hayyom hare ze mevarech laacherim veochlin veshotim af al pi sheeno ochel immahen:

Kol hashshomea beracha min habberachot mittechillatah vead sofah venitkavven latzet bah yede chovato yatza veaf al pi shello ana amen. vechol haone amen achar hamevarech hare ze kimvarech vehu sheyyihye hamevarech chayyav beotah beracha. haya hamevarech chayyav middivre sofrim vehaone chayyav min hattora lo yatza yede chovato ad sheyyaane o ad sheyyishma mimmi shehu chayyav bah min hattora kamohu:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 1:12-13: Rabbim shennitvaadu leechol pat o lishtot yayin uverech echad mehen veanu kullam amen hare ellu muttarin leechol velishtot. aval im lo nitkavvenu leechol keechad ella ze ba meatzmo veze ba meatzmo af al pi shehen ochlin mikkikkar echad kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. bamme devarim amurim befat veyayin bilvad aval shear ochalim umashkin enan tzerichin hassibba ella im berech echad mehen veanu kullan amen hare ellu ochlim veshotin. veaf al pi shello nitkavvenu lehasev keechad:

Kol hashshomea echad miyyisrael mevarech beracha mikkol habberachot kullan af al pi shello shama habberacha kullah mittechillatah vead sofah veaf al pi sheeno chayyav beotah beracha chayyav laanot amen. veim haya hamevarech goy o eppikoros o kuti o tinok hammitlammed o shehaya gadol veshinna mimmatbea habberacha en onin acharehen amen:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 1:4-6: Nimtzeu kol habberachot kullan shelosha minim. birchot hanaya. uvirchot mitzvot. uvirchot hodaa shehen derech shevach vehodaya uvakkasha kede lizkor et habbore tamid uleyira mimmennu:

Venosach kol habberachot ezra uvet dino tikkenum. veen rauy leshannotam velo lehosif al achat mehem velo ligroa mimmenna. vechol hameshanne mimmatbea shettavu chachamim babberachot eno ella toe. vechol beracha sheen bah hazekarat hashshem umalchut enah beracha ella im ken hayta semucha lachavertah:
Vechol habberachot kullan neemarin bechol lashon vehu sheyyomar keen shettikkenu chachamim. veim shinna et hammatbea hoil vehizkir azkara umalchut veinyan habberacha afillu bilshon chol yatza:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 1:7-9: Kol habberachot kullan tzarich sheyyashmia leazno ma shehu omer veim lo hishmia leazno yatza ben shehotzi bisfatav ben shebberech belibbo:

Kol habberachot kullan lo yafsik ben habberacha uven haddavar shemmevarchin alav bidvarim acherim veim hifsik tzarich lachazor ulevarech sheniyya. veim hifsik bidvarim shehen meinyan devarim shemmevarchin alav eno tzarich levarech sheniyya. ketzad. kegon shebberech al happat vekodem sheyyochal amar haviu melach haviu tavshil tenu lifloni leechol tenu maachol labbehema vechayyotze baellu eno tzarich levarech shenit. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kol habberachot kullam muttar letame levarech otan. ben shehaya tame tuma shehu yachol laalot mimmenna bo bayyom. ben tuma sheeno yachol laalot mimmenna bo bayyom. veasur lamvarech levarech keshehu arom ad sheyyechasse ervato. bamme devarim amurim beish aval beishsha yoshevet ufaneha tuchot bakkarka umevarechet:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 10:3-5:
Kosheret ishsha mifteche hechaluk af al pi sheyyesh lo shene petachim, vechute sevacha af al pi shehu rafuy beroshah, uretzuot minal vesandal shekkoshrin otan al haregel bishat malbush, venodot yayin veshemen af al pi sheyyesh lo shete aznayim, ukedera shel basar af al pi sheyyechola lehotzi habbasar velo tattir hakkesher. vekoshrin deli bimshicha o beavnet vechayyotze bo aval lo bechevel. vekoshrin lifne habbehema o beraglah bishvil shello tetze af al pi sheyyesh lah shene issarot. vechevel shehaya kashur bappara koshro baevus. haya kashur baevus koshro bappara. aval lo yavi chevel mittoch beto veyikshor bappara uvaevus. veim haya chevel gardi shemmuttar letaltelo hare ze mevi vekosher bappara uvaevus. mippene shekkol ellu hakkesharim maase hedyot hen veenan shel kayyama ella paam kosher ufaam mattir ulefichach muttar likshor otan lechattechilla. chotalot shel temarim veshel gerogarot mattir umafkia vechotech venotel veochel: 
Kol sherauy lemaachal behema muttar likshor oto beshabbat. lefichach im nifseka retzuat sandalo becharmelit notel gemi lach harauy lemaachal behema vechorech alav vekosher haggemi. nishmeta lo retzuat minal vesandal o shennishmat rov haregel muttar lehachazir hartzuot limkoman uvilvad shello yikshor: 
Haaniva mutteret lefi sheenah mitchallefet bikshira. lefichach hachevel shennifsak mekabbetz shene ketzotav vechorech alav meshicha veonev aniva:
Niddah 24b:18-25a:1: Tanya, abba shaul omer, veittema rabbi yochanan: kover metim hayiti. paam achat ratzti achar tzevi, venichnasti bekulit shel met, veratzti acharav shalosh parsaot, utzevi lo higgati, vekulit lo kalta. keshechazarti laachoray, amru li: shel og melech habbashan hayta.
Tanya, abba shaul omer: kover metim hayiti. paam achat niftecha meara tachtay, veamadti begalgal eno shel met ad chotmi. keshechazarti laachoray, amru: ayin shel avshalom hayta.

Veshemma tomar: abba shaul nannas hava — abba shaul aroch bedoro hava verabbi tarfon maggia lichtefo, verabbi tarfon aroch bedoro hava verabbi meir maggia lichtefo, rabbi meir aroch bedoro hava verabbi maggia lichtefo, rabbi aroch bedoro hava

Verabbi chiyyay maggia lichtefo, verabbi chiyyay aroch bedoro hava verav maggia lichtefo, rav aroch bedoro hava verav yehuda maggia lichtefo, verav yehuda aroch bedoro hava veadda dayyayla maggia lichtefo,
Perashtevina defumebdita kae leh leadda dayyayla ad palgeh, vechulle alma kae lifrashtevina defumebdita ad chartzeh.
Pirkei Avot 5:17-21: Kol machaloket shehi leshem shamayim, sofah lehitkayyem. vesheenah leshem shamayim, en sofah lehitkayyem. ezo hi machaloket shehi leshem shamayim, zo machaloket hillel veshammay. vesheenah leshem shamayim, zo machaloket korach vechol adato:

Kol hamezakke et harabbim, en chet ba al yado. vechol hammachati et harabbim, en maspikin beyado laasot teshuva. moshe zacha vezikka et harabbim, zechut harabbim taluy bo, shenneemar (Devarim log) tzidkat Adonai asa umishpatav im yisrael. yaravam chata vehecheti et harabbim, chet harabbim taluy bo, shenneemar (Melachim 1 15) al chattovt yaravam (ben nevat) asher chata vaasher hecheti et yisrael:

Kol mi sheyyesh beyado shelosha devarim hallalu, mittalmidav shel avraham avinu. ushelosha devarim acherim, mittalmidav shel bilam harasha. ayin tova, veruach nemucha, venefesh shefala, mittalmidav shel avraham avinu. ayin raa, veruach gevoha, venefesh rechava, mittalmidav shel bilam harasha. ma ben talmidav shel avraham avinu letalmidav shel bilam harasha. talmidav shel avraham avinu, ochlin baolam hazze venochalin baolam habba, shenneemar (Mishlei 8) lehanechil ohavay yesh, veotzrotehem amalle. aval talmidav shel bilam harasha yorshin gehinnom veyordin liver shachat, shenneemar (tehillim noah) veatta elohim toridem liver shachat, anshe damim umirma lo yechetzu yemehem, vaani evtach bach:

Yehuda ven tema omer, heve az kannamer, vekal kannesher, veratz katztzevi, vegibbor kaari, laasot retzon avicha shebbashshamayim. hu haya omer, az panim legehinnom, uvoshet panim legan eden. yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohenu shettivne ircha bimhera veyamenu veten chelkenu vetoratecha:

Hu haya omer, ben chamesh shanim lammikra, ben eser lammishna, ben shelosh esre lammitzvot, ben chamesh esre lattalmud, ben shemone esre lachuppa, ben esrim lirdof, ben sheloshim lakkoach, ben arbaim labbina, ben chamishshim laetza, ben shishshim lazzikna, ben shivim lasseva, ben shemonim laggevura, ben tishim lashuach, ben mea keillu met veavar uvatel min haolam:
Pirkei Avot 5:22-6:2: Ben bag bag omer, hafoch bah vahafoch bah, decholla vah. uvah techeze, vesiv uvele vah, uminna lo tazua, sheen lecha midda tova hemenna:
Ben he he omer, lefum tzaara agra:

Shanu chachamim bilshon hammishna, baruch shebbachar bahem uvemishnatam:
rabbi meir omer kol haosek battora lishmah, zoche lidvarim harebe. velo od ella shekkol haolam kullo cheday hu lo. nikra rea, ahuv, ohev et hammakom, ohev et habberiyyot, mesammeach et hammakom, mesammeach et habberiyyot. umalbashto anava veyira, umachsharto lihyot tzaddik vechasid veyashar veneeman, umerachakto min hachet, umekaravto lide zechut, venehenin mimmennu etza vetushiyya bina ugevura, shenneemar (Mishlei 8) li etza vetushiyya ani vina li gevura. venotenet lo malchut umemshala vechikkur din, umegallin lo raze tora, venaase chemayan hammitgabber uchenahar sheeno fosek, veheve tzanua veerech ruach, umochel al elbono, umegaddalto umeromamto al kol hammaasim:

Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi, bechol yom vayom bat kol yotzet mehar chorev umachrezet veomeret, oy lahem labberiyyot meelbonah shel tora. shekkol mi sheeno osek battora nikra nazuf, shenneemar (Mishlei 11) nezem zahav beaf chazir ishsha yafa vesarat taam. veomer (Shemot 32) vehalluchot maase elohim hemma vehammichtav michtav elohim hu charut al halluchot, al tikra charut ella cherut, sheen lecha ven chorin ella mi sheosek betalmud tora. vechol mi sheosek betalmud tora hare ze mitalle, shenneemar (Bamidbar 21) umimmattana nachaliel uminnachaliel bamot:
Pirkei Avot 6:3-6: Hallomed mechavero perek echad o halacha achat o fasuk echad o dibbur echad o afillu ot achat, tzarich linhog bo chavod, shekken matzinu vedavid melech yisrael, shello lamad meachitofel ella shene devarim bilvad, kerao rabbo allufo umeyuddao, shenneemar (tehillim noah) veatta enosh keerki allufi umeyuddai. vahalo devarim kal vachomer, uma david melech yisrael, shello lamad meachitofel ella shene devarim bilvad kerao rabbo allufo umeyuddao, hallomed mechavero perek echad o halacha achat o fasuk echad o dibbur echad o afillu ot achat, al achat kamma vechamma shetztzarich linhog bo chavod. veen kavod ella tora, shenneemar (Mishlei 3) kavod chachamim yinchalu, (Mishlei 28) utemimim yinchalu tov, veen tov ella tora, shenneemar (Mishlei 4) ki lekach tov natatti lachem torati al taazovu:

Kach hi darkah shel tora, pat bemelach tochal, umayim bimsura tishte, veal haaretz tishan, vechayye tzaar tichye, uvattora atta amel, im atta ose chen, (tehillim 128) ashrecha vetov lach. ashrecha baolam hazze vetov lach laolam habba:

Al tevakkesh gedulla leatzmecha, veal tachmod kavod, yoter millimmudecha ase, veal titavve leshulchanam shel melachim, sheshshulchancha gadol mishshulchanam, vechitrecha gadol mikkitram, veneeman hu baal melachtecha sheyyeshallem lecha sechar peullatecha:

Gedola tora yoter min hakkehunna umin hammalchut, shehammalchut niknet bishloshim maalot, vehakkehunna beesrim vearba, vehattora niknet bearbaim ushemona devarim. veelu hen, betalmud, bishmiat haozen, baarichat sefatayim, bevinat hallev, besichlut hallev, beema, beyira, baanava, besimcha, betohora, beshimmush chachamim, bedikduk chaverim, uvefilpul hattalmidim, beyishshuv, bammikra, bammishna, bemiut sechora, bemiut derech eretz, bemiut taanug, bemiut shena, bemiut sicha, bemiut sechok, beerech appayim, belev tov, beemunat chachamim, uvekabbalat hayyissurin, hammakkir et mekomo, vehassameach bechelko, vehaose seyag lidvarav, veeno machazik tova leatzmo, ahuv, ohev et hammakom, ohev et habberiyyot, ohev et hatztzedakot, ohev et hammesharim, ohev et hattochachot, mitrachek min hakkavod, velo megis libbo vetalmudo, veeno sameach behoraa, nose veol im chavero, machrio lechaf zechut, maamido al haemet, umaamido al hashshalom, mityashshev libbo vetalmudo, shoel umeshiv, shomea umosif, hallomed al menat lelammed vehallomed al menat laasot, hammachkim et rabbo, vehamechavven et shemuato, vehaomer davar beshem omro, ha lamadta shekkol haomer davar beshem omro mevi geulla laolam, shenneemar (Ester b) vattomer ester lammelech beshem mardochay:
Pirkei Avot 6:7-11: Gedola tora shehi notenet chayyim leoseha baolam hazze uvaolam habba, shenneemar (Mishlei 4) ki chayyim hem lemotzehem ulechol besaro marpe. veomer (sham 3) rifut tehi lesharecha veshikkuy leatzmotecha. veomer (sham 3) etz chayyim hi lammachazikim bah vetomcheha meushshar. veomer (sham 1) ki livyat chen hem leroshecha vaanakim legargerotecha. veomer (sham 4) titten leroshcha livyat chen ateret tiferet temaggenekka. veomer (sham 9) ki vi yirbu yamecha veyosifu lecha shenot chayyim. veomer (sham 3) orech yamim biminah bismovlah osher vechavod. veomer (sham) ki orech yamim ushenot chayyim veshalom yosifu lach. veomer (sham) deracheha darche noam vechol netivoteha shalom:

Rabbi shimon ben yehuda mishshum rabbi shimon ben yochay omer, hannoy vehakkoach vehaosher vehakkavod vehachachma vehazzikna vehasseva vehabbanim, nae latztzaddikim venae laolam, shenneemar (sham 16) ateret tiferet seva bederech tzedaka timmatze. veomer (sham 20) tiferet bachurim kocham vahadar zekenim seva. veomer (sham 14) ateret chachamim ashram. veomer (sham 17) ateret zekenim bene vanim vetiferet banim avotam. veomer (yeshaya kad) vechafra hallevana uvosha hachamma, ki malach Adonai tzevaot behar tziyyon uvirushalayim veneged zekenav kavod. rabbi shimon ben menasya omer, ellu sheva middot shemmanu chachamim latztzaddikim, kullam nitkayyemu verabbi uvevanav:

Amar rabbi yose ven kisma, paam achat hayiti mehallech badderech ufaga bi adam echad, venatan li shalom, vehechezarti lo shalom. amar li, rabbi, meeze makom atta. amarti lo, meir gedola shel chachamim veshel sofrim ani. amar li, rabbi, retzoncha shettadur immanu vimkomenu, vaani etten lecha elef alafim dinre zahav vaavanim tovot umargaliyyot. amarti lo, beni, im atta noten li chol kesef vezahav vaavanim tovot umargaliyyot shebbaolam, eni dar ella vimkom tora. velo od, ella shebbishat petirato shel adam en melavvin lo laadam lo chesef velo zahav velo avanim tovot umargaliyyot, ella tora umaasim tovim bilvad, shenneemar (Mishlei 6) behithallechcha tanche otach, beshachbecha tishmor alecha, vahakitzota hi tesichecha. behithallechcha tanche otach, baolam hazze, beshachbecha tishmor alecha, bakkever, vahakitzota hi tesichecha, laolam habba. vechen katuv besefer tehillim al yede david melech yisrael (tehillim kayit), tov li torat picha mealfe zahav vachasef. veomer (chaggay b) li hakkesef veli hazzahav amar Adonai tzevaot:

Chamishsha kinyanim kana lo hakkadosh baruch hu veolamo, veellu hen, tora kinyan echad, shamayim vaaretz kinyan echad, avraham kinyan echad, yisrael kinyan echad, bet hammikdash kinyan echad. tora minnayin, dichtiv (Mishlei 8), Adonai kanani reshit darko kedem mifalav meaz. shamayim vaaretz kinyan echad minnayin, dichtiv (yeshaya 66), ko amar Adonai hashshamayim kisi vehaaretz hadom raglay e ze vayit asher tivnu li vee ze makom menuchati, veomer (tehillim 104) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai kullam bechachma asita mala haaretz kinyanecha. avraham kinyan echad minnayin, dichtiv (Bereshit 14), vayvarchehu vayyomar baruch avram leel elyon kone shamayim vaaretz. yisrael kinyan echad minnayin, dichtiv (Shemot 15), ad yaavor ammecha Adonai ad yaavor am zo kanita, veomer (tehillim 16) likdoshim asher baaretz hemma veaddire kol cheftzi vam. bet hammikdash kinyan echad minnayin, dichtiv (Shemot 15), machon leshivtecha paalta Adonai mikkedash Adonai konnu yadecha. veomer (tehillim 78) vayviem el gevul kadsho har ze kanta yemino:

Kol ma shebbara hakkadosh baruch hu beolamo, lo verao ella lichvodo, shenneemar (yeshaya mag), kol hannikra vishmi velichvodi berativ yetzartiv af asitiv, veomer (Shemot 15), Adonai yimloch leolam vaed.

Shevuot 15b:8-16a:1: Uveshir. tanu rabbanan: shir shel toda – bechinnorot uvinvalim uvetzeltzelim al kol pinna ufinna veal kol even gedola shebbirushalayim, veomer "aromimcha Adonai ki dillitani vegomer", veshir shel pegaim, veyesh omrin shir shel negaim.
Man deamar dingaim – dichtiv: "venega lo yikrav beoholecha", uman deamar pegaim – dichtiv: "yippol mitztziddecha elef".

Veomer: "yoshev beseter elyon betzel shadday yitlonan" ad "ki atta Adonai machsi elyon samta meonecha"; vechozer veomer: "mizmor ledavid bevorcho mippene avshalom beno, Adonai ma rabbu tzaray", ad "laAdonai hayeshua al ammecha virchatecha sela".
Rabbi yehoshua ben levi amar lehu lehane kerae, vegane. hechi aved hachi? vehaamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: asur lehitrappeot bedivre tora! lehagen shane.

Veella ki amar asur – deikka makka? i deikka makka asur, vetu la?! vehatnan: hallochesh al hammakka, en lo chelek laolam habba! ha ittemar ala, amar rabbi yochanan: berokek shanu; lefi sheen mazkirin shem shamayim al harkika.

Bet din mehallechin ushete todot acharehen vechulei. lememra devet din kamme toda azli?! vehachtiv: "vayyelech acharehem hoshaya vachatzi sare yehuda"! hachi kaamar: bet din mehallechin, ushete todot mehallechot uvet din acharehem.

Ketzad mehallechot? rabbi chiyyay verabbi shimon berabbi; chad amar: zo keneged zo, vechad amar: zo achar zo. man deamar zo keneged zo, "happenimit" – hach dimkarva lachoma. man deamar zo achar zo, "happenimit" – hach dimkarva levet din.

Tenan: happenimit neechelet vehachitzona nisrefet. bishlama leman deamar zo achar zo, ammetu lehachi penimit neechelet – mishshum deatya chitzona kamma, vekaddeshah la. ella leman deamar zo keneged zo, tarvayyhu bahade hadade ka meykaddeshi!
Velitamaych, leman deamar zo achar zo, chada mi meykaddesha?! ha "kol shello naaset bechol ellu" tenan! vaafillu leman deamar "beachat mikkol ellu", hane tarvayyhu chada mitzva hi!
Al pi navi neechelet veal pi navi nisrefet.
Sotah 25a:12-21: Ibbaya lehu: baal shemmachal al kinnuyo — kinnuyo machul, o eno machul? mi amrinan bekinnuy devaal tela rachamana, uvaal ha machel leh lekinnuyo, o dilma: kevan dekanni lay meikkara — la matze machel leh?

Ta shema, veellu shebbet din mekannin lahen: mi shennitcharesh balah, o nishtatta, o shehaya chavush bevet haasurin. vei amrat baal shemmachal al kinnuyo — kinnuyo machul, avdinan midde deate baal machel leh? setama demilleta, adam maskim al daat bet din.
Ta shema: umosrin lo shene talmide chachamim, shemma yavo aleha badderech. vei amrat baal shemmachal al kinnuyo — kinnuyo machul, lachleh lekinnuye velivol!
May shena talmide chachamim — digmiri, dei bae lemival, amri leh: achaleh lekinnuyaych uvala.

Ta shema, deamar rabbi yoshiyya: shelosha devarim sach li zeera meanshe yerushalayim: baal shemmachal al kinnuyo — kinnuyo machul, vezaken mamre sheratzu bet din limchol lo — mochalin lo, uven sorer umore sheratzu aviv veimmo limchol lo — mochalin lo.
Ucheshebbati etzel chaveray shebbaddarom, al shenayim hodu li, veal zaken mamre lo hodu li — shello yirbu machalokot beyisrael. shema minna: baal shemmachal al kinnuyo — kinnuyo machul. shema minna.
Peligi ba rav acha veravina. chad amar: kodem setira — machul, leachar setira — eno machul. vechad amar: leachar setira, name machul. umistabbera keman deamar eno machul,
Mimmay — middeka mehadderi rabbanan lerabbi yose. detanya, rabbi yose omer: balah neeman aleha, mikkal vachomer: uma nidda shehi becharet — balah neeman aleha, sota shehi belav, lo — kol shekken?
Amru lo: lo, im amarta benidda — shekken yesh lah hetter, tomar besota — sheen lah hetter.
Vei amrat leachar setira machul lah, mashkachat la deyesh lah hetter, dei bae machel leh lekinnuye uvael. ella shema minna: leachar setira eno machul. shema minna.
Zohar, Eikev 4: Vaasara devarim tzarich adam lemebad bisudata. chad, nettilat yadayim. tinyayna letakkena shete kikkarot leshabbat. telitaa, lemechal telat seudatin, uleosafa mechol al hakkodesh. reviaa, leanhara patora bishraga. kema deukemuha, shulchan batztzafon, umenora badarom. vetzarich hasebba, kema deokmuha hesebbu echad mevarech lechullam.

Uveshabbat, bechol milloy, tzarich leittosfa mechol al hakkodesh, ben bemaachalav, umishtav, ben bilvushoy, ben bahasebbateh. detzarich letakkena leh mesibbah shappira, bechamma karim uchesatot merukkeman, mikkol deit beveteh, keman detakkin chuppa lechalla. deshabbeta ihi malketa, veihi kalla. uvegin da havo nafke mare matnitin erev shabbat leakdemuti learcha, vahavu amre boi kalla boi kalla. utzerichin leatteara shira vechedva lefatora legabbah.

Velo od, ella deit raza ochora. kegavvna detzarich lekabbela gevirtah, bechamma nehorin dishraggin beshabbat, uvechamma innugin, ulevushin shappirin, uveta metukkena, bechamma mane detikkuna, bahasebbah yafa lechol chad vechad. uvehay chedva vetikkuna, garmin deishtearat shifcha bisha vachashocha, beraavon, bevichya, behesped. bilvushin uchamin kearmalta. dei melea zo, chareva zo.

Yetzer tov, matronita kaddisha. malchut hakkodesh denachta beshabbat. kelila meeser sefiran. meattera besheva shemahan sheenan nimchakin. bechamma markevot dechevavn. uvechamma chayyaylin umashreyayn. umalka nafik lokovla bechamma mashiryayn. veishtaarat yetzer hara shifcha bisha bachashocha, kearmalta belo balah bela merkavot.

Veillen deittemar alayyhu, lamzabbechin velamkatrin limlechet hashshamayim velamazzalot asher lo tzivviti, hu pulechana deshifcha bisha, deshalte bearve shabbatot vearve lele reviiyyot. ma havo illen avdin. havo natlin levushin uchamin, vechashchan nehorin, veavdin hespeda belele shabbatot kede leishtattefa bahadah kema deihi sharya, ki (Kohelet 7:14) gam ze leummat ze asa haelohim.

Batar dechavu yisrael, veitcharav be makdesha, ittemar bishchinta imma kaddisha, (Eicha 1:1) echa yashva vadad hair rabbati am hayta kealmana, umechabbin belel tisha beav nehorin usheragin, veavdin hesped, veyatvin kaavelim leishtattefa bedochaka dishchinta. begin deinnun garmu lah kol hahu teviru.

Chamishaa, kos devaychullu. shetitaa, lemeheve al patora mille deorayyta. sheviaa, learchaa al patora, begin daaniyyim yetun al patoreh. teminaa, netilat yadayim bemayim acharonim. teshiaa, birkat hammazon. ashiraa, kos divracha. vetzarich leachzera alayyhu, uletakkena lon beraza kaddisha, deihi kelula meeser sefiran, veihu patora dekudesha berich hu, missitra digvura. uvegin kach okmuha rabbanan, shulchan batztzafon.

Chad (ayyen leel bareaya mehemana parashat pinchas 245 amud alef. kivvavnta 10 Devarim shel shulechan shabbat) netilat yadayim, dehachi okmuha rabbanan dematnitin, yadayim mezuhamot pesulot labberacha, begin deinnun sheniot lattumea, deihu av hattumea. deihu rishon kad innun mesuavot, vechad innun tehorot innun sheniot labberacha. divracha la sharya ella al tahara. kahana deihu ish tahor, ish chesed, sharya aleh birchata. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 133:2) kashshemen hattov al harosh vegomer. uvegin da, (Bamidbar 6:23) dabber el aharon veel banav lemor ko tevarachu et bene yisrael vegomer. veokmuha, kol kohen hammevarech, mitbarech. vesheeno mevarech, en mitbarech. veokmuha mare matnitin, kol beracha sheen bah azkara umalchut lav shemeh beracha. malchut adonay.

Veod, netilat yadayim tzarich litol lon ad pirka, degazru aleh 14 pirkin, behahu shaata sharya yad Adonai aleh, veihi yad divracha missitra dechesed deveh chachma beyad yemineh. veihi yad dikdushsha, missitra digvura, vesharyay bedina. (nusach acher vida dismala) veihi yad deyichuda, missitra detiferet, desharya beyd pirkin degufa, deinnun shenem asar pirkin bitren deroin, uteren shokin. uteren begufa uverit.

Utelat zimnin 14, ihu 42, 30, min 14 14, 14, ramuz yevarechcha yaer yissa, min 26 26 26. 4 4 4 mid 14 14, innun remizin baadonay adonay adonay. veamar hannavi alayyhu, (Yirmeyahu 7:4) hechal Adonai hechal Adonai hechal Adonai hemma. vehay netila beyad deittatkenat.

Vechol setar mig anpe chevan, deinnun Adonai Adonai Adonai. umittelat gadpe chevan, deinnun 4 4 4, kullehu tzarich lemeheve mikkoach adam. veihu yod hei vav hei. koach dileh, yod vav dalet, hei alef, vav alef vav, hei alef. umatronita la sharya bechoach dileh, befirkin deetzbean, ad deitavar minnayyhu zuhama, shifcha bisha pesula, intu defasul. uvegin da okmuha mare matnitin, yadayim mezuhamot pesulot labberacha.

Veinnun mayim ledakkea yad, desharyay tamman yad Adonai. yad Adonai, da mayim deorayyta. deamme haaretz innun sheretz, ma moil lon tevila, vehashsheretz shifcha bisha bidehon, begezel devidehon. begezel devirkan degazlin lekudesha berich hu, dela yade levarcha, vela yade may ihi beracha, umay ihi zuhama.

Miyyad kesheshshamu millin illen chavrayyay vaana immehon, la yachilna lemisbal deyashlim asra millin divracha, veishtetachna legabbeh. uvevadday let bar nash deyema millin illen, ella ant. deant hu kegavvna ded mechitzot degan eden. debar nash al behon (nusach acher dechad ant) bimchitztzat yenukin, veitavid tinok. uvimchitzat nearim, veitavid naar. uvimchitzat bachurim, veitavid bachur. uvimchitzat zekenim, veitavid zaken. ubbegin kach ittemar alach, (Tehillim 33:14) 'mimchon 'shivto 'hishgiach el kol yoshve haaretz. veant hu deittemar alach, (Bereshit 6:3) beshaggam hu basar, bedara dedor hafelaga havet. uvechol dara vedara begilgula. kegalgal demithappech lechamma gavvnin. vela niglet, ella bedara deityeyhiv beh orayyta al yadach.

Miyyad deitkenishat mealma, ant hu keshimsha denahir bechol dara vedara, dechad itkenash shimsha belelya, nahir besihara, uveshittin ribbo kochavaya. hachi at (ant), deant nahir beshittin ribbo bechol dara vedara. vehay ihu deka ramaz kohelet, (Kohelet 1:4) dor holech vedor ba. veokmuha rabbanan, en dor pachut mishshishim ribbo. veod ukemuha, haddor sheholech hu shebba, lekayyem (sham) ma shehaya hu sheyyihye. mikkan veelach, ashlim asra devarim defatora beitgalyay. amar raya mehemana, butzina kaddisha zakkaa chulakach, dekudesha berich hu galle lach, ma dela galle lechol navi vechoze, vela leman uleman.

Tinyayna, lemivtza al shene kikkarot beshabbat, deinnun remizin bitre luche orayyta, deityeyhivu beshabbat zugot. divyoma telitaa nachtu, deveh tere zimne tov, uveshabbat ityeyhivat, teren nukevin litren tavin. veaf al gav deokmuha deshedim memunin al zugot, kema deokmuha shene betzim, shene egozim. halacha lemoshe missinay sheluche mitzva enan nizokin.

Vei tema, veha tanenan, en matchilin bashsheni, veen mesayyeymin bed, dehayynu bev 4 im erev rav, dela havo sheluche mitzva, dela itgayyeyru leshem shamayim, ulevatar deitabbaru mealma, manne kudesha berich hu lenatla (Shemot 34:1) shene luchot avanim karishonim, veamar, (sham) vechatavti al halluchot et haddevarim asher hayu al halluchot vegomer.

Uteren kikkarot beshabbat, remizin litren yodin yeahdonahi. daadonay ihi yechida mibbalah beshit yomin dechol, uveshabbat nachit legabbah. uvegin da beshabbat, kol nishmatin veruchin venafshin nafkin venachtin zugot, veen satan veen mazzik shallit beyoma deshabbeta. vaafillu gehinnam la shallit, vela okid beshabbat. uvegin da, (Shemot 35:3) lo tevaaru esh bechol moshvotechem beyom hashshabbat. veda esh nucheraa, ella esh dekarbena, esh dikdushsha. velet learchaa bivtzia dilhon, deha ittemar leella.

Telitaa lemechal shelosha seudatin beshabbat, kema deokmuha rabbanan dematnitin, deamar chad minayyhu, yehe chelki im gomre shalosh seudot beshabbat, deinnun shelimu dishva birchan ditzlota, leashlema behon leeser. veraza deoneg, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden lehashekot et haggan. uman dela mekayyem lon, veit leh reshu lekayyeyman, ithappach leh lenega tzaraat. uvegin dela yete lehay, amar kudesha berich hu, leuu alay vaani porea, (Yeshayahu 58:14) az titannag al Adonai.

Reviaa, leanhara patora bimnarta. kema deokmuha kadmain, shulchan batztzafon, menora badarom, defatora dekudesha berich hu hachi tzericha lemehve. chamishaa, kos devaychullu. kos, becheshovon elohim. vaychullu amud bet, dechalil lon kalla kaddisha, dehay kos malle yena deorayyta, tzarich leashada al ovada divreshit.

Shetitaa, lemeheve al patora divre tora, dehachi okmuha mare matnitin, 3 sheachlu al shulchan echad vela amru alav divre tora vechulei. veraza demilla, begin deha okmuha shulchan batztzafon, veorayyta ityeyhivat mimina. lechabbera yemina deihu rachame, bismala deihu dina. deorayyta ihi Adonai mimina, patora adonay missemala, vetzarich lechabbera lon. divgin defatora missemala, okmuha rabbanan dematnitin, kashin mezonotav shel adam kikriat yam sof. uvegin kach, tzarich talmid chacham lezammena immeh, leman deyishtedal befitgame orayyta.

Sheviaa, learchaa al patora, begin aniyyim. uvegin da, kol hammaarich al shulchano maarichin lo yamav ushenotav. ubbegin kach (Mishlei 10:2) utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet. deani chashuv kammet, veihu mechayye leh, uf hachi kudesha berich hu mechayye leh.

Veod beorach raza, dechullehu aniyyim missitra deat 4, deittemar bah (Tehillim 116:6) dalloti veli yehoshia. veot 4 deechad, detzarich learchaa bah, hada hu dichtiv lehaarich yamim al mamlachto, uvegin da, tzarich learchaa al patora, deihi 4, kelila med raglin defatora. begin yekara deat dalet, tzarich learchaa al patora, begin aniyyim.

Uvegineh okmuha rabbanan, devikkesh kudesha berich hu midda yafa leyisrael, vela ashkach kemidda dedallut. veakshu alah, begin deokmuha kadmae, kechushevan mine mitot deinnun kechushevan totzaot, vechesron kis kashe mikkulan, veech amrin innun, dela ashkach leyisrael midda yafa kaaniyyuta.

Ella, begin (dechol amma velishana), deoved kochavim umazzalot (Yeshayahu 8:21) vehaya ki yirav vehitkatztzaf vekillel bemalko uvelohav ufana lemala. aval yisrael, innun kayyayma dekudesha berich hu behay midda, vela achchishin beh. uvegin da, bemmidda da yitparkun. hada hu dichtiv, (Shmuel b 22:28) veet am ani toshia. veani lishana deinnuy, deafillu it leh lebar nash utera, veihu bemarin uvemachteshin, ani itkere, o dedachakin leh begineh, vetzarin leh kol yoma. kol shekken man deihu rash minneh, veihu holech meatar laatar.

Veod it ani, deistellak minneh dateh, kegon iyyov. deittemar beh, (iyyov 34:35) iyyov lo vedaat yedabber. uf hachi ihi 4, deihi shechinta, kad istallak minnah 9 deihu ammuda deemtzaita, deikre daat. vehay let le chovin bemilla deyema. veod, 9 ihu tora, kalil 613 pikkudin hada hu dichtiv, (Shemot 3:15) ze shemi leolam vegomer. shemi im 15 365. zichri im 11 248. uvegin da okmuha, en ani ella min hattora umin hammitzvot dishar ani lav ihu ella innuy. veat 4 min adonay, uf hachi ihi ani bela Adonai.

Teminaa, mayim acharonim detakinu lon, begin melach sedomit, hammesamme et haenayim. amay ikrun chova. ella beorach raza, sam hammavet sharya al yedoy mezuhamin, deavde behu beracha. veal kos dimvarche aleh belo tohora, ikre tame. uma kos deshotin bo, tame levarcha ad dahavo metahare leh behaddacha millego umillevar. kol shekken yedoy. uvegin da, mayim acharonim chova. veraza demilla, (Vayikra 20:7) vehitkaddishtem: ellu mayim rishonim. vihyitem kedoshim: ellu mayim acharonim. ki kadosh: ze shemen arev. lokovel, kadosh kadosh kadosh Adonai tzevaot. uvegin da vehitkaddishtem vegomer, leishtemoda deattun benin lekudesha berich hu, hada hu dichtiv, (Devarim 14:1) banim attem laAdonai elohechem.

Teshiaa, kos divracha. veokmuha mare dematnitin, asara devarim neemru bechos divracha veillen innun. ittur. ittuf. haddacha. shetifa. chay. male. umekabbelo bishte yadav. venotno bayyamin. umesalleko min hakkarka tefach. venoten enav bo. umeshaggero bemattana leanshe beto. veachshav, en lanu ella arbaa shehen haddacha. ushetifa. chay. malle. veyesh omrim chay min hechavit, veyesh omrim chay, hakkos shalem. sheshshevirato zo hi mitato.
Kos al derech hachachma, hu elohim. vehu (male 17 vehem) vehacha shalem, kos bela 6 kemo kes shehu pagum vechaser bela alef, ken hu chaser bela vav, vehu pagum. hakkisse ken ole begimatteriya kos.

Kos hi hei, vetzarich asara devarim, keneged 10. vehem: ittur besod haatara, ateret tiferet. vezehu sod ittur, sheamru zichronam livracha meattero battalmidim, vehi ateret habberit. ittuf, (Tehillim 102:1) tefilla leani ki yaatof. shekkol habberachot vehattefilot mitattefim, ad shettaale tefillat heani.

Haddacha ushetifa, kemo (Vayikra 16:19) vetiharo vekiddesho. hattahara miyyamin hachesed. vehakedushsha missemol digvura. kos divracha malchut mitztzad bina hanikret elohim. venikra atara mitztzad hakketer. chay, mitztzad yesod, hannikra shalom, shenneemar (Yeshayahu 54:10) uverit shelomi lo tamut amar merachamech Adonai. malle, mitztzad tiferet. mekabbelo bishte yadav, Adonai Adonai.

Venotno bayyamin, ki Adonai elyona lachesed, Adonai sheniya laggevura. umesalleko min hakkarka tefach, besod yod ki silluk Adonai hu yod. venoten enav bo, shehem besod yeahdonahi. Adonai (davar acher yod) meir bevat ayin. Adonai bishlosha tzive haayin. adonay meira bishne keruve haayin, veishone afappe haayin. umeshaggero bemattana leanshe beto. hi bina, shenneemar bah, yismach moshe bemattenat chelko.
Ashiraa, birkat mezona, ha okmuha rabbanan, bishlosha, tzarich kos. veraza demilla, begin deihi (Yirmeyahu 2:2) ahavat kelulotayich, deinnun avahan, bakkol mikkol kol. velet learchaa yattir.

Birkat hamazon min hattora minayin. shenneemar, veachalta vesavata vegomer. veshaninu babberayyta, uverachta zo birkat hazan. et Adonai elohecha zo birkat hamazon. al haaretz, zo birkat haaretz. hatova, zo bone yerushalayim. vechen hu omer, (Devarim 3:25) hahar hatov haze vehalevanon. en li ela leacharav, lefanav minayin. shenneemar asher natan lach, mishaa shenatan lecha, chayayv atta levarcho.

Vedarshu chachamim zichronam livracha, moshe tiken lahem leyisrael birkat hazan, beshaa sheyarad lahem haman. yehoshua tiken lahem birkat haaretz, beshaa shehechonisan laaretz. david ushelomo tiknu bone yerushalayim. od nimtza beparashat haman, remez lebirkat mazon baman atzmo, shenneemar (Shemot 16:12) uvabboker tisbeu lechem vidatem ki ani Adonai elohechem.
Zohar, Vaetchanan 18: Ad dahavo azle, amar ribbi abba, may dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 2:13) oti azvu mekor mayim chayyim lachtzov lahem borot vegomer. oti azvu, da hu man dimshakker beat reshima kaddisha. uvemma meshakker beh. deayil leh birshuta achara, kema deat amer (Malachi 2:11) uvaal bat el nechar, deikre (Yirmeyahu 2:13) borot nishbarim. deha ammin ovde avodat kochavim umazzalot ikru borot nishbarim.

Udeyisrael, ikre beer mekor mayim chayyim, da reshuta kaddisha, mehemnuta kaddisha. veikre beer mabbue demayin tzelilan, nafkin venazlin minah, kema deat amer (Shir hashshirim 4:15) venozlim min levanon. (Mishlei Adonai:15) venozlim mittoch beerecha. uchetiv (Shir hashshirim 4:15) mayan gannim beer mayim chayyim. sitra achara ikre borot nishbarim. asher lo yachilu hammayim. (sefer acher mahu, ella hahu vechulei).

Ta chaze, nahara denagid venafik, ashke lechol ginta, (sefer acher veravvi lechol ginta) veravve lechol atar vaatar, kema deokimna, ad demalle (nusach acher demate) lehahu atar beginta, deikre beer mayim chayyim. umittamman ittezanu illain vetattain, (nusach acher almin tattain) kema deat amer (Bereshit 2:10) umishsham yippared.

Vechol innun sitrin distar semala, la mishtakyayn mehahu neviu demayin neviin, begin deinnun missitra dishar ammin, veikru borot nishbarim. uman dimshakker bishma (nusach acher birshima) kaddisha behahu sitra, itdevak bevorot nishbarim asher lo yachilu hammayim, vela ayyle letamman. vehahu dezache lenatra leh, zache leitshakyay mehahu neviu denachala (bealma din) bealma deate, vezache deitmelle hahu beer illaa, lenagda birchan leella vetatta. zakkaa ihu bealma den, uvealma deate, al da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 58:11) vehayita kegan rave uchemotza mayim asher lo yechazzevu memav.

Vavy leman dimshakker birshima kaddisha, deha meshakker bishma illaa. velo od, ella degarim lehay beer dela itbarcha, vekarenan aleh (Devarim 22:19) ki hotzi shem ra al betulat yisrael. betulat yisrael dayyka. veokmeh ribbi shimon beatreh, man deshavve tiskofe millin al inteteh kadmita, veappik alah shum bish, kema deappik leella, dichtiv ki hotzi shem ra al betulat yisrael setam.
Veazla ha, ki ha deamar ribbi chiyyay amar ribbi yosi, betula yarta sheva berachot, deitbarcha besheva, begin divtulat yisrael yarta sheva birchan, veal da itkere bat sheva.

Veinteta achara, man birchan dilah. birchata devoaz verut, kema deat amer, (Rut 4:11) vayyomru kol haam asher bashshaar vehazzekenim edim yitten Adonai et vegomer, devadday betula bez itbarcha, vela itteta achara beraza da. kevan dematu bachakal chad, chamu ilanin, yatvu techotayyhu. amar ribbi abba, ha tzachuta demille deorayyta. netiv.
Zohar, Vaetchanan 19: Patach veamar, (Yeshayahu 27:13) vehaya bayyom hahu yittaka beshofar gadol uvau haovdim beeretz ashshur vehanniddachim beeretz mitzrayim vegomer. vehaya beyom hahu, man bayyom hahu. ella hahu yoma deityeda lekudesha berich hu kema deat amer (zecharya 14:4) vehaya yom echad hu yivvada laAdonai. tu, bayom hahu, kema deat amer (yechezkel 38:18) beyom bo gog al admat yisrael.

Yittaka beshofar gadol. ma lan beh, i hu rav o zeer. ella hahu shofar illaa, deveh nafkin avdin lecheru tadir, vehay ihu yovla, deyovla illaa veravreva hu. vechad hay ittear, kol cheru dealmin mitarin beh, vehahu ikre shofar gadol.

Uvau haovdim beeretz ashshur. haavudim mibbae leh, o hanneevadim, may haovdim. haovdim mammash, begin deinnun beara achara, uman deshari beara achara, yanik mershuta achara ucheillu la sharya bimhemnuta, begin kach ovdim ikrun. ovdim innun bechol sitrin, dechad yisrael sharyayn beara kaddisha, zakkain, zakkain tadir becholla, zakkan leella vetatta.

Davar acher uvau haovdim, man innun. illen tzaddik ucheneset yisrael. deikrun ovdim. menalan. keneset yisrael, dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 9:11) al ma avda haaretz, avuda o neevedet la ketiv, ella avda haaretz, da keneset yisrael. tzaddik, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 57:1) hatztzadik avad, avud o neevad la ketiv, ella avad, veha okmuha.

Vei tema, uvau, mean atar atyayn illen ovdim. ella, keneset yisrael min galuta. tzaddik, kema deokmuha, dichtiv (Tehillim 126:1) beshuv Adonai et shivat tziyyon, begin deyetuv leatreh, veyete leitchabbera bichneset yisrael. veal da, uvau haovdim beeretz ashshur. vehishtachavu laAdonai behar hakkodesh birushalayim, may ka mayyre. ella milla da dehanniddachim beeretz mitzrayim, kivyachol, yisrael la yippekun min galuta, ella bishchinta, kema deokmuha, veinnun niddachim hishtachavu laAdonai.
Zohar, Vaetchanan 21: (Devarim 6:Adonai) veahavta et Adonai elohecha. ribbi yosi patach, (Yeshayahu 52:5) veatta ma li fo neum Adonai ki lukkach ammi chinnam vegomer. ta chaze, rechimuta dekudesha berich hu beyisrael af al gav dechovayyhu garmu leistalleka mibbenayyhu, veitbaddaru bene amamaya, hu tava elbona dilhon. veta chaze, beshaata deyisrael sharan bearahon, kudesha berich hu mishtaasha beginteh, vekariv legabbayyhu deyisrael, veshama kallehon, veishtebach behu.

Kevan degarmu chovayyhu, veitgele yisrael meara kaddisha, kudesha berich hu la al beginteh, vela mishtaasha beh. vela od, ella deihu tzavavch veamar, veatta ma li fo neum Adonai, uchetiv hatam (Tehillim 132:14) po eshev ki ivvitiha. ki lukkach ammi chinnam, kema deat amer, (Yeshayahu 52:5) chinnam nimkartem.

Umehahu yoma deitgeliu yisrael mearahon, la ishtechach chedvavta kameh kudesha berich hu. hada hu dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 50:3) albish shamayim kadrut vesak asim kesutam. vechol da, begin rechimuta dilhon, derachim lon kudesha berich hu, kema deat amer, (Malachi 1:2) ahavti etchem amar Adonai. (veal da) veahavta et Adonai elohecha. veahavta: devae bar nash leitkashshera beh birchimuta illaa, dechol pulechana devae bar nash lemiflach lekudesha berich hu, deyiflach birchimu. delet lach pulechana, kemo rechimuta dekudesha berich hu. ribbi abba amar, hane mille kelala deorayyta innun, begin deeser amiran deorayyta, hacha itkelilu, veha okmuha chavrayyay.

Ta chaze, let lach milla bachavivuta kamme kudesha berich hu, keman derachim leh kaddeka yaut. uma hu. kema dichtiv, bechol levavcha. bechol, may ka mayyre, bilvavcha mibbae leh. benafshecha, bimodecha, mahu bechol levavcha. ella leachlela teren libbin, chad tav vechad bish. bechol nafshecha: chad tav, vechad bish. bechol meodecha, da la atya lidderasha. amar ribbi elazar, vaafillu hay lidderasha hu. may tama. ben denafal leh mamona miyyeruta, o missitra achara, o ben deihu ravavch leh, veal da ketiv bechol meodecha.

Amar ribbi abba, ahadarna lakkera veahavta. man derachim lekudesha berich hu, itattar bechesed mikkol sitrin, veavid chesed becholla, vela chayis al gufeh veal mamoneh. menalan. meavraham. kema deittemar, deha la chas birchimuta demareh, al libbeh, (dehu yitzreh) veal nafsheh, veal mamoneh.

Al libbeh la ashgach, al reuta dileh, begin rechimuta demareh. al nafsheh, dela chas al bereh, veal itteteh, begin rechimuta demareh. al mamoneh, dehava kaim befarashat archin, veatkin mezone lechol alma. begin kach, itattar beitra dechesed. kema dichtiv, (Micha 7:20) chesed leavraham. uman deitkeshshar birchimuta demareh, zacha lehay. velo od, ella dealmin kullehu mitbarchan begineh. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 145:10) vachasidecha yevarchucha, al tikre yevarchucha, ella yevarchu ko. (dichtiv, (Bereshit 12:3) venivrechu bach kol mishpechot haadama)

Yoma chad, hava chalash ribbi yosi, al (alu) legabbeh ribbi abba veribbi yehuda veribbi yitzchak, chamu leh dehava nafil al anpoy venaim. yatvu. kad ittear, chamu leh leanpoy dechayychin. amar leh ribbi abba, milla chadta chameta. amar leh vadday, dehashta salleka nafshi, vechamet yekara, meinnun demasaru garmayyhu al kedushsha demarehon, dahavo alin bitlesar nahare deafarsemona dachya. vekudesha berich hu mishtaasha behu. vachamena ma dela yahavu li reshuta lememar. veshailna lon, amena, hay yekara deman hu. amru li, meinnun dirchimu lemarehon behahu alma. umimma dechamit, nafshay velibbay itnehir, veal da anpai chayyeychin.

Amar leh ribbi abba, zakkaa chulakach, aval orayyta ashid behu, dichtiv, (Yeshayahu 64:3) ayin la raata elohim zulatcha yaase limchakke lo. amar leh ribbi yehuda, ha shailu chavrayyay, da dichtiv yaase, taase mibbae leh.

Amar leh, ha ittemar. aval raza demilla, hayeynu dichtiv, (Tehillim 27:4) lachazot benoam Adonai ulevakker behechalo. veokmuha, noam Adonai, hahu deatya meattika kaddisha, dekudesha berich hu mishtaasha beh. deha hahu noam meattika nafka. ulevakker behechalo, behechala illaa al kolla. uf hacha, ayin lo raata elohim zulatcha yaase. man, hahu attika setima decholla, deha beh talya, amar leh, vadday hachi hu. zakkaa chulakehon deinnun dirchimuta demarehon mitdabbekan behu, leillen let shiura lechulakehon behahu alma.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, kama madorin al madorin it lehu letzaddikayyay behahu alma, umadora illaa decholla, innun dirchimuta demarehon itkeshshar behu, deha madorehon itkeshshar behechala desalik al kolla. may tama, begin dekudesha berich hu behay itattar.

Ta chaze, (sefer acher kolla ahava) hechala da, ahava itkere, uvegin ahava kayyeyma kolla. kema dichtiv, (Shir hashshirim 8:7) mayim rabbim lo yuchelu lechabbot et haahava. vecholla birchimuta kayyeyma, deha shema kaddisha hachi ishtechach deha ukemuha, 10 la mitperash kotza dilella min 10 lealmin. deha birchimuta sharya aleh, vela mitperash minneh lealmin. Adonai, ha ukemuha, deyod la mitperash minah, veishtechachu kachada bachavivuta, la itparshan da min da. kegavvna da Adonai veha ittemar, kema dichtiv, (Bereshit 2:10) venahar yotze meeden, yotze tadir lealmin, bachavivuta itdabbekan.

11 Kad itdabbekan da beda, itdabbekan bachavivuta kachada, chatan bechalla, dearchayyhu tadir bachavivuta ishtechach. 10 baAdonai, Adonai im 6, 6 im Adonai. veda beda itkeshshar bachavivuta. vecholla ahava ikre. veal da man derachim lemalka, ha itkeshar behahu ahava. ubbegin kach, veahavta et Adonai elohecha.
Zohar, Vayakhel 14: Hay nekuda tattaa kad salleka veitchazit, veitkashshitat. (sefer acher hay nekuda tattaa kad salleka leitattera baavahan) keden kol chedva ishtechach leella vetatta, vealmin kullehu bechedva. uvehay lelya, hay nekuda itpashat nehoraa, ufaris gadpoy al alma, vechol shiltonin acharanin mitabberan, unetiru ishtechach al alma.

Ucheden ittosaf ruach nishmeta beyisrael, al kol chad vechad, uvehahi nishmeta yetera, nashyayn kol itzba vechemata, vela ishtechach bar chedva, leella vetatta. hahu rucha denachit veittosaf bivne alma, kad nachit, itsache bevusemin deginta deeden, venachit veshara al amma kaddisha, zakkain innun, kad hay rucha itar.

Behahi shaata dehahu rucha nachit nachtin immah lego ginta deeden, shittin retichin, mitatterin leshit sitrin. vechad mate leginta deeden, keden kol innun ruchin venishmatin deginta deeden, kullehu (mitare lehahu mitattere (nusach acher behahu)) rucha. keruze kare veamar, zakkain attun yisrael, amma kaddisha, diruta demarichon ittear legabbayychu.

Raza derazin leyade chachmeta, zakkain innun kad hay rucha itar. hay rucha ihu itpashshetuta dehay nekuda, venafka minnah, veitpashsheta bealma, vehahu have raza deshabbat, deshara letatta, veal da ketiv beh shemira, (Shemot 31:16) veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat, veha ukemuha, shabbat la ketiv, ella et hashshabbat, leasgaa hahu rucha deshare al kolla, veitzterich lenatra leh, hoil vekayyeyma immeh devar nash, veal da ketiv, (Yeshayahu 56:6) kol shomer shabbat mechallelo.

Behay raza it raza achara. hay rucha, ithani behay yoma, mehanaotan deyisrael, umeinnuga dilhon, uvegin da, bae lemehav leh innuga, bemechla uvemishteya, telat zimnin, bitlat seudatin, ditlat darge mehemnuta, kema deukemuha. vehay natil chedva veinnuga, beinnun seudate deyisrael. zakkaa chulakeh, man deahane leh, umeaneg leh, behay yoma.

Hay rucha, ithane kol shita yomin, merucha illaa deattika dechol attikin. uveyoma deshabbeta, kevan denachit, veitsache beginta deeden belelya, itannag (Rosh Chodesh amud alef, 98 amud bet) meinnuga degufa, bisudate dimhemnuta, veitattar (nusach acher veitannag) hay rucha meella vetatta, veitrave bechol sitrin, beitra dilella vetatta.

Vehoil vekayyeyma immeh devar nash, itzterich leh lenatra leh. veal da ketiv veshamru vene yisrael et hashshabbat. shabbat, da hu hahi nekuda tattaa. et hashshabbat, da hu hay rucha, itpashshetuta dehahi nekuda. hahu itpashshetuta, kad ittosaf kiddushan uvirkan milleella, al hahi nekuda, itnehir kolla, veitavid rucha nehira bechol sitrin, itpelag leella venahir. veitpelag letatta venahir. veda hu dichtiv beni uven beni yisrael chulak achasana it lan kachada.

Chulaka dilella, itattar behay yoma, meinnuga illaa kaddisha, veithane mizziva illaa deattika dechol attikin. chulaka tattaa, itattar behay yoma, meinnuga diltatta, deithane behane seudate. veal da, bae leannega leh, bemechla uvemishteya bilvushe yekar, uvechedva decholla.

Vechad mitattera hay chulaka letatta, veitnetir kema deitzterich, salleka leella, veitchabbera behahu chulaka achara. vehay nekuda natil kolla meella vetatta, veitkelila mikkol sitrin. uvegin demitattera beshabbat, meella umittatta, kol shear yomin yahiv chela lecholla, veityeyhiv leh shuletanu meella umittatta. uverazin desifra dishlomo malka, ishtechach raza da, veukemuha butzina kaddisha, zakkaa chulakehon deyisrael.

Ketiv vayyinnafash, veukemuha vavy nefesh deavdat veshappir ihu. aval i hachi vavy gufa itzterich lememar, deminneh avdat nefesh. aval raza demilla, bevar nash it nefesh, denatla umashich legabbeh lehay rucha meerev shabbat. vehahu rucha sharya begavvav dehahi nefesh, vedayyra bah kol yoma deshabbeta. ucheden, hahu nefesh, yetera beribbuya vetoalta yattir mimma dehava.

Veal da taninan, kol nafshan deyisrael mitatteran beyoma deshabbeta, veitra dilhon, desharya hay rucha begavvavyyhu. kevan denafak shabbeta, vehahu rucha salleka leella, keden vavy lenefesh, deavdat ma deavdat. avdat hahu itra illaa, vehahu chela kaddisha dehava ba, veda hu vayyinnafash, vavy nefesh, deavdat ma deavdat.

Onatan dechakkimin, deyade razin illain, milelya deshabbeta lelelya deshabbeta, veokmuha. aval milla da shailna levutzina kaddisha, deha chazenan dehay kitra tattaa, nakta ma denakta bimama, uvelelya yahiv mezona lechol cheleh, kema deukemuha, dichtiv, (Mishlei 31:15) vattakam beod layla vattitten teref levetah vechok lenaaroteha. nakta bimama, veyahava belelya. vehasheta amar mar deziuuga ishtechach behay lelya.

Amar, vadday ziuuga ishtechach belelya da. may tama. begin dehay lelya, afrishat nishmatin lechol innun chakkimin, deyadin razin dechachmeta. vechibbura, veziuuga, la ishtechach beyoma achara bechol chedva, bela irbuveya (sefer acher ella begin da) achara, kegon da. begin deinnun nishmatin difligat, feligat lon bechakkimin, betzaddikim, bachaside kedka yeot. (sefer acher vetu bechol) uvechol lelya velelya, ziuuga ishtechach vadday. ematay befalgut lelya. veha okimna. aval la bechol sitrin kehay ziuuga.

Uvegin da, chakkimin deyadin razin, bayayn lesaddera shimmusha dilhon, behay lelya. may taama. begin dechol yome deshabbeta, it lon rucha achara deshara al alma, uvehay lelya it lon rucha achara kaddisha illaa, denachta livni kaddishin, vehahu rucha nashiv meattika dechol attikin, venachta lego nekuda tattaa, lemehav bah nayycha lecholla, veda itpelig lechol sitrin, leella vetatta, kema deat amar beni uven bene yisrael.

Vechad innun chakkimin, yatvin behahu rucha kaddisha, rucha illaa, baan leshammesha arsayyhu, dehay rucha amshich avatreh letatta, kol innun nishmatin kaddishin, veyartin kaddishe elyonin, behay rucha, nishmatin kaddishin livnehon kedka yeot.

rashi: Vattomer tziyyon. hi hayta sevura sheshshechachtiha:
targum: Vaamaret tzion salek shechinte Adonai mini vayay rachakani:

rashi: Al ken lo haya lelevi chelek. lefi shehuvdelu laavodat mizbeach veenan penuyin lacharosh velizroa:
Adonai hu nachalato. notel peras mezumman mibbet hammelech:
Veanochi amadti vahar. lekabbel halluchot haacharonot, ulefi shello peresh lemala kamma amad bahar baaliyya acharona zo, chazar vehitchil bah:
Kayyamim harishonim. shel luchot harishonot, ma hem beratzon af ellu beratzon, aval haemtzaiyyim sheamadti sham lehitpallel alechem hayu vechaas:
Ash. tolaat habbegadim:
targum: Ha Adonai elohim said li man hu di yechayvinani ha chulehon kilvusha divli ucheasha achil le:

rashi: Ki enechem haroot. mussav al hammikra haamur lemala – ki lo et benechem asher lo yadu ki im immachem asher enechem haroot vegomer:
Eretz harim uvekaot. meshubbach hahar min hammishor, shehammishor bevet kor atta zorea kor, aval hahar bet kor mimmennu chameshet korin – arbaa mearbaa shippuav veechad berosho:
Uvekaot. hen mishor:
ohc: Vehaaretz asher attem vegomer. kashe, achar sheamar befasuk shellifne ze "ki haaretz" vegomer, ma makom lachzor lomar "vehaaretz", kevan shemmaamar ze hu gamran shel devarim shehitchil ledabber bappasuk hakkodem? venire ki shiur hakkatuv hu al ze hadderech: ki mittechilla hizkir shevach haaretz beamro zavat chalav udevash, vegamar omer ki haaretz vegomer lo cheeretz mitzrayim vegomer, perush, hagam sheeretz mitzrayim meshubbachat beferot, shekken ketiv "kegan Adonai keeretz mitzrayim" (Bereshit 13:10), lo keshiur ze levad hi haaretz asher Adonai noten. veod yesh geriut beeretz mitzrayim asher tizra vegomer vehishkita vegomer, vegamar omer vehaaretz asher attem vegomer limtar hashshamayim vegomer.

rashi: Ufedenu lemaan chasdecha. en anu baim bechoach maasenu, ella lemaan chasdecha ase:
targum: Kum sayea lana uferok yatana metul tuvach:

rashi: Ki tomar bilvavcha. al karchacha leshon dilma hu, shemma tomar bilvavcha mippene shehem rabbim lo uchal lehorisham, al tomar ken, lo tira mehem, velo yittachen lefarsho beachat mishshear leshonot shel ki sheyyippol alav shuv lo tira mehem:
Zet shemen. zetim haosim shemen:

ohc: Vezacharta et Adonai vegomer. perush, shetztzarich latet libbo al tovato ki meAdonai hayta lo, vedavar ze yeirehu tamid lehakkir boro vehashegachato alav, utechillat tachbulot yetzer haadam hi lehashekicho davar ze vederech ze yikkanes leabbedo. veulay ki laze samach maamar sheachare ze vehaya im shachoach tishkach, perush, im shachoach davar ze she hu hammetiv lecha vegomer sofcha shettishkach et Adonai, vesofcha lalechet achare elohim acherim, velo bemachshava levad ella bemaase, keamro "vaavadtam", velo avoda sheenah mesuyyemet beissur ella "vehishtachavita lahem", shehi avoda mesuyyemet beissur lechol avoda zara shebbaolam, keamram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 60.): hammishtachave lemarkulis chayyav hagam sheen avodato bechach, ha lamadta shehazzechira zo gader gadol laavodat Adonai, umechesronah yaddichennu hassatan mimmadrega lemadrega lematta mimmenna.

rashi: Baet hahiv. lesof arbaim yom nitratztza li veamar li pesol lecha, veachar kach veasita lecha aron, vaani asiti aron techilla, shekkesheavo vehalluchot beyadi hechan ettenem? velo ze hu haaron sheasa vetzalel, shehare mishkan lo nitasseku vo ad leachar yom hakkippurim, ki beridto min hahar tzivva lahem al melechet hammishkan, uvetzalel asa mishkan techilla veachar kach aron vechelim, nimtza ze aron acher haya, vezehu shehaya yotze immahem lammilchama, veoto sheasa vetzalel lo yatza lammilchama, ella bime eli, veneenshu alav venishba (talmud yerushalmi shekalim 6):
ohc: Baet hahi vegomer pesal lecha. perush, lefi shelluchot harishonim maase elohim hemma velo maase yede moshe, veachar shennaasa haegel lo hayu reuyim leluchot kaze, veamar Adonai lemoshe sheyyifsol otam middevarim shehem mityachasim elav, lishlol hammityachasim leel elyon shehem harishonim.

Vegamar omer veasita lecha aron etz, perush, letzad shehem maase yede adam tzerichin makom muchan lehinnaten bo, ma shello tzivva Adonai ken laasot aron lalluchot harishonim. vehattaam, ki hem omdin beatzman velo hayu tzerichin aron levad mearon sheasa betzalel (Shemot 25:10), veayyen ma shekkatavti befasuk "vaetpos" (Devarim 9:17). vedikdek lomar veasita lecha lehair ledarkenu ki letzad shehem mammash shellecha hu sheanochi metzavvecha laasot aron.

rashi: Bekerev kol yisrael. kol makom shehaya echad mehem boreach haaretz nivkaat mittachtav uvolato, ellu divre rabbi yehuda, amar lo rabbi nechemya vahalo chevar neemar (Bamidbar 16) vattiftach haaretz et piha – velo piyyoteha. amar lo uma ani mekayyem bekerev kol yisrael? amar lo shennaaset haaretz midron kemashpech, vechol makom shehaya echad mehem haya mitgalgel uva ad mekom habbekia (80 yalkut shemauni 752):
Veet kol hayekum asher beraglehem. ze mamono shel adam shemmaamido al raglav (sanhedrin 110):
ohc: Kol hayekum vegomer bekerev vegomer. perush, gam hayekum shello haya omed immam bammakom sheppatzta haaretz et piha, ella bekerev kol yisrael, af al pi chen haya nishmat venivla befi haaretz, keamram zichronam livracha (Bamidbar Rabba 18,13) afilu machat vechulei:

rashi: Albish shamayim. tzeva hashshamayim, sare haovde kochavim umazzalot, kesheani ba lippara min haumma (mechilta beshallach shira 2):
targum: Achase shemaya kidbekavla uvesaka ashave kesutehon:

rashi: Patach li ozen. vehishmiani "et mi eshlach" (Yeshayahu 6:8), shalachti et amos vehayu korin oto pesilus, shalachti et micha vechulei, kidita bifsikta denachamu nachamu (Pesikta derav kahana 16 4):
Veanochi lo mariti. millelech bishlichuto, vlo nesugoti achor, ella "vaomar hinni shelacheni" (Yeshayahu 6:8):
targum: Adonai elohim shalachani leitnabbaa vaana la serevet laachora la istacharet:

ohc: (19-20) Avod tovedun vegomer kaggoyim vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar "avod tovedun", od lamma hutzrach ledammot velomar kaggoyim vegomer, od lamma hutzrach lomar levassof paam sheniyya ken tovedun velo samach lema sheamar bitchilla "avod tovedun" shealav chozer maamar "kaggoyim" vegomer.
