Achen yitbaer hakkatuv al derech amram zichronam livracha (yerushalmi chagiga 1,7) shello charva yerushalayim ella al shebbittelu bah divre tora, vahagam shehayu ovde avoda zara im hayu lomdim tora lo hayta nechrevet, keamram zichronam livracha. umeatta yesh makom lehareshia velaavod avoda zara ulehaarim lilmod tora kede shettagen alehem leval yovdu. laze ba hammaamar kan keshebba lehaterot al avodat avoda zara shettesovev sheyyovdu min haaretz, amar haidoti vegomer, perush, hareni matre bachem "ki avod tovedun", uferush battechilla aveda achat tovedun, vehu shettihyu kaggoyim chasere hattora sheyyishkachem Adonai mehem veyihyu kaggoyim, veaz "kaggoyim asher Adonai maavid vegomer ken tovedun" zo avedat atzmam. uchefi ze tevat kaggoyim nimshechet lemala, lomar dimyon haaveda sheyyihyu kaggoyim, venimshechet lematta, ledimyon avedat haggoyim atzman min haaretz. veamro ekev vegomer perush kevan sheen tora, ha lamadta sheim yesh lahem tora hagam sheyyihyu ovde avoda zara tora taamod lahem. vehu ma sheddikdek lomar bekol Adonai, uchevar hairoticha bechamma mekomot shekkol makom sheyyazkir "kol" yedabber al hattora.

Od yirtze beamro kaggoyim vegomer, ken tovedun, ki millevad avedatam sheamar lemala bemaamar "avod tovedun", od tzara acheret lahem, achar sheyyovdu hannisharim bahem yihyu kaggoyim asher vegomer ken yovedun, perush sheyyikkaret mehem nevua veruach hakkodesh sheyyovdu, veal zot yecherad lev am Adonai sheen kelala baolam kazo. oy laddorot shettaamu kos hammar hazze mar mimmavet, vehu rachum yashuv yerachamenu ki yitten et rucho banu kime kedem.

Od yitbaer al ze hadderech, ki shelosha mine puranut ramaz lahem kan. haechad – dimyon sheera lahem bechurban habbayit, sheharag mehem ma sheharag nevuchadnetztzar harasha vehigla hannisharim, vehu maamar avod tovedun. 2 – dimyon ma sheera lahem bime mardechay shebbikkesh haman harasha lehashemid laharog uleabbed et kol hayyehudim, vehu maamar kaggoyim asher Adonai maavid, perush, sheggazar alehem (Devarim 20:16) "lo techayye kol neshama", kemo chen yihye ansham, uchemo chen hayta gezerat haman al yisrael lule zechut mardechay veester sheamdu uvittelu haggezera. velaze kafal lomar ken tovedun, lomar shehu davar bifne atzmo. 3 – gezerot heder hannevua miyyisrael, vehu maamar ekev lo tishmeun bekol Adonai. hakkavvana al ze hadderech: "ekev" – perush, besof hammusarim vehattochachot yihye lachem zot shello tishmeu bekol Adonai, uchevar katavti sheen yissurim marim mimmerirut hammavet kedavar ze.

rashi: Vesamtem et devaray. af leachar shettiglu heyu metzuyyanim bammitzvot, hannichu tefillin, asu mezuzot, kede shello yihyu lachem chadashim keshettachzeru, vechen hu omer (Yirmeyahu 31) hatztzivi lach tziyyunim (sifre):
Hammassot. nisyonot:
Vehaotot. kegon vayhi lenachash (Shemot 4), vehayu ledam bayyabbashet (sham):
Vehammoftim. hammakkot hammuflaot:
Vehayyad hachazaka. zo haddever:
Vehazzeroa hannetuya. zo hacherev shel makkat bechorot:
Hen laAdonai elohecha. hakkol, veaf al pi chen, rak baavotecha cheshek Adonai. min hakkol:
VaAdonai elohim yaazar li. im yakumu alay:
targum: Vayay elohim said li al ken la itkenait al ken shaveti appi takifin ketinara veyadaana are la itbehet:

rashi: Simlatcha lo valta. anne chavod hayu shafim bichsutam umegahatzim otam kemin kelim megohatzim, veaf ketannehem kemo shehayu gedelim haya gadel levushan immahem, kallevush hazze shel chomet sheggadel immo (80 yalkut shemauni 850):
Lo vatzeka. lo nafcha kevatzek, kederech holche yachef sheraglehem nefuchot:
Ki gerim heyitem. mum shebbecha al tomar lachavercha (bava metzia 59):

ohc: Ushemartem et kol asher vegomer lemaan techezku. hakkavvana baze lishlol daat omrim lachdol meesek hattora mishshum milchemet haaretz shetztzarich chozek, vehattora nikret tushiyya (sanhedrin 26:), laze amar "ushemartem et kol hammitzva", uchevar katavti lemala shemmaamar "kol hammitzva" yirtze el esek hattora, veyiched lah shemira litten lav al bittulah, vegamar omer lemaan techezku perush, sheadrabba notenet lo koach ugevura lehitchazzek bemilchemet Adonai, vechen hu omer (Mishlei 8:14) "ani vina li gevura".

rashi: Vaadone haadonim. lo yuchal shum adon lehatztzil etchem miyyado:
Lo yissa fanim. im tifreku ullo:
Velo yikkach shochad. lefayyeso bemamon:
ohc: Elohe haelohim vaadone haadonim. perush, elohe hammalachim hannikraim elohim, dichtiv (Iyov 1,6) "vayyavou bene haelohim". vaadone haadonim hem shallite olam hattachton, al derech amro (Bereshit 42:30) "dibber haish adone haaretz". vehutzrach lomar gam perat adnut hattachtonim, lehodia ki adonim shel matta en beyadam habbechira laasot kecheftzam uretzonam, ella hu adon alehem lehattotam laasher yachpotz, vehu maamar shelomo (Mishlei 21:1) "lev melech beyad Adonai".

rashi: Halo yochiach. yeyasser etchem al kach:
targum: Haefshar dihav orayta leameh vechad yechovun hala yitvakkechun hala Adonai alif leadam kadame mandea:

rashi: Gedolim vaatzumim mimmekka. atta atzum vehem atzumim mimmecha (sifre Devarim 11):
ohc: Shema yisrael atta over vegomer. amro shema yisrael perush, tenu datechem lemaamar ze sheani omer lachem "atta over", ma retzoni lomar lachem baze "atta over", vehasekilu kavvanati bemaamar ze ma hu. vehu alav hashshalom nitkavven lehairam al ma sheera elav shehu eno over, velaze amar atta lomar velo ani, vehattaam keamram zichronam livracha (Devarim Rabba 3,11) veze leshonam: liftoach lahem petach sheyyevakshu alav rachamim, ad kan. vechash shemma lo yavinu et devarav vehikdim lomar "shema", perush, haven. veamro hayyom nitkavven lomar shehahefresh sheyyesh benam leveno shehem ovrim vehu eno over hu davka hayyom, aval bizman acher yaavor gam hu, keamram zichronam livracha (Zohar 10 120.) befasuk "kime tzetcha" vegomer ki leatid moshe yachnis et yisrael leeretz yisrael.

rashi: Veet yerivech. veim merivayich ani ariv:
targum: Are chidnan amar Adonai af dishvo gibbarin ativ vedaado takifin eshezev veyat pureanutich ana itpera veyat benach ana efrok: [401] are chidnan amar Adonai af adaa daada minich esav gibbara yitnesev mine veshivya dishva minich yishmael gevtana daamir ale arod beenasha yishtezev veyat pureanutich ana itpera veyat benach ana efrok:

rashi: Moav sir rachtzi. kelomar: avdi veshammashi, kichli tashmish shemmishtammeshin bo:
Al edom ashlich. avodati, sheyyihyu malchehem notlin minalay beragli:
Etroa. aria lahem kol leyaram mippanay:
targum: Doshshet moavae hech dudi shezugi al malchut edom etlok sandeli al malchut pelishtae etyabbev:

rashi: Ashre haggever. ashrehem hatztzaddikim hameunnim tachat yedechem, uvilvad sheyyihyu oskin battora uvammitzvot (tanchuma, mikketz 16):
targum: Tav legavra di techasnineh yah umin oraytach tealfineh:

rashi: Bekol avdo. bekol hanneviim:
Asher halach chashechim. afillu tzara baa alav, yivtach beshem Adonai, ki hu yatztzilehu:
targum: (Amar neviya atid kudesha berich hu lemeheve amar leammaya) man bechon midachalaya dayya di shema bekal avde neviya daavad orayta veaka kegibbar dimhalech bekavla velet zehor le mitrechitz bishma dayya umistemich al purekana deelahe:

ohc: Veyadata im levavecha vegomer. kavvanat hakkatuv hu sheyyeshaer haadam im libbo sheen teva adam lehochiach uleyasser ella livno, ki alav yakpid biroto asot ra, ma sheen ken yargish libbo birot ben chavero asot resha. veze mitteva hammutba beenosh leharegish al beno baasoto davar asher lo yease vikallelennu veyakkennu, ma shello yaase chen lemi sheeno makpid alav. kemo chen Adonai elohecha meyasserekka, perush shehagam shehaummot osim resha vetoevot lo yakpid alehem kemo shemmakpid alecha, lihyoto elohecha shennityached shem elohuto alecha, velaze meyasserecha al kol davar asher lo tov asot.

rashi: Maddua bati. lehitkarev alechem, veen ish – mi mikkem pone elay?
targum: Ma den shelichat neviye vela tavu itnabbiu vela kabbilu haitkefada itkefadat gevureti milmifrak veim let kodamay chel leshezava ha vimzofiti achariv yama eshave naharin madbera yisron nunehon mibbeli maya vimutun betzachuta:

rashi: Vearvatah. af hu leshon 'midbar, kemo "beeretz arava veshucha" (Yirmeyahu 2:6), ella shehaarava kevar haya bah yishshuv vehuchreva:
Toda. kol hodaya:
targum: Are atid Adonai lenachama tzion lenachama kol charvataha vishave madberaha keeden umeshraa keginta dayya bia vechedva yishtechach bah maale todata vekal dimshabbechin:

rashi: Shamor tishmerun. azharat shemirot harebe, lehizzaher betalmudo shello yishtakkach (sham):
Lalechet bechol derachav. hu rachum veatta tehe rachum, hu gomel chasadim veatta gomel chasadim (sham):
Uledovka vo. efshar lomar ken? vahalo esh ochla hu? ella hiddabbek battalmidim uvachachamim umaale ani alecha keillu nidbakta bo (sifre):
ohc: Ki im shamor tishmerun. tzarich ladaat lamma kafal lomar shamor tishmerun, od ma shemira hi zot? veulay sheyyechavven lehazehir al shemirat hammitzvot shetztzivva Adonai laasot mishmeret lemishmarto, vechan tzivva leyisrael al otah shemira sheyyishmeru otah, vehu amro shamor shehi hashshemira sheyyaasu rabbotenu zichronam livracha, tishmerun perush tishmerun otah.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: "im shamor" – perush, im taasu shemira lammitzvot, baze tihyu betuchim shettishmerun" et kol hammitzvot, aval belo mishmeret tihyu nichshalim bechelek mehammitzvot. kegon mitzvat shabbat, im lo yosifu mechol al hakkodesh yesh lachush sheyyihyu nichshalim begufo shel shabbat.

Od yirtze letzauot al hammitzvot sheyyihyu nishmarim ben mimmennu ben mehazzulat, vehakkavvana baze shello yomar adam day li im eshmor et atzmi leval avor al achat mehammitzvot veen alay lehatzer al bittul hammitzvot mehazzulat, laze ba maamar Adonai shamor attem tishmerun et mitzvot perush leval yitbattelu mehazzulat, uvenoam devarim ellu natan taam shechiyyev Adonai leyisrael bearvut, ki kelalut hachiyyuv hi al hammitzvot shello titbattel baolam meish yisrael, velaze kol shemmitbattelet hare naasa peshia binvat battenu, ki hattora lanu nittena morasha, al tikre morasha ella meorasha (fesachim mat:) veal haadam chiyyuv shemirat arusato leval tihye neelevet mehazzulat, kemo chen haddavar hazze ishsha yirat Adonai hiknu lanu min hashshamayim alenu chiyyuv shemiratah leval yishlechu yadam bema sheen hattora chafetza, veze yihye al yede hakkoach asher yihye beyad hammetzuvvim lirdot bemakkel velimnoa oshek varesha, gam lehochiach benoam divre ahava vechibba lehattot lev bene adam leyashsher akmumiyyut hallev, vehu amro laasotah leahava vegomer lalechet bechol vegomer uledavka vo, perush maamar laasotah al derech amram (yevamot 63:) nae doresh venae mekayyem, gam amru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (berachot 6:) kol ish sheyyesh bo yirat shamayim devarav nishmain, shehabba lehazehir bene adam ulehattotam el hadderech hayyashar tzarich sheyyihye hu kodem lachen ose et kol hammitzvot, vehu amro laasotah, veaz yachnis ahavat Adonai belev shomea, vehu amro leahava perush, poal yotze lashsheni sheyyafil peullat ahavato yitbarach bilvavot bene adam leval yishlechu yad betorat Adonai. veamro lalechet bechol derachav kalal bemaamar kol derachav lomar afillu devarim sheenam bammussag bannivraim, vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (bava metzia pe.) "im totzi yakar mizzolel kefi tihye", veamru od zichronam livracha (sanhedrin 19:) keillu berao, uchefi ze ma Adonai bore veyotzer kemo chen hammachnis ahavato yitbarach belev am Adonai.

Veamro uledavka vo. kevar hikdamnu hakedamot yekarot shekkol nishmot am yisrael hem mimmachtzav elyon chelek Adonai, ki chullam devekim baAdonai, dichtiv (Devarim 4:4) "veattem haddevekim baAdonai", uveemtzaut haaverot titrachek hannefesh middevekutah, uchesheyyashuv haadam lifne Adonai yachzor lehiddavek bo, vehu amro uledavka vo, perush, ledabbek bo anfe hakkedushsha shetztzerichin lehiddavek bo.
Chassalat parashat ekev

rashi: Orlat levavchem. otem levavchem vechissuyo:
Karov matzdiki. hakkadosh baruch hu karov li, lezakkoti baddin:
targum: Keriva zechuti man yedin imi nekkum kachada min beel dini yitkerev levati:

rashi: Adonai yodea. machshevotechem sheattem sevurin lehitgaot benezer hammelucha, vetedu ki hevel hem:
targum: Kodam Adonai yedian machshevat bene nasha arum hinun lema:

rashi: Venatatti metar artzechem. asitem ma shealechem af ani eese ma shealay (sham):
Beitto. ballelot shello yatrichu etchem; davar acher – beitto belele shabbatot shehakkol metzuyin bevattehem:
Yore. hi revia hannofelet leachar hazzeria, shemmarva et haaretz veet hazzeraim:

Malkosh. revia hayyoredet samuch lakkatzir, lemallot hattevua bekashsheha. uleshon malkosh davar hameuchar kedimtargeminan (Bereshit 30) "vehaya haatufim lelavan" – lakkishayya; davar acher – lechach nikret malkosh, sheyyoredet al hammelilot veal hakkashshin:

Veasafta deganecha. atta taasfennu el habbayit velo oyvecha, kainyan shenneemar "im etten deganech vegomer ki measfav yochluhu" (Yeshayahu 62) velo chainyan shenneemar "vehaya im zara yisrael vegomer" (Shoftim 6):

Kol hammitzva. kifshuto; umidrash aggada im hitchalta bemitzva gemor otah, sheenah nikret ella al shem haggomrah, shenneemar "veet atzmot yosef asher heelu vene yisrael mimmitzrayim kavru vishchem" (Yehoshua 24), vahalo moshe levaddo nitassek bahem lehaalotam? ella lefi shello hispik legamrah ugemaruha yisrael nikret al shemam (tanchuma):
ohc: Kol hammitzva vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma mitzva hi zot, veod halo kevar amar "ekev tishmeun ushemartem vaasitem", uma makom lachzor lomar "kol hammitzva"? achen hen haish moshe hiskil belivvot bene adam ki ruach echad yatem kakkaton kaggadol, vehu sullam lehameit baavodat Adonai velatzet midderech hachayyim, vehu ki baasot haadam mimmitzvot Adonai shetayim o shalosh measher tavona, uma gam im yachaziku beachat mikkol mitzvot Adonai bitmidut uvizrizut, yivvaled bahem holada raa lehitatztzel bishar hammitzvot habbaim leyadam, uma gam im yihyu beyadam kamma vechamma mehammitzvot shettimmale nafsham biktzat mehammitzvot. uma meod pasa nega ze, uvifrat belev haholchim betorat Adonai lehavezot hammitzvot hakkallot birotam shehem lomde tora umekayyemim rov hammitzvot vechulei, veze hu hassovev yissure haanashim veyimat kevodam veyirbe yegonotam veyishpal adam veyishshach ish. vaasher laze ba nevi Adonai betochchotav veamar kol hammitzva, yiches lichlalut hattora lemitzva achat vetzivva al kullah leval yite bashshiggayon hannizkar.

Venatan taam sheen alav teshuva, veamar lemaan tichyun uvatem vegomer. nitkavven bemaamar tichyun al derech amram zichronam livracha (Zohar 9 170:) ki baadam yesh 248 evarim veshs gidim, uchenegdam ba devar Adonai lishmor 365 mitzvot lo taase vermch mitzvot ase. vehinne yeshaer adam bevo al ever o gid echad eze mechush o machov, veyitzak libbo beoy vaavoy mimmachovo. haim yekabbel maane letzaako beemor lo: "halo lecha 248 evarim umehem 247 shelemim, veim chelek mermch yechele en rauy likbol al ze"? veze dimyon shemirat hammitzvot shehem meyuchadim keneged haevarim vehaggidim, uchesheadam over umevattel achat mehenna yafil hakkeev beshekkenegdo baevarim uvaggidim. ucheshem sheen teshuvat beriut 247 moelet lehaavir hergesh keev haever tashlum 248, kemo chen lo yashlimu 247 mitzvot ase lechesron haechad tashlum 248. uchemo chen lo yashlim shemirat 364 mitzvot lo taase levittul echad tashlum 365. vehu maamar kol hammitzva, perush bichlaloteha shello yechsar kol shebbeyadcha laasot, tishmerun laasot, perush, ben mitzvot lo taase ben mitzvot ase. vehattaam lemaan tichyun, ze taluy baze, uchesheatta mechasser achat mikkol hammitzvot atta mechasser kenegdo chayyut ever echad.

Veim tomar yishtanne hammashal lannimshal, shehammashal shehu hergesh ever echad lefi shehu machiv lechol achdut hagguf, ma sheen ken hammitzvot, laze ba maamar hannavi belashon ze kol hammitzva, perush sheggam mitzvot hattora leachat yechashvu, hagam sherabbim beminyan, yesod echad uvinyan echad lahem, umeatta hem shavim mammash laddimyon haramuz.
Veamro urevitem, perush shebbeemtzaut ze lo yihye lahem monea mehattovot veyichyu veyirbu.

Veamro uvatem, kan heiram heara gedola, ki mi lanu gadol bemitzvot uvaavodat Adonai kemoshe neeman hakkadosh baruch hu, vetze ulemad shebbeachat alta lo biat haaretz venimna mibbo shamma afillu achar mita. veze lecha haot shetztzarich lishmor velaasot kol hammitzva bishlemut, vechutz middarkenu nitkavven bemaamar tishmerun laasot lomar shetztzarich sheyyihye haadam yoshev umetzappe matay tavo leyado hammitzva laasotah.

Od yitbaer al pi divrehem zichronam livracha sheamru (moed katan koach.) bene chayye umezone lav bizchuta talya milleta ella bemazzala, ad kan. uva maamar moshe kan lahem bidvar chiddush, sheim yisrael yitatztzemu lishmor velaasot kol hammitzvot bichlalut yuvtechu mishshelashtam yachad, vehu amro kol hammitzva vegomer, lemaan tichyun hare chayyim, urevitem hare banim, uvatem virishtem vegomer hare mezone eretz umeloah uvattim meleim kol tuv vegomer. umeatta kol hammitatztzem bishlemut hattora vehammitzvot muvtach bivne uvechayye umezone, veze lecha haot: avraham shehammazzal haya maggid alav shello yihye lo banim, uletzad shehitatztzem bishlemut baavodat Adonai, nishtanna hammazzal vehayu lo banim.

rashi: Uvene yisrael nasu mibbeerot bene yaakan mosera. ma inyan ze lechan? veod, vechi mibbeerot bene yaakan nasu lemosera, vahalo mimmosera bau livne yaakan, shenneemar "vayyisu mimmoserot vegomer" (Bamidbar 33), veod, sham met aharon, vahalo behor hahar met, tze vachashov vetimtza shemona massaot mimmoserot lehor hahar? ella af zo min hattochecha, veod zot asitem, keshemmet aharon behor hahar lesof arbaim shana venistalleku anne chavod, yeretem lachem mimmilchemet melech arad, unetattem rosh lachazor lemitzrayim vachazartem laachorechem shemona massaot ad bene yaakan, umishsham lemosera, sham nilchamu bachem bene levi vehargu mikkem veattem mehem, ad shehecheziru etchem bederech chazaratchem, umishsham chazartem haggudgoda hu chor haggidgad.
Vehaachalti et monayich. habbavliyyim lechayyat hassade et besaram. monayich – leshon "al tonu" (Vayikra 25:14), onaat devarim, hamekanterim otach begiddufehem:
Vecheasis. metek yayin:
Damam yishkarun. ken yishkeru middamam otam hargilim lishtot dam, umi hem ellu? of hashshamayim. ken tirgem yonatan:
targum: Veetten yat besar dahavo monan lich mechal lechol ofa dishmaya uchema demitravan mechamar meret ken chayat bera midimhon titrave veyedun kol bisra are ana Adonai parkich umeshezvich takifa deyaakov:

ohc: Vaetpos bishne vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach letafsam, vahalo beyado hayu? veulay keshello chatu yisrael hayu halluchot gevohot al yad moshe velo hayta yado masseget lakachat otam, uchemo sheddikdek lomar befasuk shellifne ze "ushene halluchot al shete yaday" velo amar "bishte yaday" o "beyaday", ella nitkavven lomar shello hayu beyadav mammash ella gevohot lemala miyyadav vehayu nosot atzman, veachar sheraa haegel husar koach kedushshatam vehutzrach letafsam beyado.

rashi: Vaetnappal vegomer. ellu hen atzmam haamurim lemala, uchefalan kan, lefi shekkatuv kan seder tefillato, shenneemar Adonai elohim el tashchet immach vegomer:

Ledabber bam. mishshaa shehabben yodea ledabber, lammedehu "tora tzivva lanu moshe" sheyyehe ze limmud dibburo; mikkan amru keshehattinok matchil ledabber aviv mesiach immo bilshon hakkodesh umelammedo tora, veim lo asa chen hare hu cheillu kovro, shenneemar velimmadtem otam et benechem ledabber bam vegomer.
Gevi natatti lemakkim hu amar li: "yeshaya, banay sarvanim hem, banay tarchanim hem, al menat shello tichos alehem". amarti lo: "al menat ken" (Pesikta derav kahana 16 4):
targum: Gabbe yehavet lemachan veliste lemartan appi la tamret meitkenau varok:

ohc: Eretz asher lo vemiskenut vegomer. perush, lefi sheyyesh bene adam shehagam shehem ashirim mitnahagim keminhag aniyyim lishte sibbot: 1, shechoshesh shemma yitmotet veyaani, lachen metzamtzem leval yotzi hotzaot merubbot. 2, shello yasbia atzmo kede shello yerae shehu ashir. laze amar asher lo vemiskenut vegomer, sheen makom bah lishne hammechushim hannizkar, ki shene hammechushim yihyu meemtzaut ze ashir veze ani umeemtzaut hahitmottut, ushenehem enam bair hallazo. venatan taam laze beamro lo techsar kol bah, perush, bishlama im haosher ba mizzulat haaretz, ze mishtaddel umaashir veze eno mishtaddel umaani, aval kevan shehaosher baaretz hi taluy vehammaashir mehaaretz maashir venitchalleka lechullam beshave, im ken kullam ashirim. gam en lachush lehitmottut kol et heyotam baaretz, ki mimmenna osher unechasim, vehu amro kol bah:

Vehizkir shene peratim shehem barzel unechoshet, shehem shene devarim hatztzerichim ikkarim letashmishe adam. vehizkir achar ze veachalta vegomer, perush, lefi sheen shelemut laaretz bihyotah meshubbachat beferot im hi chasrat devarim hatztzerichin leyishshuv hair vetashmishe bene adam, ki yetze hashshevach lehashelim hechaser. vahalo timtza kamma ovde adama gannot ufardesim sheyyesh lahem kamma vechamma, umishtakkerin harebe bema shennotenet haadama kochah beferot haaretz uveferot hailan, veaf al pi chen omdim bechoser ki yotziu hakkol betzarche tashmishehem umalbushehem. laze achar sheamar eretz chitta vegomer, gamar omer lo techsar kol bah, veen attem tzerichin lehotzi mishshevach perot haaretz lemakom acher lehavi bimkomo devarim hatztzerichim letashmish adam vetashmish tashmishav, uvaze yeshnam begeder "veachalta vesavata".

rashi: Hayukkach miggibbor malkoach. kisvurim attem shei efshar lakachat meesav malkoach shivyo shel yaakov hatzaddik?
targum: Hayitnesev migabbara adi veim dishvo zakkain yishtazev: [401] amaret yerushelem haefshar deyitnesev meesav rashia daamir ale detzadikaya hu yishtezev:

rashi: Umin haggudgoda vegomer. uvemosera asitem evel kaved al mitato shel aharon sheggarma lachem zot, venidma lachem keillu met sham (talmud yerushalmi sota 1; mechilta Shemot 15; tanchuma chukkat); vesamach moshe tochecha zo leshibbur halluchot lomar shekkasha mitatan shel tzaddikim lifne hakkabba kayyom shennishtabberu vo halluchot, ulehodiacha shehuksha lo ma sheamru "nittena rosh" (Bamidbar 14) lifrosh mimmennu – kayyom sheasu vo et haegel (Vayikra Rabba 20):
Lo vetzidkatcha, atta va lareshet, ki berishat haggoyim. hare ki meshammesh bilshon ella:
ohc: Lo vetzidkatcha. perush, lo vetzidkatcha atta rauy lareshet haaretz, aval al kol panim dor kasher hayu bae haaretz, vechen timtza sheamar lahem "veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem" vegomer (Devarim 4:4), ella shello hayu shelemim latet lahem haaretz lizchutam im lo hayta berit avot. vahagam shebberit avot lo hayta moelet lareshet haaretz im hayu reshaim, vedor hammidbar yochiach, uchemo shekkatav haraavad beferush hammishna beferek 2 deeduyyot sheshshaninu: haav zoche labben vechulei uvemispar haddorot lefanav, vehu hakketz, shenneemar "kore haddorot merosh" (Yeshayahu 41:4), ad kan. vechatav haraavad veze leshono: shehu roe et haddor shehu zakkay umitgalgel immahem ad oto dor vechulei kedoro shel yehoshua vechulei, ad kan. hare shetztzarich gam ken dor zakkay. af al pi chen lo haya bizchutam shiur asher yizku bishvilo lareshet et haaretz im lo hayta berit avot. uchefi ze amro lo vetzidkatcha vegomer, perush, hagam sheattem eda shelema en koach bizchutechem lehassig davar ze. vehechlit lomar "lo vetzidkatcha" lehair shello hoila tzidkutam afillu lesayyea ki berit avot maspeket, ella hoil kishron maasehem leval yimmana hattov mehem.

Ki berishat vegomer ulemaan vegomer asher nishba vegomer. velo hispik beachat mehenna, ki belo rishat haggoyim lo haya Adonai morisham shello al pi hammishpat, uverishat levad en reuyim yisrael littol artzam. o efshar ki perush "morisham" hu meabbedam, velaze tzarich resha shezzulat haresha lo haya Adonai gozer alehem (Devarim 20:16) "lo techayye kol neshama".

rashi: Venatatti esev besadcha. shello titztarech leholichah lammidbarot. davar acher — shettihye gozez tevuatcha kol yemot haggeshamim umashlich lifne vehemtecha veatta monea yadcha mimmenna sheloshim yom kodem lakkatzir veenah pochetet middeganah (sifre):
Veachalta vesavata. hare zo veracha acheret shettehe veracha metzuya bappat betoch hammeayim veachalta vesavata:
Bachem. kemo sheattem roim etchem chashukim mikkol haammim hayyom hazze:
ohc: Kayyom hazze. perush, keseder sheattem beyom ze shehayta haeda shelema bechosher, uchemo sheheid hu alehem shekkullam hayu devukim baAdonai vegomer chayyim (Devarim 4:4), vehakkavvana bammaamar shezzulat seder ze en bechira bahem, hagam sheyyihyu zaram shel hachashukim, im yarshiu lo yechashvu zaram. vehayu lecha yishmael veesav leot, sheenenu root heyotam bene avraham veyitzchak, veaf al pi chen amar hakkatuv "ki veyitzchak yikkare lecha zara" (Bereshit 21:12, nedarim lo.):

rashi: Vidatem hayyom. tenu lev ladaat ulehavin vlkabbel tochachti:
Ki lo et benechem. ani medabber achshav, sheyyuchelu lomar anu lo yadanu velo rainu bechol ze:
ohc: Vidatem hayyom vegomer. perush, mivchan hayyedia hatztzericha chala alechem hayyom, perush, achar sheavru kol haotot vechulei shehizkir besamuch shemmehem yatzdiku hayyedia berura. veamro ki lo et benechem vegomer, perush, taam sheani omer "vidatem" lachem bechinnuy, hu lomar velo et benechem shehem en lahem yedia bemivchan ze kemotchem. velo hutzrach lehazekir hayyedia ma hi, ki keshemmassig haadam dea bemivchan tzodek yire beenav haemet meatzmo ki Adonai elohenu hu echad shebbara hakkol veshallit bakkol umoes beovre tora uvocher bevochareha.

rashi: Ose mishpat yatom vealmana. hare gevura, veetzel gevurato atta motze anvetanuto (Megila 31):
Veohev ger latet lo lechem vesimla. vedavar chashuv hu ze, shekkol atzmo shel yaakov avinu al ze nitpallel (Bereshit 28) venatan li lechem leechol uveged lilbosh (Bereshit Rabba 70):
Mi yovileni. limot hammashiach lifshot yad beesav beare mivtzarim, mi shennachani kevar al edom shehikkiti vahem "bege melach shemona asar elef" (Shmuel 2 8:13):
targum: Uchedun man ovil yati ad kerakka takifa man dabberani ad edom:

rashi: Tachon. leshon hove, kemo haloch vechallot, mavelaanat belaaz:
ohc: Veet chattatchem vegomer lakachti vegomer. ramaz shebbemaasehu baegel paal gam ken bivchinat hachet vesaraf koach hara shennaasa mimmaasehem, veayyen ma shekkatavti befarashat ki tissa befasuk (Shemot 32:20) "vayyikkach et haegel asher asu".

rashi: Hatishkach ishsha ulah. olal shellah:
Merachem ben bitnah. millerachem al ben bitnah:
Gam elle tishkachna. afillu im elle tishkachna, anochi lo eshkachech:
targum: Haefshar detitneshe itteta berah milrachama al bar meaha metiva kenishta deyisrael vaamarat im let kodamohi itnashaa dilma la mitnashe li yat daavadit egel didhav amar lah neviya af ilen itnashyan metiva veemra leh im it kodamohi itneshaa dilma mitneshe li yat daamarit besinay nabed unekabbel metiv veamar lah memri la yerachakinach:

rashi: Hatishmor mitzvotav. shello tenassehu velo teharher acharav:

ohc: Vayannecha vayyarivecha vegomer. tzarich ladaat ma kishran shel devarim shel vayannecha vegomer im vayyaachilcha vegomer, ulefi mashmaut haddevarim genay hamman yaggid sheachilat hamman hayta letzad haravon, veze eno, shemmatzinu shehattora hirbeta beshivche hamman, kaamur (Bamidbar 11:7) "vehamman" vegomer, veamru rabbotenu zichronam livracha (sifre sham) shekkol hakkatuv beshivcho medabber. gam hu mezon hammalachim (yoma 75:), keamro "lechem abbirim achal ish". venire sheggam kan shevach hamman yaggid, ki hammaachalim yeshnam bishne sugim, yesh maachol sheshshave lakkol, ben bari ben chole, letzad heyoto naki mehaippush vechullo nivla baevarim vekal lehitakkel umavri haadam, veyesh maachol sheeno rauy ella levari aval lechole yazzikennu viabbedennu. laze amar hakkatuv beinyan hamman vayannecha vayyarivecha vayyaachilcha vegomer perush vayannecha innuy hadderech, vayyarivecha innuy chesron hammazon, vehinne yadua hu shehammitanne badderech yeafsu kochotav koach hammevashshel vechoach haikkul uchesheadam ochel maachol kashe ketzat lehitakkel yazzikennu ad meod, gam kesheyyirav haadam veyochal kede sevia yeviennu lide choli, veenenu root ki yom shemmitanne haadam leet haochel lo yuchal echol kechol avvat nafsho, veamar vayyaachilcha et hamman hare shevach hammaachol shehu davar harauy afillu lammeunne velaraev millevad taam hannirgash shehaya ketzappichit bidvash.

rashi: Hishshamru lachem. kevan shettihyu ochlim useveim hishshamru lachem shello tivatu, sheen adam mored behakkadosh baruch hu ella mittoch sevia, shenneemar "pen tochal vesavata uvekarcha vetzoncha yirbeyun" (Devarim 8), ma hu omer acharav? "veram levavecha veshachachta":

Vesartem. lifrosh min hattora, umittoch kach vaavadtem elohim acherim, shekkevan sheadam poresh min hattora holech umiddabbek baaza, vechen david omer "ki gershuni hayyom mehistappeach benachalat Adonai lemor lech avod vegomer" (Shmuel 1 26), umi amar lo chen? ella kevan sheani megorash millaasok battora, hareni karov laavod elohim acherim:
Elohim acherim. shehem acherim leovdehem – tzoek elav veeno onehu, nimtza asuy lo kenachri (sifre):
Im asiti zot. ma shemforash acharav:
targum: Adonai elohay in avadet shirata hada bechavavnta vishsha in it teluma biday:

rashi: El tzur chutztzavtem. mimmennu:
Veel makkevet bor. shennokvin vechotzvin bah et habborot, asher nukkartem bah:

Nukkartem. leshon "nikrat hatztzur" (Shemot 33:22), "yikkeruha orve nachal" (Mishlei 30:17). umi hu hatzur? hu avraham avichem, umi hi hammakkevet? hi sara asher choleltechem, asher yeladtechem, leshon "ki chala gam yalda" (Yeshayahu 66:8):
targum: Kabbilu lememri radfe kusheta devaan ulefan min kodam Adonai istakkalu di bachatziva mitinara itchatzavtun vechifsula demiguv rekan itfesiltun:

ohc: Uvishloach Adonai vegomer. perush, lihoshua vechalev leraggel haaretz hayta kavvanato lemor "alu ureshu et haaretz asher ani noten" vegomer, ucheamro befarashat shelach lecha (Bamidbar 13:2) "asher ani noten", veayyen ma shepperashti sham. vehifsik beinyan hammeraggelim uveinyan tavera umassa vechulei beemtza maase haegel, nitkavven lehasemich kol hahaktzafot, veim haya nigmar seder kol maase haegel haya maflig ben haketzafa lehaketzafa, vehahaflaga baze tolid heder hahergesh sheelav yechavven.

rashi: Tetzri miyyoshev. tehi tzara merov yoshvim sheyyavou letochech, yehi lahem hammakom tzar millivnot lahem battim:
targum: Are charvatayich vetzadyutich vaara mefagrutich are chean tidachakun miyativ veyitrachakun mesalamach:

rashi: Lishmor et mitzvot Adonai. veaf hi lo lechinnam, ella letov lach shettekabbelu sachar:

Nemogim eretz vechol yoshveha vegomer. beyom mattan tora, keshehayu nemogim haaretz vechol yoshveha mittenay shehitneta im maase vereshit (shabbat pach.): im lo yekabbelu vechulei tachzeru letohu vavohu:
Tikkanti ammudeha. kesheamarti: "naase venishma" (Shemot 24:7):
targum: Mitmassin dayare ara vechol yatvaha ana atkenit amudaha lealmin:

rashi: Vayyomer Adonai elay vegomer. af al pi shessartem meacharav uteitem baegel, amar li lech neche et haam (Shemot 32):
Vaeshev bahar. en yeshiva ella leshon akkava (Megila 21):

ohc: Am gadol vegomer atta yadata veatta shamata. kashe, im yada – ma chashivut lezichron hashshemia achar sheyyada? od, lamma amar shete peamim atta veatta velo hispik lomar "atta yadata veshamata"? achen hakkavvana hi shemmedabber im shete kittot: kat gedola bechammut hem am bene yisrael, vechat gedola beechut hem yehoshua vechalev shehem gedole yisrael, uvifrat yehoshua shemmuchan lemelech al yisrael. vehitchil ledabber im haggedolim shehem yehoshua vechalev veamar atta yadata, shehem yadu yedia berura beraggelam et haaretz, ucheneged hamon yisrael amar veatta shamata mippi hammaggidim, uvaze nityashshevu haddikdukim.

rashi: Hen kullechem. sheenchem shomim bekol neviav:
Kodche esh. evrato alechem:

Meazzere zikot. machazike zikot, hen gitztzin vegachale esh hannizrakin bakkela. veyesh lo dugma bilshon arammi: "zikukin denur" (berachot noach 2), "kach vechach zikata pasik lan" (bava metzia tzad 1):
Lechu beur eshchem. lefi darkechem tilku:
Miyyadi. tehe gemulechem zot lachem:
targum: (Metivin ammaya veamrin kodamohi ribbonana la efshar lana lemesak beorayta are kol yomana itgerena den im den bikrava vechad netzachna den leden okedna vattehon ushevina taflehon venichsehon uvahada gavna shelimu yomana vela efshar lana lemesak beorayta metiv kudesha verich hu vaamar lehon) ha kulechon megaren beeshta matkefe cherev ezilu pilu beeshta digretun uvecharba ditkeftun mimemri havat da lechon letaklutechon techuvun:

ohc: Kaasher tzivvani Adonai. perush, kol hemshech hazzeman asher tzivvani, vehakkavvana hu lomar ad ki yavo zeman shehotziam meoto aron unetanam baaron sheasa betzalel.

rashi: Al kappayim. al kappay roe ani keillu at chakuka al kappi lirotech ulezachrech tamid. davar acher: al kappayim – meal anne kavod, kemo (Iyov 36:32) "al kappayim kissa or":
targum: Ha kidal yedin at tzayra kodamay shurach lekivli tedira:

rashi: Shiggayon ledavid. menachem amar sheggam ze echad mishshemot hazzemer al shem hakkeli, vechen peresh "al shigyonot" (Chavakuk 3:1), verabbotenu pershu leshon mishge shennitvadda venitpallel al hashshiggayon sheamar shira al mappalto shel shaul kemo shenneemar "vaydabber david laAdonai vegomer" (Shmuel 2 22:1), aval inyan hammizmor eno mochiach al kach. veomer ani sheamaro al iske yishbi venov (Shmuel 2 21:16) shebba alav al ansho shel shaul kemo sheppershu rabbotenu sheamar lo hakkadosh baruch hu al yadcha nitrad doeg haadomi al yadcha neherag shaul uvanav kulei (kidita bechelek shegiot shebbikkesh david lehakkadosh baruch hu lehimmaser beyad sone velo yichle zaro sefer acher eno), vehafach david et tefillato vehitpallel shello yippol beyad oyev. vechen pitrono mishge shar david laAdonai al sheshshagag lomar lehakkadosh baruch hu lemasro beyad oyev al divre shaul shenneherag al yado. davar acher: al shiggayon kenaf hammeil asher karat leshaul (Shmuel 1 24:5):
Kush. ma kushi meshunne beoro, af shaul meshunne bemaasav (moed katan 16:):
targum: Targuma deodeta ledavid di shabbach kodam Adonai metul di amar shirata al tevira deshaul bar kish demin shevet binyamin:

rashi: Yadi… nissi. siman lehavi galiyyot:
Nissi. pirka 109, kemo "vechannes al hagiva" (Yeshayahu 30:17), vehu siman kibbutz, venotnin beroshah beged:
Bechotzen. 362 109, vedome lo beezra: "vgam (ani) chatzni naarti" (Nechemya 5:13):
targum: Kidnan amar Adonai elohim ha egle beammaya gevureti veal malkevata arim nisi veyetun venach betzivin uvenatach al parvan yitnatlan:

ohc: Veyadata ki lo vegomer zechor al tishkach vegomer. kashe, ma mochiach mimma sheavar bazzemannim shehayu bahem reshaim lizman ze, sheefshar shetztzidkatam shehem omdim bah hayyom taspik lahem lareshet et haaretz, vicholin lomar "betzidkati heviani Adonai"? achen hakkavvana hi, ki mimma shehayu roim bazzeman shehayu mamrim et Adonai bederech biatam laaretz, veaf al pi chen hayu nosim uvaim lerishtah, meatta biatam hi letzad berit avot, veen reaya mimma shehem baim laaretz shebbizchutam hem baim.

rashi: Bene shikkulayich. banim shehayit shechula mehem:
Gesha li. hitkarev letzad acher bishvili veesheva:
targum: Mikkean yemrun chad chad begavich bene am galvatich ak li atra revach li veetiv:

ohc: Veachalta et kol haammim. zo mitzvat ase, vegamar omer asher Adonai elohecha noten lach, ha lamadta sheim titatztzelu attem moasim bemattenat elohim.

Veamro lo tachos encha vegomer, al derech amro (Mishlei 12:10) verachame reshaim achzari, perush, en zo mimmiddot hattovot ella midda raa, velaze mazhir negdiyyut midda tova ki bema shellefanenu enah ella raa. veulay shehutzrach lehazehir "lo tachos", lefi shebberach Adonai et yisrael bevanim, veamru zichronam livracha (sanhedrin lo:) shebbaal banim yitrabbu rachamav, veharaya sheen memannim besanhedrin ella mi sheyyesh lo banim. laze ba maamar Adonai lenegdiyyut hatteva sheyyivvaled bahem mikkoach birkat habbanim.

Vegamar omer velo taavod vegomer, lehaircha sherachmanut bedavar ze tolid mechush avoda zara, vehu amro ki mokesh hu lach, perush haam, shekkesheatta chas alav atta mitachzer al atzmecha. o perusho hu chozer al harachmanut asher tzivva alav leval yachus.

rashi: Asher Adonai elohecha doresh otah. vahalo kol haaratzot doresh, shenneemar "lehametir al eretz lo ish" (Iyov 38)? ella kivyachol eno doresh ella otah, veal yede otah derisha sheddorshah, doresh et kol haaratzot immah:
Tamid ene Adonai elohecha bah. lirot ma hi tzericha, ulechaddesh bah gezerot, ittim letova ittim leraa kulei, kidita beroah (daf 17):
Mereshit hashshana. merosh hashshana niddon ma yehe besofah (sham 8):
ohc: Asher Adonai elohecha doresh. dikdek lomar tevat elohecha lehair ki shevach haaretz hi keshe meyached elokuto al yisrael, aval bizman sheyyisrael golim veen hashshechina betocham en shevach kol kach laaretz.

rashi: Vehorish Adonai. asitem ma shealechem, af ani eese ma shealay (sham):

Vaatzumim mikkem. attem gibborim, vehem gibborim mikkem, sheim lo sheyyisrael gibborim ma hashshevach hahu shemmeshabbeach et haemoriyyim lomar vaatzumim mikkem? ella attem gibborim mishshear haummot, vehem gibborim mikkem (70 sham):

ohc: Veyadata hayyom. hutzrach lomar hayyom, lehairam shello ad achar boam el haaretz veyirshu am gadol vegomer, az yatzdiku ze, ella mehayyom yadu veyatzdiku davar ze shehu haover vegomer.

rashi: Hanota ozen. shemma hakkadosh baruch hu, shennata ozen, lo yishma tzaakat ammo veanyo?
targum: Haefshar di netziv udena hala shamea ulefana in efshar di vera ayna vela istakkel beorayta:

rashi: Lo yityatztzev ish vegomer. en li ella ish, umma umishpacha veishsha bichshafeha minnayin? talmud lomar "lo yityatztzev" mikkol makom, im ken ma talmud lomar "ish"? afillu cheog melech habbashan (sham):
Pachdechem umoraachem. vahalo pachad hu mora? ella pachdechem al hakkerovim umoraachem al harchokim; pachad leshon beitat pitom, mora leshon deaga miyyamim rabbim:
Kaasher dibber lachem. vehechan dibber? (Shemot 23) et emati ashallach lefanecha vegomer (sifre sham):
Veatta yisrael. af al pi sheasitem kol zot, odennu rachamav vechibbato alechem, umikkol ma shechatatem lefanav eno shoel mikkem ki im leyira vegomer:
Ki im leyira vegomer. verabbotenu darshu mikkan hakkol bide shamayim chutz miyyirat shamayim (berachot 33):
ohc: Veatta yisrael ma vegomer ki im leyira vegomer. kavvanat hakkatuv hi al ze hadderech, lefi sheyyesh shete haderagot shechafetz Adonai miyyisrael asot, vehem zo lemala mizzo: achat hi hayyira, lemala mimmenna haahava. veamar lahem sheeno mevakkesh mehem ki im hayyira, vetaam haddavar hi lefi shehayyira tesovev etchem lalechet bechol derachav, ki hayyare lo yechdal miyyirato afillu beachat meelef shealav laasot. velo zo bilvad maggiato ella od lo "uleahava oto", hare shehayyira hi petach likkanes leshaar haahava. velaze kesheamar hakkatuv ma Adonai shoel ki im leyira, dikdek lomar veatta, perush, ma shehu shoel leyira hu atta bazzeman hazze sheatta ba lissa ol haelohut, aval en ze tachlit ma shechafetz mimmennu asot, ella shezze yaamidennu begeder haahava. ulederech ze yityashshev maamar ma vegomer ki im vegomer, shebbeerech haahava shehi davar hammekuvve tihye hayyira milleta zutarti. uvaggemara sheamru (Megila 25.) atu yira milleta zutarti vechulei, hakkavvana hi kevan shebbeerech massigeha gedola hi lo tikkare ketanna, hagam shebbeerech haahava hi lematta mimmenna, veteretz legabbe moshe vechulei sheggam beerech hammassigim yeshnah begeder katan.

Od yitbaer al ze hadderech, lefi sheyyaale al daat enosh shehaover pi Adonai niflet hi mimmennu hassagat retzono yitbarach, laze amar elav veatta vegomer, perush "veatta" hu teshuva, keamram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 21,6) en "veatta" ella teshuva, "ma Adonai elohecha shoel meimmach" letakken meshuvatcha ki im leyira levad, baze yitratztze Adonai elohecha lecha.

Veamro lalechet bechol derachav vegomer, perush al derech amram zichronam livracha (Vayikra Rabba 21,5): im asita chavillot shel averot, ase kenegdan chavillot shel mitzvot. vechatav rambam beferush hammishnayot (sof massechet makkot): sheim adam lo yachis boro baaverot, hagam shello yaase ella mitzva achat, yesh koach beotah mitzva lezakkoto laolam hazze velaolam habba, ad kan. vehimshalti davar ze lishne avde melech: echad miyyamav lo hichis hammelech uva lirot pene hammelech beven yona lemincha, veechad hichis hammelech uva lirot pene hammelech beshor echad. yesh makom sheyyismach hammelech likrat minchat haof veyichos likrat minchat hashshor, letzad hahachasot shekkadmu mimmennu. vehu amro kan levaal hatteshuva lalechet bechol derachav vegomer, laasot chavillot chavillot shel mitzvot.

Od yechavven hakkatuv lenistarot Adonai al pi divre emet, ki beemtzaut maase hattachtonim yityachadu anfe hakkedushsha, vechen lehefech besod (Mishlei 16:28) "venirgan mafrid alluf" – allufo shel olam. uva lehair kan al haddavar habba mimmaase adam, vehu amro ma Adonai elohecha shoel vegomer, perush bechinat hakkedushsha hannikret "ma" shehi hashshechina, keamram baggemara (sota 11.) befasuk "vattetatztzav achoto" vegomer shekkol hakkatuv medabber bashshechina, veze leshono: "ma" dichtiv "veatta yisrael ma" vegomer, hare shemmizze atzmo mochichim ki "ma" hi hashshechina.

Veze maskim veholech gam ken lema sheheiru otanu rabbotenu zichronam livracha bedivrehem sheamru (tanchuma korach 12) al tikre "ma" ella "mea", shehem mea berachot shehi sod kelalut haasiriyyot, vehismich lezichronam shemo yitbarach shem havaya hu yichud kudesha berich hu ushechinteh, zo hi sheelat elohecha meimmach. vedikdek lomar veatta lehair sheen koach baadam lehassig asot ze ella baolam hazze, aval achar moto hagam sheyyafli asot lo yaase peulla vehaya keechad mehammalachim. umatzinu sherabbotenu zichronam livracha yichasu olam hazze leshaa, keamro (shabbat log:) mannichim chayye olam veoskim bechayye shaa. ulederech ze yityashshev amro ki im leyira kemin chomer, ki beerech hammussag bammusekol ki rav hu yiktan hammifal, hagam shetztzarich hitatztzemut lehassigo, im kol ze mufla hu hannisbav mehattorach.

rashi: Ki ekkach moed. kesheyyesh lanu yom tov, en anu asukim benibbul pe vekallut rosh:
Ani mesharim eshpot. anu notnin el libbenu lehallelcha uleshabbechacha meen hammeora layyom:
targum: Arum eda zimna ana teritzan adun:

rashi: Luchot. luchot ketiv sheshshetehen shavot (tanchuma):
ohc: Ketuvim vegomer vaalehem vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro vaalehem. hinne befarashat tissa (Shemot 31:18) perashti maamar "ketuvim beetzba elohim" shehaya Adonai mechavven etzba elohim keneged halluach betzurat haot, uvaze haya et shekkenegdo nismach latztzedadin venishar makom chakuk, ucheamro "charut al halluchot". ba hakkatuv kan vehodia shemmekom hachakak nechkak mekom halluach, aval gava oro asher notzetz meor etzba elohim haya otiyyot nirot elyonot, hagam shehayu chakukot, vehu amro vaalehem kechol haddevarim asher dibber Adonai vegomer, perush kedimyon shehaya haddibbur notzar mimmenna beriyya kedosha, kemo chen nechtzav bingiat elohim balluach or veala al halluchot, vehaven:

rashi: Im gamalti sholmi ra. im gemaltiv kigmulo:

Vaachalletza tzorri rekam. shichatti et chalitzato becharti et kenaf meilo, im lehashechit ulechalletzo ulehaamido rekam uvesina asiti? ella lehodio, shehaya masur beyadi lehargo velo haragtiv. vaachalletza leshon hafeshata:
targum: In parit livel shelami bish udechaket meikay magan:

rashi: Miharu banayich. lashuv:
targum: Yochun venaychi charvatayich mefagrach umecharbach minich yiglon:

rashi: Hodinu lecha elohim. al hattova hodinu af al haraa, vekarov befinu shimcha tamid (berachot ned.):
Sipperu. dorotenu nifleotecha tamid:
targum: Odena lach Adonai odena vekarev shemach ishteiu ferishvatach:

rashi: Uveaharon hitannaf Adonai. lefi sheshshama lachem:
Lehashemido. ze chilluy banim, vechen hu omer (Amos 2) vaashmid piryo mimmaal:
Vaetpallel gam bead aharon. vehoila tefillati lechapper mechetza, umetu shenayim venisharu hashshenayim:
Vehaya im shamoa. vehaya musav al haamur lemala, limtar hashshamayim tishte mayim:

Vehaya im shamoa tishmeu. im shamoa bayyashan tishmeu bechadash, vechen "im shachoach tishkach" (Devarim 8) – im hitchalta lishkoach sofcha shettishkach kullah, shekken ketiv bimgilla im taazveni yom yomayim eezvekka:
Metzavve etchem hayyom. sheyyihyu alechem chadashim, keillu shematem bo vayyom (sifre):
Leahava et Adonai. shello tomar hare ani lomed bishvil sheehye ashir, bishvil sheekkare rav, bishvil sheakabbel sachar, ella kol ma shettaase ase meahava vesof hakkavod lavo (sham):

Uleovdo bechol levavchem. avoda shehi ballev, vezo hi tefilla, shehattefilla keruya avoda, shenneemar "elahach di ant palach le bitdira" (Daniel 6), vechi yesh pulchan bevavel? ella al shehaya mitpallel shenneemar (sham) "vechavvin petichan le vegomer"; vechen bedavid hu omer (Tehillim 141) "tikkon tefillati ketoret lefanecha":
Bechol levavchem uvechol nafshechem. vahalo kevar hizhir "bechol levavcha uvechol nafshecha" (Devarim 6), ella azhara layyachid, azhara latztzibbur (sifre):
ohc: Vehaya im shamoa vegomer. perush vehaya leshon simcha utenay hu haddavar im tihye simcha shel mitzva, vehu amro im shamoa tishmeu vegomer keamram zichronam livracha (shabbat 30:) shello shibbach shelomo ella simcha shel mitzva, aval shear semachot alehem amar (Kohelet 2:2) "ulesimcha ma zo osa", vechafal lomar shamoa tishmeu al derech amram zichronam livracha (berachot noah.) befasuk (Daniel 2:21) "yahev chachmeta lechakkimin" sheen hakkadosh baruch hu noten chachma ella lemi sheyyesh bo chachma, vehu amro "im shamoa" perush, sheyyihye lachem lev shomea, "tishmeu".

Leahava vegomer uleavdo vegomer venatatti vegomer. perush, lefi ma shekkadam lanu ki sechar mitzvot eno mishtallem baolam hazze, hodia hakkatuv sheim ki sechar mitzvot eno mishtallem baolam hazze, hodia hakkatuv sheim yohavu Adonai vegomer bechol levavam vegomer yizku gam baolam hazze, vehu ma shennitkavven bemaamar "venatatti" betosefet vav lehaircha sheen ze ella tosefet al haikkar shehu sechar olam hannitzchi vehakkayyam. gam ramaz shehagam shehammezonot hu bichlal haddevarim sheenam teluyim bizchut (moed katan koach:), af al pi chen kesheyyaavdu Adonai kammitztarech en hammazzal sholet bahem veyochlu veyisbeu gam mittuv haggashmi.

Bechol levavchem uvechol nafshechem. velo amar "bechol meodchem" keseder sheamar befarashat shema (Devarim 6:5), lefi shepparashat shema neemra belashon yachid veyachol lihyot sheyyimmatze yachid sheyyihye lo mamono chaviv alav minnafsho, aval kelalut hatztzibbur sheimmahem medabber min hannimna sheyyihye lahem mamonam chaviv minnafsham, ki chol asher leish yitten bead nafsho, velaze kesheamar "bechol nafshechem" mikkol shekken bechol meodam.

rashi: Shegar alafecha. valde vekarcha shehannekeva meshaggeret mimmeeha:

Veashterot tzonecha. menachem peresh "abbire vashan" (Tehillim 22) – mivchar hatztzon, kemo "beashterot karnayim" (Bereshit 14), leshon chozek, veunkelos tirgem "veedre anach". verabbotenu amru lamma nikra shemam ashtarot? shemmaashirot et baalehen (chullin 84):
Et yevulah. af ma sheatta movil lah, kainyan shenneemar (Chagai 1) zeratem harebe vehave meat (sifre):

Vaavadtem mehera. al kol shear hayyissurin agle etchen min haadama sheggarma lachem lachato; mashal lemelech sheshshalach beno levet hammishte vehaya yoshev umafkido al tochal yoter mitztzarkecha, shettavo naki levetcha, velo hishgiach habben hahu, achal veshata yoter mitztzarko, veheki vetinnef et kol bene hammesibba, netaluhu veyadav uveraglav uzerakuhu achore palterin (sham):

Mehera. eni noten lachem arka, veim tomru vahalo nittena arka ledor hammabbul shenneemar vehayu yamav mea veesrim shana (Bereshit 6) dor hammabbul lo haya lahem mimmi lilmod veattem yesh lachem mimmi lilmod (sifre):
ohc: Lo titten et yevulah. hagam sheamar "veatzar et hashshamayim", chazar lomar lo titten vegomer, lomar afillu tizreu haadama behameshachat neharot umayanot, lo totzi ma sheattem movilim lah.
Vaavadtem mehera. perush, afilu yimmatze lachem tevua mishshanim kedumot, ucheamram zichronam livracha (gittin 56.) amru alav al ben kalba vegomer.

rashi: Elohim dibber bekadsho. sheemloch veyavo haet veeeloz bidvaro (tehillim 60:8):
Achalleka shechem. achalleka eretz oyvi leyisrael, shechem chelek kemo (Bereshit 48:22) "shechem achad al achecha" (veemek sukkot amadded):
targum: Elaha memalel meatar bet shechinteh avua afaleg bizta im yatve shechem veim yatve meshar sukkot emshach techuma:

rashi: Lemaan yirbu yemechem vime venechem. im asitem ken yirbu, veim lav lo yirbu, sheddivre tora nidrashin mikkelal lav hen umikkelal hen lav (sifre):
Latet lahem. latet lachem en ketiv kan, ella latet lahem, mikkan matzinu lemedim techiyyat hammetim min hattora:
ohc: Lemaan yirbu. kashe lamma lo hikdim maamar ze kodem maamar "uchetavtam", kede sheyyihye maamar "uchetavtam" chozer gam al pasuk "lemaan yirbu"? veulay shennitkavven lehasemich maamar "lemaan yirbu" lemaamar "uchetavtam", lomar shebbischar "uchetavtam" yirbu yemechem, vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (shabbat lev:) kol hazzahir bemitzvat mezuza maarichin lo yamav ushenotav.

rashi: Galmuda. 341 109:
Vesura. museret mikkol adam, hakkol omrim alay: suru mimmenna:
targum: Vetemrin belibbich man rabbi li yat ilen vaana tichla vichida galya umetaltela veilen man rabbi ha ana ishtaaret bilchodi ilen hecha havo:

rashi: Porek. leshon "parku nizme hazzahav" (Shemot 32:2):
targum: Dilma yitabbar hech aryevata nafshi yifshach velet deyiftze:

rashi: Pen tirbe alecha chayyat hassade. vahalo im osin retzono shel makom en mityarin min hachayya, shenneemar (Iyov Adonai) vechayyat hassade hashlema lach? ella galuy haya lefanav sheatidin lachato:
Et Adonai elohecha tira. vetaavod lo vetidbak bo, uleachar sheyyihyu vecha kol hammiddot hallalu, az bishmo tishshavea:

Lo cheeretz mitzrayim hiv. ella tova hemenna, veneemra havetacha zo leyisrael bitziatam mimmitzrayim, shehayu omrim shemma lo navo el eretz tova veyafa kazo. yachol bignutah hakkatuv medabber, vechach amar lahem lo keeretz mitzrayim hi ella raa hemenna? talo "vechevron sheva shanim nivneta lifne vegomer" (Bamidbar 13), adam echad benaan, cham bana tzoan lemitzrayim beno, vechevron lichnaan, derech eretz adam bone et hannae veachar kach bone et haggarua, sheppesalto shel rishon hiv noten bashsheni, uvechol makom hechaviv kodem, ha lamadta shechevron yafa mitztzoan; umitzrayim meshubbachat mikkol haaratzot shenneemar (Bereshit 13) "kegan Adonai keeretz mitzrayim", vetzoan shevach mitzrayim hi shehi mekom malchut, shekken hiv omer (Yeshayahu 30) "ki hayu vetzoan sarav", vechevron pesaltah shel yisrael, lechach hiktzuha lekvurat metim, veaf al pi chen hi yafa mitztzoan. uvichtubbot (daf 112) darshu beinyan acher, efshar adam bone vayit livno hakkatan veachar kach livno haggadol? ella shemmevunna al echad mishshiva betzoan:
Asher yetzatem mishsham. afillu eretz rameses asher yeshavtem bah vehi bemetav eretz mitzrayim, shenneemar "bemetav haaretz vegomer" (Bereshit 47), af hi enah keeretz yisrael:

Vehishkita veraglecha. eretz mitzrayim hayta tzericha lehavi mayim minnilus, beraglecha, ulehashkotah – tzarich atta lindod mishshenatcha velaamol, vehannamuch shote velo haggavoah, veatta maale hammayim min hannamuch laggavoah, aval zo lemittar hashshamayim tishte mayim – atta yashen al mittatcha vehakkabba mashke namuch vegavo galuy vesheeno galuy keechat (sifre):
Kegan hayyarak. sheen day lo vigshamim umashkin oto baregel uvakkatef:
Akar. sheeno molid:
ohc: Baruch tihye vegomer. perush, shello tihye umma gedola mehem. o yirtze al ze hadderech baruch tihye vegomer, uma hi habberacha? shello yihye vegomer. veamro "becha" vegomer, perush shello yimmatze adam akar meatzmo, ucheneged akarut habba al yede choli amar vehesir Adonai mimmecha kol choli hassovev, uvaze tihye nikkeret habberacha shel "lo yihye vecha akar" keshello yihye beyisrael adam sheeno molid.

Od yirtze beamro vehesir vegomer, al derech amram zichronam livracha (ketuvot 30.) hakkol bide shamayim chutz mitztzinnim ufachim vechulei, laze amar "vehesir", perush, leheyot sheenam beyado uvaim al haadam, mavtiach sheyyesirem achar shekkevar bau. ucheneged cholaim habbaim bishlichut amar lo yesimam bach, velaze lo hispik bemaamar "vehesir" vehutzrach lichpol velomar "lo yesimam", velo samach al ma shekkadam lomar "vehesir".

Od ba lehair behakkarat chesed el ki hu hammesir choli miyyisrael, leval yomru ki haddavar ba kefi hatteva, yesh ittim uzemannim sheen cholaim baolam. laze amar vechol madve vegomer lo yesimam becha unetanam bechol vegomer, uvaze taskil ki haddavar ba behashegacha meAdonai veyukkar hannes.
Od yirtze, shehagam sheyyasim Adonai hammadve besonehem – lo yihye hacholi nidbak mehem alehem, hagam sheyyihye choli hannidbak kecholi ratan (avoda zara 13.), yafli Adonai ben yisrael laammim.

rashi: Vehaya ekev tishmeun. im hammitzvot kallot sheadam dash baakevav tishmeun.
Veshamar Adonai vegomer. yishmor lecha havetachato (80 tanchuma):
ohc: Vehaya ekev tishmeun vegomer. tzarich ladaat amro vehaya ma yihye, im hashshemira shehu omer besamuch, lo haya tzarich lomar ella ekev tishmeun veshamar, uma tzorech betevat vehaya? od tzarich ladaat amro ekev velo amar im tishmeun kederech amro (Vayikra 26:3) "im bechukkotay". verabbotenu zichronam livracha darshu (tanchuma) im mitzvot shehaadam dash baakevav tishmeun, veze derech derash.

Veyitbaer al derech amram zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 42,3) en vehaya ella simcha. vehinne adon hanneviim ba benoam devarav lehair bemusar naim ki en laadam lismoach ella kesheyyishmor laasot et kol asher tzivva Adonai laasot, az yismach libbo veyagel kevodo, aval kol od sheyyachush shechaser achat mikkol mitzvot Adonai, ben mitzvot lo taase ben mitzvot ase, alav amar shelomo (Kohelet 2) "ulesimcha ma zo osa". vehu amro vehaya – simcha tihye lecha ekev tishmeun, perush ekev hu sof vetachlit, kederech shemmatzinu sheyyishtammeshu chachamenu zichronam livracha belashon ze bilshon hammishna (sota mat:) beikkevot meshicha vechulei, ki bigmar zeman biato yikkare ikkevot. kemo chen amar ekev tishmeun et hammishpatim ushemartem vaasitem, az hu zeman hassimcha, vechol shello higgia laze en lo makom lismoach, uchemaamar chaside yisrael (chovot hallevavot sear happerishut perek 4) shehapparush evlo belibbo vetzahalato befanav, ki en nachon lismoach mi shehu atid laamod bevusha uchelimma lifne melech haggadol, veen tzarich lomar mi shemmechuyyav rosho lammelech. uchefi ze shiur ekev hu sof shemiat kol hammishpatim.
Od nitkavven lomar sheen simcha laish ella besof hashshemia, vechol od shello gamar adam avodato lo yaamin betzidkot maasav, al derech amro (Iyov 15,15) "hen bikdoshav lo yaamin":
Od nitkavven shetztzarich sheyyilmod hattora besimcha velo beitztzavon, ki divre tora asurin leavel (yore dea siman 384).

Od ramaz al derech amro (tehillim 19:9) "pikkude Adonai yesharim mesammeche lev", vehu amro vehaya – hassimcha tihye ekev tishmeun, uferush ekev – sechar esek hattora tesammechehu, vehu ma sheramaz hattanna beamro (avot 4:2) mitzva goreret mitzva vechulei shessechar mitzva mitzva, shehi hassimcha.

Od ramaz lema sheamru besefer hazzohar (zohar 11 213) veze leshono: delet chedvavta kamme kudsha berich hu keshaata deyisrael mishtaddele beorayta, vehu amro vehaya setam – simcha kelalit lemalle olam, ucheshehu sameach kol haolam besimcha vesason "ekev tishmeun" vegomer. veramaz betevat ekev middat hattora sheyyihye adam holech akev letzad guddal baanava veshiflut, veaz yaskil lishmoa ballimmudim. vehu amro tishmeun, gam bechinnuy lannishmaim, lomar shebbeemtzaut sheadam mesim atzmo kaakevim yitgallu lo veyavin sitre tora.

Veefshar sheramaz beot hannun sheyyassig veyavin chamishshim shaare bina, ulederech ze gezerat hakkatuv hi tishmeun sheim yassig madregat haanava yassig lishmoa divre tora. veamro ushemartem vegomer perush, sheal yede hasekala battora yassig lishmor velaasot, shehattora maggena umatztzela min hachet shehi hashshemira, gam mevia lide kiyyum hammitzvot shehu hammaase.

Veshamar vegomer. amro betosefet vav, ulefi mashmaut hakkatuv hu gezerat haddibbur vehaya tzarich lomar "yishmor Adonai" vegomer, ulefi ma shepperashti bappasuk shellifne ze leechad mehadderachim shehaggezera hi "ekev", uleechad mehadderachim haggezera hi "tishmeun" yavo al nachon amro veshamar betosefet vav.

Lecha et habberit vegomer. kashe, shemmiddevarav kan mashma sheachar sheyyishmeu veyishmeru veyaasu kol hammishpatim, baze yizku lishmor lahem havetachato. umimma sheamar befarasha zo atzmah (Devarim 9:5) "lo vetzidkatcha vegomer ki berishat vegomer ulemaan hakim" vegomer – ze yaggid shehagam sheen lahem tzedaka, behechreach sheyyekayyem Adonai et hashshevua. veze lecha haot ki lo betzidkato ba veyarash ma sheyyarash. veulay ki kenisatam laaretz hayta bishvil shevuat haavot, utenay hu haddavar – im yishmeru veyaasu, yishmor Adonai hammattana leolam vaed, vehu amro kan veshamar Adonai, veim lo yishmeru, tihye kiyyum hashshevua bazzeman hammuat shennichnesu laaretz vishallechem lenafsham.

Od yitbaer al ze hadderech, lefi shehavetachat avraham matzinu sheamar lo shene havetachot: 1 lehotziam mimmitzrayim viviam el eretz kenaan, dichtiv (Bereshit 15:14) "veachare chen yetzu birchush gadol vedor revii yashuvu henna", 2 latet lo minnehar mitzrayim ad nehar perat veeser ummot. vehen atta, hagam shello hayu tzaddikim kammitztarech, keamro "lo vetzidkatcha" vegomer, af al pi chen kiyyem Adonai livnehem havetacha rishona shehotziam mimmitzrayim veheviam el haaretz vehinchilam shiur hammaspik. vahalo timtza sheafillu shiur hatztzarich lahem lo nachalu, shehare bene yosef omdim vetzovchim shello hispikam nachalatam (Yehoshua 17:14), hare sheadayin lo higgia leyadam havetachat minnehar mitzrayim ad nehar perat veeser ummot. laze amar moshe vehaya ekev tishmeun vegomer veshamar Adonai vegomer et habberit vegomer, perush latet minnehar mitzrayim veeser ummot bishlemut.

O efshar lomar ki al sheva ummot omer et habberit, veal tashlum haasara hu omer veet hachesed, ki mattenat hashshalosh hu chesed mufla shehem millevad eretz kenaan. vehammaskil al davar yire ki hem kelalut rov haolam, ki edom ammon umoav hem pinna gedola, uma gam ledivrehem zichronam livracha (yoma 10.) sheamru atida malchut edom shettitpashshet bechol haolam. meatta yesh bemattana zo kol haolam bichlal vechesed muflag yikkare, vealav hu omer "veet hachesed". veteda shekken hu, shehare adayin lo zachu yisrael lahavetacha hannizkeret, veotah anu mevakshim umetzappim lehanechil elyon lanu goyim rabbim.

Od yirtze al ze hadderech: vehaya ekev tishmeun vegomer, lo titztarchu lizkot betuv Adonai uvechasdo mitztzad shevuat haavot, ella tizku mitztzad atzmechem lishmor Adonai lachem habberit vegomer shennishba laavotechem, ki eno dome habba lizkot bishvil atzmo kemo lizkot bishvil avotav. vehu sheddikdek lomar lecha et habberit velo amar "veshamar lecha Adonai elohecha" vegomer, shennitkavven lehasemich tevat "lecha" im tevat "habberit" lehaircha lidvarenu. ulederech ze amro veshamar, perush, shekkol havetachot Adonai, veen tzarich lomar berito, hem betuchim ushemurim leolam vaed. udevarim ellu kenim hem, shehalo avraham zacha lechol hakkavod letzad maasav, veim yisrael yishmeru torat Adonai lamma yiggaru lavo bechoach zechut avot? veadrabba, shellahem gadol mishshel avotehem, ki hem amdu al har sinay, vegam heyotam metzuvvim battora uvammitzvot ma sheen ken haavot shello nittena lahem hattora. umeatta gadol koach habbanim kesheyyetivu maasehem mikkoach haavot.

rashi: Vehamam. nakud kamatz kullo, lefi sheen mem acharona min hayesod, vahare hu kemo veham otam, aval "vehamam gilgal eglato" (Yeshayahu 28) kullo yesod, lefichach chetzyo kamatz vechetzyo pattach, kishar poal shel shalosh otiyyot:
Natan li leshon limmudim. yeshaya haya omer: Adonai shelachani vnatan li lashon harauy lelammed, kede ladaat laut et haayefim utzemeim lishmoa et divre hakkadosh baruch hu davar:
Laut. menachem chibbero bemachaloket "et laasot laAdonai" (tehillim 119:126), likboa lahem ittim:
Yair li ozen. meorer et azni beruach kadsho:
Lishmoa kallimmudim. bemishpat hallimmudim, haemet vehannechocha:
targum: Adonai elohim yehav li leshan demalfin lehodaa alfa letzadikaya dimshalhan lefitgame orayta chuchema vechen bitzfar bitzfar makdim leshalacha neviohi maim yitpatchan udene chayavaya vikabbelun ulefan:

rashi: Techolelchem. asher teled etchem:

Ki echad kerativ. ki echad haya, yechidi beeretz kenaan asher higletiv sham meartzo umimmoladto, kerativ – ribbitiv vegiddaltiv, leshon "kerie haeda" (Bamidbar 1:16), ucheshem shehu haya yachid vegiddaltiv, ken agaddel etchem sheattem yechidim li:
targum: Istakkalu beavraham avuchon uvesara deadiatchon are chad hava avraham yechidi bealma karevte lefulechani uverachte veasgete:

rashi: Al tomar bilvavcha. tzidkati verishat haggoyim garmu:
ohc: Al tomar vegomer. kashe, bishlama ma shetztzivva beval yomru betzidkatam matzinu shessetaro bidvarav, ella maamar "uverishat" hare gam hu maskim veholech keamro besamuch "ki berishat" vegomer, veim ken lamma yetzavve lahem beval tomar. veulay shechash sheyyachshevu shello asar lahem maamar "betzidkati" ella keshello yigmeru omer "uverishat", aval kesheyyomru gam ken "uverishat" vegomer en issur hagam sheyyomru "betzidkati", talmud lomar "al tomar betzidkati" hagam shettigmeru omer "uverishat" vegomer.

rashi: Vaetnappal lifne Adonai karishona arbaim yom. shenneemar (Shemot 32) veatta eele el Adonai ulay achappera, beotah aliyya nitakkavti arbaim yom, nimtzeu chalim becht beav, shehu ala bishmona asar betammuz, bo vayyom nitratztza leyisrael veamar lo lemoshe pesal lecha shene luchot (sham 34) asa od arbaim yom, nimtzeu chalim beyom hakkippurim, bo vayyom nitratztza hakkabba leyisrael besimcha veamar lo lemoshe salachti kidvarecha (Bamidbar 14), lechach hukba limchila velislicha, uminnayin shennitratztza veratzon shalem, shenneemar baarbaim shel luchot acharonot (Devarim 10) veanochi amadti vahar kayyamim harishonim, ma harishonim beratzon af haacharonim beratzon, emor meatta emtzaiyyim hayu bechaas:
Baet hahiv hivdil Adonai vegomer. musav lainyan harishon:

Baet hahiv, bashshana harishona letzetchem mimmitzrayim, uteitem baegel uvene levi lo tau, hivdilam hammakom mikkem; vesamach mikra ze lachazarat bene yaakan lomar sheaf bezo lo tau vah bene levi ella amdu beemunatam:
Laset et aron. haleviyim:
Laamod lifne Adonai lesharto ulevarech bishmo. hakkohanim, vehu nesiat kappayim (arachin 11):
Al tashchet. et yisrael (315 75:1):
targum: Leshabbacha vizman di amar david la techabbel amach tushebachta al yedoy deasaf shira:

rashi: Hatztzira. min sheretz haof shehayta zoreket bahem mara umesarastan umesammea et enehem bechol makom shehayu nistarin sham (sota 36):

ohc: Venatan malchehem beyadecha. perush bachayyim chayyutam, keamro (Yehoshua 10:23) "vayyotziu elav et chameshet hammelachim haelle el yehoshua".

rashi: Binu boarim baam. ketzat shotim shebbaolam:
targum: Hitbonnu deshatyan beama uchesilaya ematay taskilun:
Vaamaru la yecheme yah vela yitbayen elaha deyaakov:
Itgabbar lama tehi chigvar damich Adonai itar elahana la titneshi lealma:
Hala al dechavna kodam Adonai shevaktana vela nafka shechinteh bechelvetana:
Kidnan amar Adonai eda hi igrat piturin dihavet lichnishtechon are itrachakat o min gevar dele chova kodamay dezabbenet yatchon le ha vechovechon izdabbantun uvemardechon itrachakat kenishatchon:
Adonai elohay bememrach sabberit perok yati mikkol radfay ufetza yati:
Vihon malchaya turebyanach umalkevathon yeshamshunich al appehon al ara yishtatchun lemive minich vaafar riglach yelachachun vetedin are ana Adonai dela yivhatun tzadikaya dimsavrin lefurekani:
Lama shechinat yekarach tesalek tishle segufena vedochakana:
Dili gilad dili menashe gibbarin devet efrayim ushena dereshi umidvet yehuda safre:
Zekufi yerushelem sechor sechor enach vachaza kol bene am galvatich mitkanshin veatan legavich keyam ana amar Adonai are chulehon lich kilvush dikar veovadehon begavich kekishut kalata:
Arum shicha leafra nafshana davkat learit guva mayenana:
Yehe radef beel devava nafshi veyadbek veyichbosh leara chayay vikari leafra yashre lealmin:

bart: Arbaa rashe shanim hen. lammelachim. malche yisrael monin lahem minnisan. sheim malach melech bishvat o baadar, mishshehiggia nisan kalta lo shana umatchilin limnot lo shana sheniyya. umikkera nafka lan deminnisan maninan lehu, dichtiv (Melachim 1 6) vayhi vishmonim shana vearba meot shana letzet bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim bashshana harviit bechodesh ziv hu hachodesh hashsheni limloch shelomo al yisrael, mekish malchut shelomo litziat mitzrayim, ma yetziat mitzrayim minnisan maninan la, af lemalchut shelomo minnisan maninan la. ulemalche ummot haolam monin mittishre, vehayenu ditnan lekamman besamuch beechad betishre rosh hashshana lashshanim, kelomar lashshanim shel malche ummot haolam. venafka minna, lefi shergilin limnot zeman shetarot lishnot hammelech mishshana sheamad bah, mishshum shelom malchut. veim amad melech baadar vechatav lo hassofer benisan shelleachar shelosha asar chodesh, nisan shel shana sheniyya, kevan denisan rosh hashshana lammelachim, hava leh shetar mukdam ufasul, mishshum dehay nisan shel shana shelishit hu, veshitre chov hammukdamim pesulim, lefi shennimtza toref lakochot shellakchu hassade min hallove ben zemanno shel shetar lizman hahalvaa, shello kedin, shehare kadma mechira lahalevaa. lefichach kenasuhu leabbed gam mizzeman hahalvaa vaelach, vela gave mimmeshabede:

Velargalim. hachi kaamar, regel shebbo shehu pesach, rosh hashshana largalim leinyan hannoder, sheim avru alav shelosha regalim mishshennadar velo kiyyem nidro over al bal teacher. verabbi shimon omer sheeno over al bal teacher ad sheyyaavru alav shalosh regalim kesidran, vechag hammatztzot techilla, kemo shehen sedurim bammikra (Devarim 16). bechag hammatztzot uvechag hashshavuot uvechag hassukkot. ufesak halacha, mishsheyaavor alav regel echad bilvad velo hevi nidro over baase, dichtiv (sham 12) uvata shamma vahavetem shamma olotechem vegomer, regel rishon sheatta ba atta tzarich lehavi. umishsheyyaavru alav shalosh regalim over al bal teacher. veen halacha kerabbi shimon devae shalosh regalim kesidran:

Rosh hashshana lemasar behema. sheen measserim min hannoladim beshana zo al hannoladim bachavertah, dichtiv (Devarim 14) asser teasser, bishte maasrot hakkatuv medabber, echad maasar dagan veechad maasar behema, veamar kera shana shana, velo mishshana zo al shel chavertah:

Verabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim beechad betishre. kevan deittakash maasar behema lemaasar dagan, ma maasar dagan rosh hashshana shello tishre, af maasar behema rosh hashshana shello tishre. veen halacha kerabbi elazar verabbi shimon [deamre] beechad betishre. vetanna kamma savar kevan deittakash maasar behema lemaasar dagan dichtiv asser teasser, ma dagan samuch legamro issuro, shehare rosh hashshana shello tishre vehu samuch legamro, shekkol yemot [hachamma] omed baggoren lehityabbesh, af maasar behema nammi samuch legamro issuro, dehaynu echad beelul, shehabbehemot yoldot beav sheaz nigmar zeman ibburan, dehachi yalfinan mikkera, dichtiv (tehillim 65) lavshu karim hatztzon vaamakim yaatfu bar, ematay lavshu karim hatztzon, kelomar shemmitlabbeshot mehazzecharim haolim alehem umitabberot, bizman shehaamakim yaatfu bar, dehaynu baadar shehazzeria tzomachat venikkeret yafe. veyoldot beav, dizman ibburah shel behema dakka chamishsha chodashim, hilkach rosh hashshana shel maasar behema beechad beelul, samuch legamro:
Lashshanim. lishne malche ummot haolam, kedifrishit leel:
Velashshemittin velayyovlot. mishshennichnas tishre asur lacharosh velizroa min hattora:

Velannetia. im nata ilan arbaim vachamishsha yom kodem echad betishre, shehem shete shabbatot lakkelita, shehannetia nikletet bishte shabbatot, usheloshim yom achar hakkelita lehechashev shana, dishloshim yom bashshana chashuvim shana, hare arbaim vachamishsha yom, kesheyyaggia echad betishre monin lah shana sheniyya mishshenot haarla, uletishre shel shana haacheret monin lah shana shelishit, uleachar shana shelishit kesheyyaggia echad betishre shel shana reviit, im chantu bintia zo perot, adayin hem asurim mishshum arla, sheaf al pi shettishre rosh hashshana lannetia, chamishsha asar bishvat rosh hashshana lailan, veze kevar naasa ilan, lefichach en shenato mitchaddeshet latzet mide arla ad chamishsha asar bishvat, umishsham vaelach im yachnetu bo perot hem torat revai alehen leachlan birushalayim, uvachamishsha asar bishvat leshana habbaa yetzu mide revai perot hachontim bah mikkan vaelach:
Velayrakot. lemaaser yarak, sheen tormin min hayyarak shennilkat lifne rosh hashshana al hayyarak hannilkat leachar rosh hashshana:

Rosh hashshana lailan. leinyan maasar perot, sheen measserin perot ilan shechantu kodem shevat al shechantu leachar shevat, divilan azlinan batar chanata. i nammi nafka minneh leinyan shana shelishit shel shemita shennoheg bah maasar ani, sheotan perot shechantu merosh hashshana shel shana shelishit ad shevat danin otan keferot shel shana sheniyya sheavra, venoheg bahen maaser rishon umaaser sheni, umishshevat vaelach noheg bahen maaser rishon umaasar ani:

Mashshilin perot derech arubba. mi sheyyesh lo perot o tevua shatuach al gaggo lehityabbesh veraa geshamim memashmeshim uvaim, hittiru lo litroach ulehashlich derech arubba shebbaggag vehem noflim laaretz, delekka tircha yetera. vedavka arubba, dechol arubba millemala lematta [betikrat haggag], aval challon kegon gag shemmukkaf mechitztzot vechallon bakkotel vetzarich lehagebiho ad hachallon ulehashlicho, kulle hay lo sharu rabbanan lemitrach:
Umechassin et happerot. velo amrinan torach shello letzorech yom tov hu, demishshum hefsed mamon sharu leh rabbanan:
Delef. geshamim hannotfim min haggag:
Vechen kadde yayin vechadde shamen. mechassin otan mippene haddelef:
Tachat haddelef. lekabbel et hammayim shello yetannefu habbayit. veim nitmalle hakkeli shofech veshone veeno nimna:
Kemin saara. sear:
Yavchushin. yattushin:
Tattil lammayim. poshrin, veyashhe otam bammayim happoshrim esrim vearba shaot:
Im nimmochu temea. mishshum nidda. dedam hu:
Im yesh immahen dam temea veim lav tehora. matnitin kerabbanan diflige aleh derabbi yehuda leel, vesavre deefshar liftichat hakkever belo dam:

Vachachamim omrim kol sheen bo mitztzurat adam eno valad. hakkol modim benolad gufo ketzurat chayya ufanav pene adam, shehu chashuv valad. gufo adam ufanav pene chayya, hare hu chayya veen ze valad, devatar tzurat panim azlinan. lo nechleku ella bemi shekketzat panav kifne adam, uketzat kifne behema, vaafillu rov panav kifne adam veayin achat shebberosho bilvad keayin shel behema, rabbi meir omer, kol tzurat adam tzericha, vechevan sheyyesh lo ayin kivhema en ze valad. verabbanan savre, kol sheen bo mitztzurat adam kelal vaafillu miktzat tzura en lo, eno valad. aval yesh bo miktzat tzura, hare ze valad. vahalacha kachachamim:
En potchin et hanner. littol echad min habbetzim shel yotzer cheres velitchov egrofo letocho lachkok ner, mippene sheose keli:
Veen osin pechamin. deinhu nammi keli ninhu letzorfe zahav, ufetila nammi keli hi lehadelaka, shetztzericha asiyya vetikkun:
Veen chotchin otah lishnayim. lefi shehu metakken keli. ulemaachah bayyad muttar:

Chotchah baur. noten shene rashe happetila befi shete nerot shetztzarich lehadelikan keachat umadlik baemtza, dehashta lo muchach diltikkuna mana mechavven ella lehadelaka bealma. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hora chohen mashiach. kohen gadol hammashuach beshemen hammishcha hora hetter leatzmo veasa maase beatzmo bedavar shechayyavim al zedono karet:
Mitkapper lo vifne atzmo. chayyav lehavi par bifne atzmo:
Hora im hatztzibbur. shehaya hu echad min hassanhedrin sheshshaggu behoraa:

Mitkapper lo im hatztzibbur. befar helem davar shel tzibbur, veeno tzarich karban acher. desalka datach amena ki hechi divyom hakkippurim en mitkapper im hatztzibbur, deha chetiv (Vayikra 16) veshachat et par hachattat asher lo, hacha nammi yihye tzarich karban bifne atzmo, kamashma lan dela. venafka lan mikkera dichtiv (sham 4) al chattato asher chata, bechet hameyuchad lo mevi karban bifne atzmo, uvechet sheeno meyuchad lo eno mevi karban bifne atzmo:

Sheen bet din chayyavim. kelomar, din hu shehammashiach mitkapper im hatztzibbur, shehare en bet din chayyavin vechulei, vechen hammashiach, alma hushva hammashiach levet din bechol inyanav, im ken keshehora im hatztzibbur din hu sheyyihye shave latztzibbur veyitkapper im hatztzibbur:

Velo vaavoda zara ad sheyyoru levattel miktzat. lefi shenneemar bishar mitzvot (Vayikra 4) venelam davar meene hakkahal, veneemar baavoda zara (Bamidbar 15) vehaya im meene haeda vegomer, ma bishar mitzvot venelam davar velo kol hagguf, af baavoda zara davar velo kol hagguf:
Shefir. chaticha shel basar. veim yesh bah tzurat adam nikra shefir merukkam. vaani shamati shehu kishfoferet shel betza, lefichach nikra shefir:
Male genunim. male gevanim harebe. perush acher, geninim, tolaim, shechatichat habbasar chatucha chatichot dakkot keen tolaim:
Enah chosheshet levalad. veenah temea leda. veim en immahen dam, enah chosheshet afillu mishshum nidda:

Teshev lezachar velinkeva. temea shevuayim keyoledet nekeva, veen lah dam tohar ella sheloshim ushelosha yamim keyoledet zachar. hoil veeno nikkar im zachar im nekeva, notnim alav chumre zachar vechumre nekeva:
Meviin par. haamur bevayyikra vehikrivu hakkahal par:

Uvaavoda zara meviim par vesair. veim horu lehattir beissur avoda zara, meviin par vesair haamur befarashat shelach lecha, vechi tishgu velo taasu et kol hammitzvot haelle, mitzva shehi shekula keneged kol hammitzvot, heve omer zo avoda zara, uchetiv hatam (sham 15) vehaya im meene haeda neesta lishgaga veasu chol haeda par ben bakar echad leola vegomer‏ useir izzim echad lechattat. verabbi meir savar, hay vehikrivu hakkahal, par haamur bevayyikra beshiggat shear averot, vechen veasu chol haeda, par useir haamur bishlach lecha beshiggat avoda zara, hakkahal shehora bilvad hen hammeviim otam, vehen bet din haggadol:
Shenem asar shevatim meviin. desavar rabbi yehuda kol shevet veshevet ikre kahal, shenneemar (divrei hayamim 2 20) vayyaamod yehoshafat bikhal yehuda:
Shelosha asar parim. desavar rabbi shimon sheen bet din sheshshaggu behoraa mitkapperim befarim useirim shel hashshevatim, ella chayyavim lehavi par vesair leatzmam:

Shiva shevatim. shehem rov minyan shel shevatim, af al pi shehen miut yisrael, o rov minyan yisrael veaf al pi sheyyihyu mimmiut minyan hashshevatim, vaafillu asa shevet echad vehu rov yisrael, meviin kol shear hashshevatim shello chatu al yede ellu hachotim:
Shemona farim. desavar rabbi shimon sheen otan shello chatu meviim al yede hachotim. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Veasa oto shevet. leatzmo, veen kan rov minyan yisrael velo rov hashshevatim:
Vachachamim omrim en chayyavim vechulei. vahalacha kachachamim:

Keragle hashshoel. shehare kana shevitato etzlo ben hashshemashot, deven hashshemashot shehu kenisat hayyom kone shevita. vaafillu lo ba leyad hashshoel ella beyom tov, delav birshuteh kayyamin beven hashshemashot, hare ellu keraglav shel shoel. veim shealo beyom tov mishshechashcha, hare hen keragle hammashil, lefi shekkana shevita etzel bealav. vaafillu haya ragil lehasheil bechol yom tov:
Haishsha sheshshaala mechavertah tevalin. likderatah:
Umayim umelach. leissatah:
Hare ellu. hakkedera vehaissa:
Keragle shetehen. en molichin otan ella bemakom sheshshetehen yecholot lelech. dechevan divyom tov shaala, kanu hattavlin o hammayim vehammelach shevita etzel baalehen:

Sheen bahem mammash. en nikkarot lo bakkedera velo baissa, kegon shehattavshil ave veen hammayim nikkarim bah, hilkach en meakkevot holachatan. uvemelach lo falig rabbi yehuda, demayre beissa shennillosha bemelach shehi gassa veava, shehi nikkeret veyesh bah mammash. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hafoch bah vahafoch bah. battora:
Decholla vah. shehakkol timtza bah:
Vesiv uvele vah. gam ad zikna veseva lo taazvenna:

Uminna lo tazua. shello tomar lamadti chachmat yisrael elech veelmad chachmat yevanit, sheen muttar lilmod chachmat yevanit ella bemakom sheasur lehareher bedivre tora, kegon bevet hammerchatz o bevet hakkisse. sheshshaalu et rabbi yehoshua mahu lelammed adam et beno chachmat yevanit, amar lahem yelammedennu beshaa sheeno lo yom velo layla, deha ketiv vehagita bo yomam valayla:

Benot kutim niddot mearisatan. mikkatnutan, keshehen munnachot baarisa, gazru behu rabbanan delitammu mishshum nidda, dichtiv (Vayikra 15) veishsha ki tihye zava, vetanya, en li ella ishsha shehi gedola, tinoket bat yom echad lenidda minnayin, talmud lomar veishsha. vechutim lo darshe ishsha veishsha, vechi chazyan ketannot lo mafreshe lehu, hilkach gazru behu rabbanan delitammu kullehu:

Metammein mishkav hattachton kaelyon. tachtono shel boel nidda tame keelyono shel zav, ma elyono shel zav eno metamme ella ochalin umashkin, af tachtono shel boel nidda eno metamme ella ochalin umashkin. veelyono shel zav, hu haddavar hannissa al gabbe hazzav nafka lan mikkera deeno metamme adam vechelim ella ochalim umashkim, dichtiv (Vayikra 15) vehannogea bechol asher yihye tachtav yitma, may tachtav, ilema tachtav dezav, mikkol asher yigga bemishkavo nafka, ella hannogea bechol asher yihye hazzav tachtav yitma, umiddelo arvinhu venichtov vechol hannogea bechol asher yihye tachtav vehannose otam yechabbes begadav, veafsekinhu beyitma, mikkelal dehay yitma lav beadam vechelim ayre, ella beochalim umashkim. vechutim shehen boale niddot, metammeim mishkav hattachton shellahen ochalin umashkin, aval lo adam vechelim, keelyono shel zav sheggam hu metamme ochalim umashkim lo adam vechelim. vechol haddevarim hallalu lo neemru ella bizman shehayu hakkutim machazikim battora umedakdekim beharebe mitzvot keyisrael. aval leachar shebbadku umatzu lahem kidmut yona berosh har gerizim sheovdim otah, asaum kenachrim gemurim lechol divrehem, ben leinyan tuma vetohora, ben lishar dinim shebbattora, en hefresh benam leven hannachrim kelal:

Vehen yoshvot al kol dam. kelomar, lefichach hakkutim hem boale niddot, lefi shehen yoshvot al kol dam, dechol dam sheroa ben adom ben yarok yoshevet alav yeme niddut, vezo takkala hi lahem, sheim roa dam yarok hayyom matchelet limnot mehayyom shivat yeme nidda, veim tire beotam yeme niddut dam adom, enah mona ella miyyom reiyya rishona, veoto dam tahor haya, umeriyya sheniyya hi tzericha limnot:
Veen chayyavin alehen. hallovesh o mitkasse beotan begadim venichnas lammikdash, patur mikkarban. o im nagu otan begadim shel mishkav shellahen batteruma, tolin:

Mippene shettumatan safek. delo yadinan i nidda [hi] i lo. uvaggemara parech ammatnitin meha ditnan bemassechet tohorot perek 4‏ (mishna 5) al shishsha sefekot sorfin et hatteruma, al sefek bigde am haaretz, kelomar al bigde am haaretz im nagu bah, nisrefet, mishshum shemma tame haya, vehay kuti nammi teppuk leh im naga mishkavo batteruma, tehe nisrefet, mishshum deam haaretz hu vahave leh bigde am haaretz. umeshane, dematnitin ayre bechuti shettaval befanenu veala vedaras al begadav shel chaver keshehu arom, o shellavash bigde chaver, o shehitbil et begadav befanav, beofen divgadav shel kuti keshehen midras lo nagu bivgadav shel chaver kesheddaras alehen, veachar kach nagu begadav shel chaver sheddaras kuti alehen batteruma, lo sarfinan teruma alehen. dei mishshum tumat am haaretz, ha tavel leh. vei mishshum boel nidda, shemma lo baal bekarov uchevar avru yeme tumato vesalka leh tevila. veim timtza lomar baal bekarov, shemma lo hayta ishto yoshevet al dam tame ella al dam tahor, vehave sefek sefeka, veassefek sefeka lo sarfinan teruma:
Mitkaddeshet bevia. im mesarah aviha lechach:
Veim ba aleha yavam kenaah. lihyot ishto lechol davar, veyorshah umittamme lah vezacha benichse achiv:
Vechayyavin aleha mishshum eshet ish. im kibbel bah aviha kiddushin meechad, uva aleha acher, neherag aleha, deviatah bia:
Umetammea et boalah. im hi nidda. aval pachot mikkan, af al pi shehi metammea bemagga, enah metammea et boalah mishshum boel nidda letumat shiva, ella mishshum nogea uletumat erev:
Tachton. shel boel nidda:
Keelyono. shel zav, shemmetamme ochalin umashkin velo adam vechelim:
Min happesulin. kegon nachri, veeved, venatin, mamzer, o chalal:
Pesalah. mitterumat aviha, im hi bat kohen:
Mikkol haarayot. kegon aviha o chamiha:
Vehi fetura. mippene shehi ketanna veenah bat onashim:
Kenoten etzba baayin. sheddomea vechozer lichmot shehaya, af kan chozeret betula kemo shehayta:
Hammappelet. im yesh immah dam temea. nidda:
Veim lav tehora. desavar tanna kamma, efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam. vaafillu nimtza dam betoch hachaticha, tehora, dedam chaticha hu velo dam nidda:
