Rabbi yehuda omer ben kach uven kach temea. desavar rabbi yehuda i efshar liftichat hakkever belo dam. vechevan shehippila chaticha, vadday dam haya sham ella sheavad bemiuto velo nira. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Bechor shennafal levor. bechor baal mum shello herahu lechacham meerev yom tov mibbeod yom lehattiro, venafal levor beyom tov veyare shemma yamut sham:
Yered mumche. shebbaki lehavechin ben mum kavua lemum over:
Veyire. mum shehaya bo etmol, im mum kavua hu:
Yaale veyishchot. demishshum muktze lekka, demeetmol dateh illaveh:

Veim lav lo yishchot. hachi kaamar, veim lav, deoto mum shehaya bo meerev yom tov lo haya kavua ella hayyom naasa bo mum kavua, afillu avar veheelahu lo yishchot. velo amrinan meetmol hava dateh illaveh vechevan sheyyesh bo achshav mum kavua nishchateh, dehoil vehammum shel etmol lo haya kavua, muktze mechamat issur hava:

En ze min hammuchan. lav mishshum muktze asar leh, deha let leh lerabbi shimon muktze, ella mippene shemmattiro beyom tov hava leh kimtakkeno, venire kedan din, degazur beh mishshum shevut. vehachi kaamar, en hattarato hetter, veeno muchan lihyot kasher:
Kol hannashim bechezkat tohora levaalehen. veen tzarich lishol lah im hi tehora. vehane mile, keshehinnichah bechezkat tehora:
Habbain min hadderech neshehen lahen bechezkat tohora. desalka datach amena hane mile hecha deiteh bemata, deramya annafsha uvadka, aval hecha deleteh bemata, delo ramya annafsha, lo, kamashma lan:
Shene iddim al kol tashmish. echad lefanav veechad leacharav, ulemachar teayyen bahem:
O teshammesh leor hanner. vetivdok leachar tashmish ed shekkinnecha bo:

Dayyah bishne iddim kol hallayla. echad lifne tashmish rishon, veechad leachar tashmish acharon. veaf al gav demishmesha velo yada i raata dam bene uvene, ben levet shammay ben levet hillel lo ichpat lan, delo hutzrechu ella lechomer tohorot:
Pershu lalechet bedarche yisrael hare hen keyisreeliyyot. aval setama, hare hen kakkutiyyot:
Rabbi yose omer leolam hen keyisrael. usetama hen keyisreeliyyot. veen halacha kerabbi yose:
Nimtza dam al shello. afillu shaha zeman aroch leachar beila kodem kinnuach, beyadua shehaya dam bishat tashmish:
Temein. shenehem, tumat shiva, kedin boel nidda:
Otyom. techef. veen lo dome bammishna:
Temeim missafek. shenehem temeim shiva yamim, umihu tumat safek hi litlot aval lo lisrof:
Ufeturim min hakkarban. mechattat kavua, aval chayyavim beasham taluy:
Hammevi. mimmakom lemakom. betoch hattechum:
Lo yeviem vechulei. latet shalosh vearba kaddot betoch sal o kuppa veyissaem, mishshum denire kemaase chol laset massaot. veim i efshar lo leshannot muttar:
Aval mevi hu al ketefo. echad o shenayim, demuchach diltzorech yom tov:
O lefanav. beyado:
Vechen hammolich et hatteven. lehessek o livhema:
Lo yafshil kuppa laachorav. shennire kederech chol:
Umatchilin baaremat hatteven. veaf al pi shello zimmenah mibbeod yom velo haya ragil lehassik mimmenna, delet leh lehay tanna muktze:

Aval lo vaetzim [shebbammuktze]. rechava sheachore habbattim keruya muktze, al shem shehi muktza leachor veen nichnasim veyotzim lah tadir. vehanach etzim deayre behu hacha hen korot gedolot shel arazim haomdot levinyan, demuktze mechamat chesron kis ninhu, sheddemehen yekarim, uveha afillu rabbi shimon delet leh muktze mode:
Vetadiach et paneha. kinnuach shellematta:
Veachar kach. kelomar im shahata yoter mishshiur ze:
Metammea meet leet. tohorot shennitasseka bahen. kedin meet leet deamrinan beferek kamma:
Veenah metammea et boalah. tumat shiva, ella tumat erev kedin kol nogea benidda:
Rabbi akiva omer af metammea et boalah. desavar rabbi akiva kol meet leet metammea et boalah tumat shiva missafek. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:

Umodim chachamim lerabbi akiva beroa chetem. veaf al gav divtumat meet leet amru chachamim sheenah metammea et boalah lefi shettumat meet leet enah ella midderabbanan, modim hem beroa ketem, deaf al gav detumat ketamim derabbanan, metammea et boalah tumat shiva:
Keragle habbealim. en adam yachol leholichah beyom tov ella bemakom shebbealeha yecholim lelech:

O leroe hare ellu cheragle habbealim. matnitin kesheyyesh bair shene roim, delo yadinan lehe minnayhu haveya la daat bealim, hilkach hare hen keragle habbealim im enah etzel haroe mibbeod yom. aval kesheen bair ella roe echad, kol bene hair maamidin behemtan birshuto uvikniyyat shevitato, vehaveya la keragle haroe:
Vesheenan meyuchadim. leechad mehen, ella lechullan:

Hare ellu chimkom sheholchin. limkom shekkullan yecholin lelech muttar leholich et hakkelim. aval im erev echad mehen lesof alpayim latztzafon vehashshear lo ervu, hu meakkev al yadam milleholichah laddarom afillu pesia achat mippene chelko, vehen meakkevin al yado milleholichah latztzafon ella alpayim amma shehen muttarin bahen:
Lefum tzaara agra. kefi rov hatztzaar sheatta sovel belimmud hattora vaasiyyat hammitzva, yihye secharcha merubbe:
Veen chotchin et hanneyar. shennotnin bo shemen, veomed bifne haesh kol zeman shehashshemen betocho, veeno nisraf: maliach. dag
Maliach. dag:
En gorfin tannur vechirayim. im nafal letochan mittefulah shel tannur umin hattiach, en gorfin otan, dimtakken mana hu. veatya kerabbanan deamre machshire ochel nefesh asire:
Mechabbeshin. mashkivin et haefer veet heafar kede sheyyihye chalak. veim i efshar lo leefot ella im ken garaf, muttar:
Makkifin. mekarvin zo etzel zo. kemo en makkifin berea:
Lishpot. laaroch ulehoshiv alehem kedera, vehaur ben shete hechaviyyot. veasar la mishshum dedame levinyan:
[Veen somchin] et hakkedera vevakkaat. delo nittenu etzim ella lahassaka. uvekaat, etzim shennitbaku:
Vechen haddelet. en somchin otah bivkaat, deetzim muktzim hem etzel kol tashmish chutz min hahassaka:
Veen manhigim et habbehema bemakkel. mishshum denire kemolichah limkor bashshuk:
Sandal. chatichat basar asuya kidmut lashon shel shor. umippene sheyyesh lah tzurat sandal korin lah sandal. vehu ragil lavo im valad. veyesh mefarshim, sandal, sanouy (valad) [vedal]:
Shilya. kemin kerum shehavvalad munnach betochah. utechillatah kechut shel erev. ucheshehi holechet verovachat, rechava keturmos, vachalula kachatzotzeret. veen shilya pechuta mittefach:
Habbayit tame. mishshum ohel hammet, devalad hava bah umet:
Nimmok havvalad. venaasa dam venitarev bedam halleda uvatel berov, veen habbayit tame. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:
Mittammea venidda. im raata dam:

Bat asara yamim mittammea veziva. im raata shelosha yamim retzufim leachar shiva. dechol dam sheroa betoch shiva dam nidda hu, hilkach i efshar lah littame bazziva dehaynu lihyot zava gedola, ad asara yamim:
Tinok ben yom echad mittamme veziva. dichtiv (sham 15) ish ish ki yihye zav, limmed al tinok ben yomo shemmittamme beziva:
Umittamme vingaim. degabbe negaim ketiv (sham 13) adam ki yihye veor besaro, vetinok ben yomo adam hu, deadam kol shehu mashma:
Umittamme vitme met. dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) veal hannefashot asher hayu sham, nefesh kol shehu:
Vezokek leyibbum. im nolad yom echad kodem mitat achiv. aval nolad leachar mitat achiv, eno zokek, dichtiv (Devarim 28) ki yeshvu achim yachdav, shehayta lahem yeshiva achat baolam:
Ufoter min hayyibbum. im nolad leachar mitat aviv vechaya shaa achat umet. aval kol zeman shemmeubberet, eno mattirah linnase:

Umaachil batteruma. bat yisrael shennisset lechohen umet, venolad ben leachar mitato, ochelet bishvilo bo bayyom shennolad, kedichtiv (Vayikra 22) vilid beto hem yochlu velachmo, vedarshinan yaachilu et immam. aval hinnichah meubberet, enah ochelet bishvilo ad sheyyivvaled:

Ufosel min hatteruma. kegon kohen shehayu lo shete nashim, achat gerusha sheavar unesaah keshehi gerusha, veachat sheenah gerusha, veyesh lo banim mishsheenah gerusha, vaavadim shennaflu lahen birushsha ochlim batteruma bishvilan, dichtiv (sham) vechohen ki yikne nefesh kinyan kaspo, veyesh lo ben yom echad min haggerusha vehu chalal, veyesh lo chelek baavadim, ufosel et kullan min hatteruma, deen berera ladaat mi mehen maggia lechelko. vedavka ben yom echad derauy lirushsha. aval kol zeman shello nolad, ochlim kullan, deen zechiyya leubbar:

Venochel umanchil. nochel et haem. im meta immo bayyom shennolad, hare hu nochalah. ucheshemmet hu, bain echav meaviv veyorshim hemennu nichse immo. aval ubbar shebbemeeha, im meta meubberet eno nochel et immo lehanechil leechav meaviv, shehare met hu kodem immo, veen habben yoresh et immo bakkever lehanechil leechav meaviv:
Vehahorgo chayyav. dichtiv (Vayikra 24) veish ki yakke kol nefesh, mikkol makom:

Kechatan shalem. shechayyavim lehitabbel alav. vehane mille, dekim lehu begavveh shekkalu lo chodashav, aval lo kim lehu shekkalu lo chodashav, en chayyavin lehitabbel alav ad sheyyihye ben sheloshim veechad yom:
En notlin etzim min hassukka. afillu sukka sheenah shel mitzva kegon befesach o baatzeret, en notlim mimmenna etzim beyom tov, mishshum setirat ohel:
Ella min hassamuch lah. kegon kanim hazzekufim samuch laddefanot velo neergu im haddofen, delo batlu legabbe dofen, lefichach notlim mehen beyom tov:
Meviin etzim. telushim:
Min hassade. shebbetoch hattechum, min hammechunnas:

Umin hakkarpef afillu min hammefuzzar. matnitin yechidaa hi veenah halacha, ella hilchata en meviin etzim ella min hammechunnasim shebbakarpef. umin hassade lo yavi kelal, vaafillu min hammechunnasim, delav dateh illavayhu hoil veenan mishtammerim sham. aval min hakkarpef shehu mishtammer umukkaf saviv, keshehen mechunnasin dateh illavayhu:

Kol shessamuch lair. mammash. vehu deit leh potachat mippetach shemmishtammer, derabbi yehuda tarte vae, samuch lair ufotachat. umishshum dekasavar setam karpifot yesh lahem potachat, mishshum hachi lo chash lehazekirah:

Rabbi yose omer kol shennichnasin lo befotachat, vaafillu vetoch techum shabbat. kevan deit leh potachat lo bainan samuch, ella afillu rachok ad karov lesof techum shabbat. veim hu samuch lo bainan potachat. uvesamuch belo potachat o potachat belo samuch share. vahalacha kerabbi yose:
Aval lo vammidda. bichli hammeyuchad lemidda shemmoded umocher bo. aval im eno meyuchad lechach, af al pi sheomed lemidda, shekkesheyyishshaver ze shehu moded bo yaamod ze tachtav, muttar lemaloto:
Im haya cheli shel midda. af al pi sheadayin lo yichado lechach, lo yemalleennu. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Memalle middotav meerev yom tov. lefi sheen moddin beyom tov:

Af bechol hammoed ose chen. mippene bittul bet hammidrash, shehayu rabbim baim lishol hemennu bammoed, sheen terudin bimlacha, vehaya memalle middotav ballayla sheeno zeman bet hammidrash kede sheyyehe panuy bayyom:

Mippene mitztzuy hammiddot. keshehaya mocher shemen hayu lo middot harebe, umeviin hallakochot kelehen umoded lechol echad veechad bemidda leatzmo, umitmatztzot veholchot letoch kelehen kol hallayla, kede shello yishshaer lo hashshemen hammudbak beshule hammidda uvedafnoteha venimtza gozel et hallakochot:
Veshalhevet. kegon hidlik nero beshalhevet chavero, eno meakkev beissur techumin:
Moalin bah. hannehene mimmenna mevi asham meilot:

Veshalhevet lo nehenin. lechattechilla midderabbanan. veim nehenu lo moalin, en chayyavin karban meila, delet bah mammasha. vechen hammotzi gachelet beshabbat lirshut harabbim chayyav, veshalhevet sheddechafah beyado mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim patur:
Keragle hayyachid. en molichin hammayim ella keragle baal habbor:
Keragle otah hair. alpayim amma lechol ruach chutz leibburah:
Veshel ole vavel. heasuy leovre derachim beemtza hadderech, vaasaum bene haggola lishtotam baalotam:

Keragle hammemalle. mippene shehu hefker vehefker nikne behagebaha. veim ba echad veshaal lo memav eno molichan ella keraglav, dekasavar hay tanna yesh berera lehachemir umeetmol huvrar haddavar dilhay gavra chazu uvirshuteh kayyeme. udelo kerabbi yochanan ben nuri deamar cheftze hefker konin shevita leatzman bimkoman:

Hammaksha nidda. hachi kaamar, hammaksha beledatah bime niddatah veraata dam behakeshotah, hare hi nidda, delo tihara tora ledam koshi ella beachad asar yom shel yeme ziva, aval beyamim shel nidda lo tahareh rachamana:
Kishsheta. mechamat valad shelosha yamim betoch achad asar yom shel yeme ziva veraata kol shelosha yamim retzufim:
Veshafta. sheamda beshofi uvenachat mechavaleha meet leet barvii:

Veyalda. iggallay milleta dedamim sheraata lo bau mechamat valad, hilkach hare zo yoledet bezov. aval im lo shafta samuch leledatah, kol damim sheraata, mechamat valad hu, verachamana taharinhu mizziva, dichtiv zov damah, damah mechamat atzmah velo damah mechamat valad:
Layla vayom. deim shafta bachatzi yom shelishi veyalda bachatzi yom revii, deshafta meet leet, en ze shofi, ella im ken shafta layla veyom shel achar hallayla:
Kelele shabbat veyomo. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:
Sheshshafta min hatztzaar. kelomar veshafta zo sheamarnu, im shafta min hatztzaar af al pi shello shafta min haddam, have shofi:

Ben chamesh shanim lammikra. mearla yalfinan, dichtiv (Vayikra 19) shalosh shanim yihye lachem arelim vegomer uvashshana harviit yihye kol piryo kodesh hillulim, sheaviv melammedo tzurat haotiyyot vehekker hannekuddot. uvashshana hachamishit tochlu et piryo lehosif lachem tevuato, mikkan veelach sefe leh ketora:

Ben eser lammishna. shellomed mikra chamesh shanim, vechamesh shanim mishna, vechamesh shanim gemara. deamar mar (chullin kad.) kol talmid shello raa siman yafe bemishnato chamesh shanim shuv eno roe, dichtiv (Bamidbar 8) zot asher lalviyyim mibben chamesh veesrim shana vamala yavo litzvo tzava, shebba velomed hilchot avoda chamesh shanim, uven sheloshim oved:

Ben shelosh esre lammitzvot. dichtiv (sham 5) ish o ishsha ki yaasu mikkol chattot haadam, vegabbe shechem ketiv (Bereshit 34) vayyikchu shene vene yaakov shimon velevi ache dina ish charbo, velevi beoto perek ben shelosh esre shana haya, vekare leh ish:
Ben shemone esre lachuppa. tesha esre adam ketuvim befarashat bereshit min vayyomer elohim naase adam ad vayyiven Adonai elohim et hatztzela, chad legufeh, pashu leh shemona asar lidrasha:

Ben esrim lirdof. achar mezonotav. leachar shellamad mikra mishna ugemara venasa ishsha veholid banim, tzarich hu lachazor ulevakkesh achar mezonot. perush acher, ben esrim lirdof oto min hashshamayim ulehaanisho al maasav, sheen bet din shel maala maanishin pachot mibben esrim:
Ben sheloshim lakkoach. shehaleviyyim hayu mekimim et hammishkan umefarkin vetoanin et haagalot venosin bakkatef mibben sheloshim shana vamala:
Ben arbaim labbina. shelleachar arbaim shana shehayu yisrael bammidbar amar lahem moshe (Devarim 29) velo natan Adonai lachem lev ladaat veenayim lirot veaznayim lishmoa ad hayyom hazze:
Ben chamishshim laetza. shenneemar balleviyyim (Bamidbar 8) umibben chamishshim shana yashuv mitztzeva haavoda velo yaavod od vesheret et echav vegomer, umahu hashsherut, sheyyitten lahem etza:
Ben shishshim lazzikna. dichtiv (Iyov 5) tavo vechelach ele kaver. 60 baggimatriyya shishshim:
Ben shivim lashsheva. dichtiv bedavid (divrei hayamim 1 29) vayyamat beseva tova, vime chayyav hayu shivim shana:
Ben shemonim ligvurot. dichtiv (tehillim 90) veim bigvurot shemonim shana:
Ben tishim lashuach. holech shachuach vechafuf. veyesh omrim, leshon shucha amukka:
Kol achad asar yom. sheachar shivat yeme nidda:
Bechezkat tohora. veenah tzericha livdok atzmah. dahalacha lemoshe missinay sheen ben nidda lenidda pachot meachad asar yom:
Yashva lah velo vadka. matnitin chassore michassera vehachi katane, bime niddatah baya bedika. yashva velo badka, shagga, neensa, hezida velo badka, tehora:
Higgia sheat vistah velo vadka. af al pi shebbadka achar kach umatza tehora, hoil velo badka bishat vestah, temea, deorach bizmanno ba:
Bemachave. mechamat listim o chayil shebba lair. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Aval yeme hazzav vehazzava. shivat yamim nekiyyim shetztzerichim lispor:
Veshomeret yom. kegon haroa yom echad o shene yamim bime zivatah, enah soferet ella yom echad binkiyyut, vetovelet laerev utehora levalah:
Hare ellu bechezkat tuma. kevan shenniftach mayanah veraata hayyom, af al gav detoch achad asar hi, haveya lemachar bechezkat tuma:
Shennizdazeu evarav. shenneekra shichvat zera miggufo:
Ochez baamma. veaf al gav dechol haochez baamma umashtin keillu mevi mabbul laolam, hacha kevan deneekra shichvat zera shuv eno chozer umitchammem laakor od miyyad beotah shaa:
Umetammein. zov veshichvat zera:
Bechol shehen. laadam hayyotze mimmennu. aval hannogea, eno tame ad sheyyigga bechaadasha:

Sheluchin yotzin. keshekkiddeshu bet din et hachodesh sholchin umodiin laggola yom shekkiddeshuhu, im beyom sheloshim vechodesh sheavar chaser, im beyom sheloshim veechad vechodesh sheavar male. usheluche bet din en mechallelin lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov:
Veal av mippene hattaanit. lefi shehuchpelu bo tzarot yoter mishshear taaniyyot:

Veal elul mippene rosh hashshana. modiin matay elul, veosin rosh hashshana beyom sheloshim beelul baggola, derov shanim en elul meubbar. veaf al pi shessafek beyadam shemma yeabberuhu bet din, i efshar lahem ladaat, veal karchan holchim achar rov shanim. veim lo yedu matay matchil [elul], lo yedu yom sheloshim shello:

Veal tishre mippene takkanat hammoadot. leachar shekkiddeshu bet din letishre, hashsheluchin yotzin leyom hammochorat veholchin ad makom sheycholin lehaggia ad hechag, umodiin otam im ibberu bet din et elul im lav, kede shello yehe libban nokfan beyom hakkippurim uvesukkot:
Pesach katan. pesach sheni:

Chamishsha damim temeim. dishte peamim ketiv dameha bakkera betumat damim shebbaishsha, (Vayikra 20) vehi gilleta et mekor dameha, (sham 12) vetahara mimmekor dameha, umiut dameha shenayim, hare arbaa damim. odem, vekeren karkom, umeme adama, umazug. vehashshachor bichlal adom hu, vehachi amrinan baggemara, hay shachor adom hu, ella shellaka:
Uchekeren karkom. kemare ziv hakkarkom. leshon ki karan or panav (Shemot 34):
Uchememe adama. kullan mefaresh lahen lekamman bematnitin:
Uchemazug. keyayin adom hammazug bemayim:
Kememe tiltan. mayim sheshshorin bahen tiltan. 566 belaaz:
Uchememe vasar tzali. mochal hayyotze mibbasar tzaluy:

Uvet hillel metaharin. veshalosh machalokot baddavar. tanna kamma deamar chamishsha damim temeim vetu lo, sevira leh dememe tiltan ume basar tzali tolin, lo ochlin velo sorfin. uvet shammay metammein, vesorfim alehem teruma vekadashim. uvet hillel metaharin legamre. vahalacha ketanna kamma, detolin:
Akavya ben mahalalel metamme. disvira leh hay yarok kekeren karkom hu, ella shellaka. veyarok dimtamme akavya ben mahalalel, dehaynu kemare etrog, velo kemare karti sheeno note leadmimut kelal:

Vachachamim metaharim. veshalosh machalokot nammi beyarok, tanna kamma savar tolin lo ochlim velo sorfim, vaakavya ben mahalalel metamme vesorfim, vachachamim metaharin veochlim. vahalacha ketanna kamma:
Im eno metamme mishshum ketem. lihyoto chashuv min haddamim hametammein baishsha:
Metamme mishshum mashke. vechashuv hu dam lehacheshir hazzeraim lekabbel tuma kechol shear dam, shehu echad min hashshiva mashkin shemmachshirin et hazzeraim:
Lo chach velo chach. lo metamme mishshum ketem, velo machshir et hazzeraim. vahalacha kerabbi yose, vehu chachamim diflige aakavya:
Lo yaviu lo. mipperotav, hoil vehu lo erev lesham, deferotav kamohu:
Laakor et kol hagguf. kol ikkarah shel mitzva, kedimfaresh veazel:
Hare ellu feturim. dichtiv (Vayikra 4) venelam davar, kare ve venelam middavar, miktzat haddavar velo kullo:

Aval habba al shomeret yom keneged yom patur. baggemara parech deha shomeret yom keneged yom battora ketiv (sham 15), vesafra lah, melammed shessoferet echad keneged echad, vechol mide dichtiv battora en bet din meviin alav karban. umefaresh baggemara kegon deamre zava lo have ella vimama, kelomar, kesheroa dam bayyom velo kesheroa ballayla, dichtiv (sham) kol yeme zovah:
Hammotzi mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim patur. deamre hachenasa vehotzaa asura, dichtiv (Shemot 16) al yetze ish mimmekomo, zerika vehoshata mutteret:

Hammishtachave fatur. deamre hishtachavaa deit bah pishshut yadayim veraglayim asura, dichtiv (sham 34) lo tishtachave leel acher, vesheen bah pishshut yadayim veraglayim mutteret. uchelala demilleta, en bet din chayyavin ad sheyyoru bedavar sheen hatztzedokin modin bo. aval horu bedavar shehatztzedokin modin bo, peturin mikkarban tzibbur, veharabbim haosim al pihem kol echad chayyav lehavi karban al shiggato. may taama, dezil kare be rav hu:

Hacheder vehaaliyya vehapperozdor. cheder mibbifnim, uferozdor mibbachutz, shenehem ze etzel ze, cheder letzad achoreha, uferozdor lefaneha, vaaliyya benuya al shetehen, venekev yesh ben aliyya lapperozdor venikra lul. ufeamim yored dam min haaliyya lapperozdor derech hallul. vechatle rechem, lematta beemtza perozdor, vederech sham damim yotzim:
Dam hacheder tame. dehaynu dam hammakor:
Sefeko tame. missafek tame tuma vaddait:

Shechezkato min hammakor. velo amrinan shemma min haaliyya ba, udeme haaliyya tehorim hem, ella asauhu keillu vadday ba min hammakor. vehane mile, keshennimtza min hallul velifnim letzad hacheder, aval nimtza min hallul velachutz, eno tame tuma vaddait lisrof, ella sefeko tame litlot, shehare shene damim yotzin derech sham, deme hacheder udeme haaliyya, velo yadinan mehe ata:
Yotze dofen. ishsha sheppatchu [meeha] al yede sam vehotziu haubbar lachutz venitrappea:
En yoshvin alav yeme tuma. shiva lezachar ushevuayim linkeva:
Vime tohora. veen lah dam tohar:
Veen chayyavin alav karban. shel yoledet. dichtiv (Vayikra 12) ishsha ki tazria veyalda, ad shetteled mimmakom shemmazraat:
Rabbi shimon omer hare ze cheyalud. shenneemar (sham) veim nekeva teled, lerabbot yotze dofen. veen halacha kerabbi shimon:

Kol hannashim mittammeot. benidda mishsheyyatza haddam min hammakor vehiggia labbayit hachitzon, veaf al gav deheemiduhu katle bet harechem velo perash lachutz. dichtiv [sham 15] dam yihye zovah bivsarah, melammed shemmetammea af al pi sheadayin hu bivsarah. uvayit hachitzon mikre makom shehaevar dash bo bishat bia:
Enan mittammein ad shettetze tumatan lachutz. dichtiv bazzav (sham) ish ki yihye zav mibbesaro, ad shettetze zovo mibbesaro. uvevaal keri ketiv (sham 22) asher tetze mimmennu shichvat zara:
Mishshellefanav. mimma shellefanav babbayit:

Lachatzotz bo shinnav. littol basar hachotzetz ben shinnav. umishshellefanav lav davka, dilrabbi eliezer af min hechatzer nammi muttar littol, dekaamar kol ma shebbechatzer muchan hu. veha denakat mishshellefanav, mishshum rabbanan diflige daafillu mishshellefanav lehadelik en, lachatzotz lo, desavre lo nittenu etzim ella lahassaka:

Vachachamim omrim megabbev mishshellefanav umadlik. aval min hechatzer lo, dehoil vekismin dakkin hen vetoreach lekoshshan ulegabbevan, meetmol lav lehachi kayme. udekaamart notel kesam lachatzotz bo shinnav, anan it lan deaf mishshellefanav lo yittol ella lehadelik, delo nittenu etzim ella lahassaka. uvetarte felige. vahalacha kachachamim. veen muttar littol kesam lachatzotz bo shinnav ella meevus shel behema. velo yechattechennu vitakkenennu lechach, ella im ken haya lach verauy lemaachal behema, shekkol davar harauy lemaachal behema muttar lechatcho ben beyom tov ben beshabbat, veen bahem mishshum tikkun keli:
Bearbaa ferakim. bashshana:
Befesach al hattevua. middeamra tora haviu lefanay omer befesach kede sheavarech lachem tevua shebbassadot, minna yadinan divfesach niddonim al hattevua:

Uvaatzeret al perot hailan. middeamra tora haviu lefanay shete hallechem baatzeret kede sheavarech lachem perot hailan, vechitta etz karye rachamana dichtiv (Bereshit 2) umeetz haddaat tov vara, keman deamar etz sheachal adam harishon chitta haya:
Kivne maron. kivne immerayya, kichvasim hallalu shemotziin otan befetach katan ze achar ze leasseran, veen shenayim yecholim latzet keechad:

Hayyotzer yachad libbam. hachi kaamar, hayyotzer vehu hakkadosh baruch hu, roe yachad libbam umevin el kol maasehem, sheaf al pi sheovrim lefanav echad echad, mikkol makom kullan niskarim biskira achat:
Uvechag niddonin al hammayim. middeamra tora nassechu lefanay mayim bechag:
Hammaksha vetoch shemonim shel nekeva. kegon sheshshimmesha leachar arbaa asar shel yeme leda venitabbera vehippila betoch shemonim:
Kol damim shehi roa tehorim. dechol toch melot have dam tahor:
Verabbi eliezer metamme. nidda, dechevan divkoshi ba lav dam tohar hu ella mechamat valad shebbemeeha, umizziva hu detahareh rachamana lakkishshuy, velo minnidda:
Shehechmir bedam hashshofi. kegon shear yoledet sheroa shelosha beshofi veyalda, hare zo yoledet bezov:
Hekel bedam hakkoshi. letaharah mizziva:
Mekom shehekel bedam hashshofi. letaharah mikkol tuma, kegon toch melot:
Eno din shennakel bedam hakkoshi. letaharo mikkol tumot vaafillu minnidda:
Dayyo labba min haddin. kegon koshi shel toch melot sheattem lemedim mikkoshi shel alma, dayyo lihyot kanniddon kekoshi dealma, ma koshi dealma tame benidda, af koshi detoch melot tame benidda:
En motziin et haur. mishshum demolid vedame limlacha, shebbore haesh hazze beyom tov:
Min heafar. yesh karka keshechofrin otah motzia ur mimmekom machporet shellah:
Velo min hammayim. notnim mayim bichli zechuchit levana venotno bachamma keshehashshemesh cham meod vehazzechuchit motzia shalhevet, umeviim neoret umaggiim bazzechuchit vehi boeret:
Reafim. kele cheres chalulim beemtzaan shemmechassim bahen haggaggot:
En melabbenin. baur:
Et harafim. davka birafim chadashim, mishshum demashve leh mana behessek ze, shehen mitchassemin umitchazzekim al yede haur:
Veod amar rabbi eliezer. mishshum detana achat lekulla gabbe muktze vehadar amar achariti, kaamar veod:
Omed adam al hammuktze. hatztzarich hazemana, vehazemana moelet lo:

Erev shabbat bashsheviit. sheen maaser noheg bah veen mechussar ella hazemana. vehu haddin bimussar uvishar shene hashshavua. ella orcha demilleta nakat, distam muktze lav meussar hu, digrogarot vetzimmukim hen setam muktze veen regilin leasser kodem gemar melacha:
Mikkan ani notel lemachar. vesaggi behachi, deyesh berera:
Ad sheyyirshom. besiman, deen berera. vahalacha kachachamim:
En mashchizin et hassakkin. berechayim o bemashchezet:
Aval massiah al gabbe chavertah. dimshanne midderech chol:
Hammappelet leyom arbaim. litvilatah:
Enah chosheshet levalad. shello nigmera yetzirato ad sheyyichlu kol arbaim yom:
Ulenidda. keshettire, tehe nidda, dilma lekka valad veen kan yeme tohar:

Yom arbaim veechad teshev lezachar. shiva yeme tuma. afillu beleda yaveshta sheenah nidda. aval shevuayim dinkeva, enah yoshevet, kiddekatane taama sheyyetzirat nekeva lishmonim veechad. veen halacha kerabbi yishmael:

Vachachamim omrim kulei. chachamim hayenu tanna kamma, ella mishshum demistabber taameh derabbi yishmael tefe middetanna kamma, hadar rabbi ushenaah bilshon chachamim, leashmeinan dahalacha kistam rishon, veaf al pi shemmachaloket rabbi yishmael betziddo:
Kol shechayyavin alav. sheasru chachamim laasoto beshabbat mishshum shevut:
O mishshum reshut. sheyyesh bo ketzat mitzva aval lo mitzva gedola, vekarov hu lihyot devar harshut, veyesh bo issur middivre sofrim:
O mishshum mitzva. o sheyyesh bo mitzva mammash, veasru chachamim laasoto beshabbat:
Chayyavin alav. shello laasoto beyom tov:
Veellu hen mishshum shevut. shehetilu alav chachamim lishbot mehen veen baasiyyatan shum mitzva:
Lo olin bailan. gezera shemma yitlosh:
Velo rochvin al gabbe vehema. gezera shemma yachtoch zemora lehanehigah:
Velo shatin al pene hammayim. gezera shemma yaase chavit shel shayyatin:
Velo metappechin. kaf al kaf:
Velo mesappekin. kaf al yarech:
Velo merakkedin. baregel. vechullehu gezera shemma yetakken kele shir:
Veellu hen mishshum reshut. mishshum dehanach desefa havu mitzva gemura, legabbehen kare lehane reshut:
Lo danin. din. vezimnin dahave reshut, kegon sheyyesh bair gadol mimmennu, sheen muttal alav ladun:
Velo mekaddeshin. kiddushe ishsha. vezimnin delo have mitzva gemura ella reshut, kegon deit leh ishsha uvanim:
Velo choltzin velo meyabbemin. nammi bizman sheyyesh achiv haggadol mimmennu have reshut, demitzva vaggadol leyabbem. vetama dechullehu, gezera shemma yichtov:
Velo maarichin. erech peloni alay. venoten kefi hashshanim kemo shekkatuv befarashat arachin (Vayikra 27):
Velo macharimin. hare behema zo cherem. usetam charamim levedek habbayit. vechullehu asrinhu rabbanan mishshum dedamu lemikkach umimkar, shemmotzi mershuto lirshut hekdesh:

Velo magbihin terumot umaasrot. vaafillu kede littenam lechohen bo bayyom, demechaze demishshum simchat yom tov dechohen shehu tzarich lahen hu mafrishan, afillu hachi asur, dahava leh metakken. vehane mille perot ditvile meetmol, aval perot ditvile haidna kegon issa leafrushe minah challa mafrishinan la beyom tov veyahavinan lakkohen:

En ben yom tov leshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad. hach setama kevet shammay deamre en motziin lo et hakkatan velo et hallulav velo et sefer hattora lirshut harabbim, delo huttera hotzaa ella letzorech ochel nefesh. aval anan kayma lan kevet hillel deamre mittoch shehuttera hotzaa letzorech ochel nefesh huttera nammi shello letzorech. veikka nammi mashshilin perot derech arubba deresh pirkin, divshabbat asur uveyom tov muttar:

En chayyavin ella al helem davar. bet din shehoru latztzibbur al achat mikkol hammitzvot, en chayyavin lehavi par helem davar shel tzibbur ella al helem davar sheshshaggu behoraa venelam mehen haddin:
Im shiggat maase. veshaggu rov hatztzibbur veasu maase al pihem. dichtiv yishgu venelam davar, shiggat maase venelam davar:

Vechen hammashiach. vechen kohen gadol hammashuach beshemen hammishcha eno chayyav karban ad sheyyealem mimmennu haddin veyaase hu atzmo maase beshogeg al pi horaa shechashav, dichtiv (Vayikra 4) leashmat haam, melammed shehammashiach kaam:
Uvaavoda zara en chayyavin. (uvaavoda zara) shebbet din sheshshaggu behoraa baavoda zara chayyavin par vesair:
En chayyavin ella al helem davar im shiggat maase. kishar kol hammitzvot. deyalfinan avoda zara mishshear mitzvot miggezera shava demeene meene, kidchatvinan leel:

En chayyavin ella al davar shezzedono charet veal shiggato chattat. shekkol hakkeretot shebbattora hen sheloshim veshesh, veal kullan chayyavin al shiggatan chattat, chutz mechamesh shebbahen sheen chayyavin al shiggatan chattat, vehen mila vekarban pesach, lefi shehen mitzvot ase, af al pi sheyyesh al zedonan karet en chayyavin al shiggatan chattat, divchattat ketiv (Vayikra 4) achat mikkol mitzvot Adonai‏ asher lo teasena. umegaddef, mippene sheen bo maase, vehakkatuv omer bachattat laose bishgaga, yatza megaddef sheen bo maase. vetumat mikdash vekadashav en chayyavin al shiggatan ella karban ole veyored haamur bevayyikra. vechol hanach en bet din meviin chattat al shiggatan, velo hammashiach. nimtzeu kol hammitzvot shebbet din vechohen hammashiach meviin alehen karban, sheloshim veachat mitzvot shechayyavin al zedonan karet veal shiggatan chattat kevua:

Kedam hammakka. kedam shel shor shachut shehu adom harebe, uvitchillat hakkaatah shel sakkin, velo kaddam shel kulla shechita, sheddam shechita mishtanne veholech. veit deamre, kedam hammakka shel hakkaza:

Kacheret. kemare haddeyo shebbeshule hakkeli, shehu shachor harebe, velo kemare haddeyo shebberosh hakkeli shehu kalush veeno shachor kol kach. perush acher, cheret 314 belaaz, shetztzovin bo haorot. kemo charta deushechafe [dimgilla daf 19.]:
Amok mikkan. sheamok bemare shacharurit, kelomar shachor yoter mecheret:
Dehe. shennidhet marito veeno shachor kol kach. vehu haddin lechol damim temeim, divchullehu amok mikkan tame, dehe mikkan tahor, chutz miyyayin mazug, deven amok ben dehe tahor:

Kabbarur shebbo. sheyyesh alin berurim bemare adamdumit yoter mechavrehen. veshalosh shurot shel alin yesh bakkarkom, uvechol shura shelosha alin, veen bodkin ella bashshura haemtzait, veheale haemtzai shebbashshura haemtzait, meshubbach shebbechullan livdika:
Mibbikat bet kerem. makom yadua beeretz yisrael sheshshemo bet kerem:
Umetzif mayim. noten mayim al heafar, ad sheyyihyu hammayim tzafin al gabbe haadama. umeshaarin otan achurim, veen meshaarim otan tzelulim:

Uchemazug. ketzad: shene chalakim mayim veechad yayin min hayyayin hashsharoni. habba meeretz hashsharon. makom yadua beeretz yisrael. perush acher, yayin heasuy min haggefanim hannetuim babbika uvaemek. leshon chavatztzelet hashsharon. uvazzeman hazze, kol ma shetterae beishsha meoto makom, tame, chutz min hallavan vehayyarok. umiyyamenu lo shamanu mi shehittir shum mare dam, ella hallavan vehayyarok kecharti bilvad:
Kamma hu kishshuyah. delo atya lide ziva bechol damim shettire:
Afillu arbaim vachamishshim yom. im lo shafta yom echad samuch lalleda, lo atya lide ziva velo haveya yoledet bezov:

Dayyah chadshah. dayyah im netaher et hakkoshi chodesh echad, dehaynu chodesh teshii. aval kashta shelosha betoch achad asar yeme ziva bechodesh shemini vaafillu kashta veholechet kol teshii, hare zo yoledet bezov mechamat shelosha yamim shel shemini:

En kishshuy yoter mishshete shabbatot. sheim kashta veraata shelosha yamim kodem shete shabbatot vehayta maksha veholechet kol hashshabbatot achare chen, hare zo yoledet bezov mechamat shelosha yamim shehayu kodem hashshete shabbatot. vahalacha kerabbi yose verabbi shimon:
En nimnin. en poskim damim lihyot shenayim shelosha bene adam omrim behema zo bishlosha zuzim, zuz lechol echad:
Veshochatim umechallekim benehen. lemechetza lishlish velirvia, veen mazkirin pissuk damim:
Shokel adam basar. af al pi sheasur lishkol belitra, dahave maase chol, muttar lishkol keneged hakkeli ucheneged hakkofitz, ulemachar yiru hakkofitz vehakkeli kamma mishkalo:
Chachamim omrim en mashgichin. en meayyenin:
Bechaf moznayim kol ikkar. vaafillu lishmor habbasar min haachbarin asur lasum oto bechaf moznayim. vahalacha kachachamim:

En tzadin dagim. af al gav dishchita vaafiyya uvishshul meavot melachot hen vehutteru letzorech yom tov, tzida damya liktzira, uketzira lo huttera beyom tov. bevarin shel dagim, hen berechot shel mayim sheddagim mitgaddelim sham. bevarim shel chayya, karpifot mukkafin gader saviv umeviim sham chayyot veyoldot umitgaddelot sham:
Veen notnin. lifne haddagim mezonot, deefshar lahem belo mezonot veen mezonotan alecha:
Aval tzadin chayya vaof. hammuchanim meetmol:
Min habbevarin. hakketannim, sheen mechussarim tzida. verabban shimon ben gamliel lav leafluge attanna kamma ata, ella lifrushe:
Kol hammechussar tzida. shetztzarich levakkesh tachbulot kede letafso. vechol derahet batreh umate leh bechad shechiyya lo have mechussar tzida, vei lo, have mechussar tzida:
Agala. haasuya lesachek lekatan, umeyuchedet lo leshev aleha:
Temea midras. im haya hakkatan zav naaset haagala av hattuma:
Venittelet beshabbat. detorat keli aleha:
Veenah nigreret. beshabbat:
Ella al gabbe chelim. al gabbe begadim, mippene sheosa charitz bakkarka, vechofer chayyav mishshum choresh:

Rabbi yehuda omer kulei. tere tannae ninhu veallibba derabbi yehuda, detanna kamma nammi rabbi yehuda hi deamar davar sheen mitkavven asur. vaata hay tanna achariti veamar delo asar rabbi yehuda baagala shel katan, mippene sheenah osa charitz behilluchah al yede chafira, ella koveshet hakkarka venadosh tachteha venaase afarah namuch, aval enah meziza afar mimmekomah. uchevar ifsika hilchata kerabbi shimon deamar gorer adam mitta kisse vesafsal, uvilvad shello yitkavven laasot charitz:

Umaase venachri echad. chissure michassera vehachi katane, safek muchan asur verabban gamliel mattir, umaase benachri echad vechulei. veen halacha kerabban gamliel, ella perot vedagim shehuveu beyom tov, safek nilketu hayyom safek meetmol, safek nitztzodu hayyom safek meetmol, asurim. vechol sheasur leachlo asur letaltelo. veim tzuratan mochachat alehen, kegon perot dichmushin shei efshar shennilketu hayyom, vechen dagim shehevium mimmakom rachok shei efshar shennitztzodu hayyom, muttarin. vedavar muchan shebba michutz lattechum bishvil yisrael, asur leoto yisrael shehuva bishvilo ulechol bene veto, umuttar leyisrael acher. uferot o dagim shennitleshu o nitztzodu beyom tov rishon muttarin laerev belel yom tov sheni bichde sheyyaasu, chutz mishshene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana shehem asurim ad motzae yom tov sheni bichde sheyyaasu. uferush kede sheyyaasu, kede sheyyitleshu happerot mimmakom shennitleshu veyaviu otam min hammakom shehevium. veir sheddaltoteha neulot ballayla tzarich sheyyamtin labboker bichde sheyyaasu:
Ella sheen retzoni lekabbel mimmennu. sheani sone oto:
Behema mesukkenet. shehu yare shemma tamut. veen tzarich lah, shekkevar saad seudato:
Lo yishchot. ella im ken yodea sheyyesh shahut bayyom leechol kazzayit tzali hemenna:
Mibbet tevichatah. shehu mezumman umufshat meoro veomed. veen halacha kerabbi akiva:
Lo yevienna bemot uvemota. bishne bene adam. mishshum deavsha milleta umezalzel bichvod yom tov:
Veen yadua ma hu. im zachar im nekeva:
Teshev lezachar velinkeva. yeme tohar dezachar, vime tuma dinkeva:

Lezachar velinkeva ulenidda. kelomar, keshettire tehe nidda, sheen lah yeme tohar, deshemma lav valad hu. vetovelet lesof arbaim keyoledet zachar leman deamar tevila bizmannah mitzva. vetovelet yom aroch, kegon yoledet zachar shettavla lesof shiva veenah tehora lakkodesh velammikdash ad melot haarbaim, tzericha tevila acheret lesof haarbaim, vezot nitzrecha litbol lesof arbaim yom keyoledet zachar, af al pi sheen tevila zo moelet lah kelum, shehare enah tehora lakkodesh velammikdash ad melot shemonim keyoledet nekeva:
Mi shezzimmen etzlo orchim. meir acheret, veyavou etzlo al yede eruv:
Lo yolichu. leachar seuda manot beyadam levetam:
Ella im ken zikka lahem. al yede acher:
Teshev lezachar velinkeva. temea shevuayim kinkeva, vime tohar shellah sheloshim ushelosha yom bilvad kezachar:
Tumtum vezachar anderoginos vezachar. kegon sheyyalda teomim, echad tumtum o anderoginos, vehaechad zachar vadday:
Teshev lezachar velinkeva. velo amrinan middehay zachar vadday, hay nammi zachar:
Teshev linkeva vilvad. daafillu have tumtum zachar, batar nekevot azlinan, dechol yeme zachar ben letuma ben letohora muvlaim toch shel nekeva:
Mechuttach. avarim avarim:
Mesoras. lashon hafuch hu. kemo, sares hammikra vedarshehu [bava vatra kayit.]:
Mishsheyyatza rubbo hare hu cheyalud. verosho kerubbo. hilkach mishsheyyatza rosho shel mechuttach, af al pi shekkol shear hagguf bifnim, hare hu keyalud:
Paddachto. mitzcho:
En mevakkein etzim min hakkorot. hassedurot baaretz, kede shello yitakkemu, veomdot levinyan:
Velo min hakkora shennishbera veyom tov. veaf al gav dehashta lahassaka kayma, ben hashshemashot lav lehachi kayma:
Veen mevakkein lo vekardom. matnitin chissure michassera vehachi katane, aval mevakkein min hakkora shennishbera meerev yom tov, ucheshehen mevakkein en mevakkein lo vakkardom:
Velo vimgera. keen sakkin aroch male pegimot vekotztzin bo etzim avim. ucheli umman hu:
Maggal. af hu keli umman, venire kerotze laasot melacha:

Ella vekofitz. setam kofitz hu sakkin shel katztzavim, veeno keli umman. veyesh mehen sheyyesh lahen shene rashin, rosh echad rachav venikra tzad nakvut, verosh echad tzar venikra tzad zachrut, veen mevakkein bo ella betzad zachrut shello:

Notel mimmekom happechat. velo amrinan muktzim mechamat issur hen deen yachol lefachato beyom tov vaasach dateh minnayhu, devayit ditnan bematnitin mayre sheeno banuy betit uvesid ella sadur shel levenim zo al zo belo tit, vehasheta en bifchitato issura deorayta, hilkach lav muktzim ninhu, ki hechi deamrinan gabbe tevel delav muktze hu sheim avar vetikkeno metukkan:
Af pochet lechattechilla. dehoil veen sham tit ella levenim sedurin zo al zo, lo have soter, veshare lifchot lechattechilla. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Rabbi shimon poter. kevan sheppashta horaatam berov tzibbur:

Verabbi eliezer omer safek. hoil vehaya lo lishol bechol et al devarim shennitchaddeshu bevet din velo shaal, hare ze kemi shennistappek lo im chata im lo chata, umevi asham taluy. vahalacha kerabbi eliezer:
Ezehu safek. kelomar bamme omer rabbi eliezer shehu niddon kemi shennistappek lo im chata im lo chata vechayyav asham taluy:
Beyoshev beveto. keshehu yoshev beveto bammedina shehoru bah bet din, shehaya efshar sheyyishma shechazru bahem bet din mehoraatam:

Aval halach lo limdinat hayyam. velav davka halach, ella hechezik badderech lalechet af al pi sheadayin lo halach, sevira leh lerabbi akiva shemmippene tirdato latzet ladderech eno shoel im chazru bahen bet din, ufatur measham taluy. uven azzay savar, hoil vaadayin lo halach haya lo lishol. uvehachi moke la pelugetayhu baggemara. vahalacha kerabbi akiva:

Dam nachrit bet shammay metaharin. veaf al gav divrukkah uvememe ragleha modu bet shammay derabbanan gazru alehen lihyot kezavin lechol divrehen, afillu hachi damah tahor, deshiyyeru bah rabbanan lemihve hekkera detumatan derabbanan, ki hechi delo lisrefu alayhu teruma vekadashim:

Vedam tahor shel metzoraat. veaf al gav demayanot shel metzoraat kegon rukkah umeme ragleha havu av hattuma keshel zav, afillu hachi dam tohar shellah tahor, delav mayan hu, dedumeya derok bainan shemmitaggel veyotze:

Kerukkah uchememe ragleha. dimtammein lachin veen metammein yeveshin. vehach hekkera hu deavud gabbe dam hannachrit dimtamme midderabbanan sheggazru alehem sheyyihyu kazzavim lechol divrehen, deillu deyisreelit metamme lach veyavesh, udenachrit lach velo yavesh, kerukkah uchememe ragleha deen metammein yeveshin. vedam tahor shel metzoraat nammi, af al gav dedam lav mayan hu, din mayan it leh, derachamana rabbeye mikkera dichtiv lezachar, lerabbot metzora lemayenotav, velinkeva, lerabbot metzoraat lemayenoteha, veamrinan mayenoteha demay, ilema shear mayenoteha kegon rukkah umeme ragleha deatu mizzav dichtiv beh vechi yarok hazzav, uminneh nafke shear mayanot, mizzachar nafka, dechevan deitrabbe metzora lemayenotav, itrabbe metzoraat lechol mayenoteha deikka dichvatayhu bezachar, ella ledamah deleteh bezachar, vechevan derabbeye rachamana ledamah sheyyehe kerukkah uchememe ragleha, im ken ma rukkah umeme ragleha metammein lachin veen metammein yeveshim, af damah ken:
Dam hayyoledet. sheavru shivat yeme tumat leda velo tavla:

Bet shammay omrim kerukkah uchememe ragleha. metamme lach veeno metamme yavesh. veaf al gav dedam tohar hu, divyome tala rachamana veha malu, velekka letammoye nammi mishshum mayan deha en mitaggel veyotze, afillu hachi rabbanan gazzur tuma aleh, hoil velo tavla utemea hi, gezera achar shiva attu toch shiva. umihu lo gazzur sheyyetamme lach veyavesh kelifne shiva, ki hechi delahave leh hekkera deleda detumato derabbanan:

Uvet hillel omrim metamme lach veyavesh. detumato min hattora kol zeman shello tavla. desavre bet hillel beyome utevila tala rachamana, vechol zeman shello tavla, hare damah leachar shiva kelifne shiva:

Umodim beyoledet bezov. im beet ledatah hayta zava shehi tzericha lispor shiva nekiyyim kodem shettithar, veyalda velo safra, modim bet shammay levet hillel sheddamah tame lach veyavesh af al pi sheavru shivat yeme leda lezachar ushevuayim linkeva, sheddamah shel zava leolam hu betumato min hattora ad shettispor shiva nekiyyim:
En chet ba al yado. kede shello yehe hu baggehinnom vetalmidav began eden:
En maspikin beyado laasot teshuva. shello yehe hu began eden vetalmidav baggehinnom:
Vezikka et harabbim. shellimmed tora lechol yisrael:
Tzidkat Adonai asa umishpatav im yisrael. umishpatav sheim yisrael keillu hu asaan:
Asher chata vaasher hecheti et yisrael. middelo kaamar al chattot yaravam veyisrael, shema minna shehakkol taluy beyaravam:

Az kannamer. hannamer hazze nolad min chazir hayyaar vehallevia, ki beet yachem haarayot hallevia machneset roshah besivche hayyaar venohemet vetovaat et hazzachar, vehachazir shomea kolah verovah, venamer yotze mibben shenehen. ulefi shehu mamzer hu az panim, af al pi sheen bo gevura kol kach. af atta heve az velo titbayyesh lishol merabbecha ma shello hevanta, keotah sheshshaninu lo habbayshan lamed:
Vekal kannesher. lachazor achar talmudecha, velo tiga. kedichtiv (yeshaya 40) yaalu ever kannesharim yarutzu velo yigau:
Veratz katztzevi. lirdof achar hammitzvot:
Vegibbor kaari. lichbosh et yitzrecha min haaverot:
Az panim. lefi shehaazzut nikkar bappanim kedichtiv (Mishlei 21) heez ish rasha befanav, lefichach nikra az panim:
Shettivne ircha bimhera veyamenu. kelomar, keshem shechonantanu zot hammidda, shessiman lezera avraham bayshanim rachamanim vegomle chasadim (yevamot et.), ken yehi ratzon shettivne ircha vechulei:

Behema shemmeta. bevehemat kadashim mayre, kidkatane aleh veal hachalla shennitmet. uvehemat kadashim shemmeta asura bahanaa uteuna kevura, hilkach lo yezizenna mimmekomah. aval behemat chullin mechattechin otah lifne hakkelavim. vehane mille shehayta mesukkenet meetmol, dedateh illavah, aval lo hayta mesukkenet meetmol af behemat chullin lo yezizenna mimmekomah:

Hachalla shennitmet. enah reuya lechohen beyom tov, af lahassaka o letittah lechalbo, deen mevaarin kadashim min haolam beyom tov, vaafillu al yede achilat behema, digzerat hakkatuv hi sheen kadashim temeim mitbaarim min haolam beyom tov:
Shebba al yevimto kenaah. vezacha benichse achiv. veaf al pi sheen kinyan lekatan, shane hacha demin shemayya aknoya nihaleh:

Veeno noten get ad sheyyagdil. im ba legarshah. dekiddushe achiv kiddushin gemurim, vegerushin shel ze enan gerushin gemurin. vedavka keshebba aleha leachar shehigdil, day lah beget. aval im lo ba aleha leachar shehigdil, tzericha get vachalitza:
Umittamme venidda. im ba aleha beniddatah. deviato bia lechol davar:
Ufosel. kegon nachri veeved o chalal ben tesha shanim shebba al hakkohenet, pesalah mitterumat aviha:
Veeno maachil. im hu kohen venasa yisreelit, eno maachilah batteruma, lefi sheen kinyano kinyan gamur. vaafillu hu yavam dekanya behach bia kedaamaran, afillu hachi eno maachilah batteruma:
Ufosel et habbehema. im revaah al pi ed echad:
Veniskelet al yado. im yesh shene edim:
Horu vet din laavor. sheamru laam muttarim attem laasot davar shechayyavim al zedono karet:

Vehalach hayyachid veasa. matnitin rabbi yehuda hi deamar yachid sheasa behoraat bet din patur. veenah halacha, ella kerabbanan deamre yachid sheasa behoraat bet din chayyav. veeno patur ad sheyyehu haosim al pi bet din rov yoshve eretz yisrael o rov hashshevatim, veaz bet din meviin par helem davar shel tzibbur, vehaosim al pihem peturim:
Shogeg al pihem. laafoke hecha shello tala behoraat bet din, kegon shehoru bet din shechelev muttar, venitchallef lo chelev beshumman vaachalo, shezze chayyav, shehare lo al pi bet din achal:
Ben shello asu. bet din atzman maase al pi horaatam, hu patur vehen chayyavin, shebbet din en meviin karban ella al shiggat horaa, shehammaase taluy bakkahal vehahoraa bevet din:

Hare ze chayyav mippene shello tala bevet din. veaf al gav demezid hu ze, shehare yada shettau veaf al pi chen asa kedivrehem, umezid lav bar karban hu, ha amrinan baggemara shehu shogeg, shechashav shemmitzva laasot al pi bet din vaafillu yada bahen shettau:
Ze hakkelal. laatoye mevaet behoraa, sheen darko laasot al pi horaatam, veasa kehoraat bet din lo mippene shessamach al horaatam ella mippene shennidme lo bedato shezze muttar, hare ze chayyav:

Kol machaloket shehi leshem shamayim sofah lehitkayyem. kelomar sheanshe hammachaloket hahi mitkayyemim veenam ovdin, kemachaloket hillel veshammay shello avdu lo talmide bet shammay velo talmide bet hillel. aval korach vaadato avdu. vaani shamati, perush sofah, tachlitah hamevukkash meinyanah. vehammachaloket shehi leshem shamayim, hattachlit vehassof hamevukkash meotah machaloket lehassig haemet, veze mitkayyem, kemo sheamru mittoch havvikkuach yitbarer haemet, uchemo shennitbaer bemachaloket hillel veshammay shehalacha kevet hillel. umachaloket sheenah leshem shamayim, tachlit hannirtze bah hi bakkashat hasserara veahavat hannitztzuach, veze hassof eno mitkayyem, kemo shemmatzinu bemachaloket korach vaadato shettachlit vesof kavvanatam hayta bakkashat hakkavod vehasserara vehayu lehefech:
Mittalmidav shel avraham avinu. lamed mimmennu veholech bidrachav:
Ayin tova. mistappek bema sheyyesh lo veeno chomed mamon acherim. shekken matzinu beavraham sheamar lemelech sedom (Bereshit 14) im michut vead seroch naal veim ekkach mikkol asher lecha:
Veruach nemucha. anava yetera. vechen matzinu avraham omer (sham 18) veanochi afar vaefer:

Venefesh shefala. zehirut vehapperisha min hattaavot. umatzinu ze beavraham, dichtiv (sham 12) hinne na yadati ki ishsha yefat mare at, shead achshav lo hikkir bah merov tzeniut. uvevilam ashkechan ayin raa, shehaya yodea shehaya ra beene hammakom sheyyelech etzel balak vehaya holech kede littol sachar, dichtiv (Bamidbar 22) im yitten li valak melo veto kesef vezahav:
Veruach gevoha. deamar (sham 24) neum shomea imre el veyodea daat elyon:
Venefesh rechava. sheim lo haya rav hattaava lo haya yoetz lehafekir benot moav liznut. veamru chachamim (sanhedrin 105.) bilam boel atono haya:
Lehanechil ohavay yesh. avraham ikkere ohev, dichtiv (yeshaya ma) zera avraham ohavi. yesh, baolam habba, veotzrotehem amalle, baolam hazze:
Anshe damim. bilam ikkere ish damim, shehippil baatzato esrim vearbaa alafim miyyisrael:
Veyada echad mehen shettau vechulei. deamar kera (Vayikra 4) veim kol adat yisrael yishgu, ad sheyyihyu kullam maskimim bashshegaga:
Mufla shel bet din. haggadol shebbahen, rosh hayeshiva:
Zaken shello raa banim. eno rauy ladun dine nefashot, shessetamo shehu achzari velo yerachem:
Veneemar lehallan eda. veshaftu haeda:

Ma eda haamura lehallan vechulei. shenneemar bassanhedrin (Bamidbar 11) vehityatztzevu sham immach, bedomin lecha, meyuchasin kemotcha. perat leger ulenatin ulemamzer sheenan reuyin limmanot bassanhedrin:
Mezidin. sheyyadu bet din shehaddavar asur, peturim mikkarban tzibbur, demezid lav bar karban hu. vehaosim shogeg meviim kisba o seira chattat yachid:

Shoggim veasu mezidin ellu veellu feturim. bet din peturim shehare lo asu hakkahal mippi horaatam velo talu maasehem bevet din, shehare yadu shebbet din tau. vechol haosim peturim shehare mezidim hen umezid lav bar karban hu:
